### [205] [Making Clinical Language Models Auditable: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning for Robust Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27397)
*Jin Mu,Guanhua Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAST框架利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）暴露中间层Transformer激活中的可审计特征，通过LLM辅助标注和ICD-10约束来抑制临床笔记中的伪影特征，在MIMIC-IV死亡预测任务上超越微调编码器基线并达到与强LLM基线相当的水平，同时提供特征级审计轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床语言模型在院内数据上表现良好，但在部署场景下因依赖笔记特有的伪影（如模板、分隔符、样板文本）而性能下降，这些伪影不能反映真实患者状态，需要一种能够识别并抑制这些伪影的可审计框架。

Method: CAST主要包含四个环节：(1)使用SAE从Transformer中间激活中提取稀疏、人类可审计的特征；(2)利用LLM辅助的解释管道结合ICD-10检索约束对SAE潜在变量进行标注；(3)在微调过程中通过残差减法抑制已验证的伪影潜在变量；(4)提供事后逐概念归因用于模型决策审计。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV出院笔记死亡预测任务上，CAST优于相应的微调编码器基线，与强LLM基线表现相当，并生成了特征级审计轨迹，展示支撑每个预测的临床概念及训练中抑制的伪影概念。

Conclusion: CAST通过概念引导的伪影抑制实现了对临床文本分类中分布偏移的鲁棒性提升，同时以可审计的特征级归因增强了模型决策的透明性和可信度，证明SAE结合LLM标注是可解释临床NLP的有效范式。

Abstract: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretation pipeline and ICD-10 retrieval constraints, suppresses verified artifact latents via residual subtraction during fine-tuning, and provides post-hoc per-concept attributions for auditing model decisions. On MIMIC-IV discharge-note mortality prediction, CAST improves over its corresponding fine-tuned encoder baselines and remains competitive with strong LLM baselines, while producing a feature-level audit trail of the clinical concepts that support each prediction and the artifact concepts suppressed during training.

</details>


### [206] [How Language Models Organize and Structure Moral Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27402)
*Orion Reblitz-Richardson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过六个独立的线性探针（每个对应道德基础理论的一个类别）研究大语言模型如何组织道德知识，发现道德方向的表征既不坍缩为单一检测器也不彼此隔离，而是跨越近最大维度的独立维度同时共享一个道德特异的正公共分量，且该几何结构在预训练早期即达到整合状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅表明LLM能检测道德内容，但检测是低门槛任务。作者追问模型是否更进一步：能否区分不同的道德基础（MFT的六个类别），并在表征空间中几何性地组织它们之间的关系。这关乎模型内部道德知识的组织方式这一更深层问题。

Method: 在开源权重的语言模型上训练六个独立的线性探针，每个对应MFT的一个类别（care/harm, fair/cheat, lib/oppress, loy/betray, auth/subv, sanc/degrade），然后分析这些探针方向在表征空间中的相互关系。通过比较平均成对余弦相似度（道德方向0.26 vs 非道德对照0.013）检验道德特异性；通过对比个体化/约束性（individualizing/binding）的理论划分来检验MFT预测；通过道德困境的方向组合分析检验组成性。

Result: 道德方向不坍缩也不隔离，而是跨越近最大维度数同时共享正公共分量；该公共分量是道德特异的（平均成对余弦0.26 vs 非道德0.013）；几何结构跨架构和规模一致且在预训练早期即达到整合状态；结构不符合作者预测的individualizing/binding区分（但该检验功效低）而反映语料统计；道德困境方向以2.7倍于错配基线的程度从其组成基础部分组合而来，但大部分方差编码冲突特定的结构。

Conclusion: LLM在表征空间中组织道德知识的方式是"整合而非坍缩"——六个道德基础方向共享一个道德特异的公共分量同时保持独立维度。模型表征的是道德张力的结构本身（冲突特定信息），而非预先解决的道德判断，且这种组织方式遵循语料统计规律而非MFT理论的范畴划分。

Abstract: How do large language models (LLMs) organize moral knowledge? Models detect moral content broadly, but detection is a low bar. We ask whether they go further, distinguishing moral foundations from one another and organizing the relationships between them geometrically.
  We train six independent linear probes on open-weight language models, one per Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) category (care/harm, fair/cheat, lib/oppress, loy/betray, auth/subv, sanc/degrade), and examine how the resulting directions relate to each other in representation space. We find the directions neither collapse into a single moral detector nor isolate from one another. Rather, they span a near-maximal number of independent dimensions while sharing a positive common component. The shared component is the signature of integration, and it is moral-specific relative to a matched non-moral concept battery built identically (mean pairwise cosine 0.26 vs. 0.013).
  The geometry is consistent across architectures and scale and reaches its integration regime early in pre-training, well before probe accuracy saturates. The structure the model discovers shows no evidence of the individualizing/binding distinction predicted by Moral Foundations Theory (an underpowered test: only 20 candidate partitions exist) but rather reflects corpus statistics. Extending to moral dilemmas, each dilemma direction partially composes from its component foundations, at 2.7x a mismatched-pair baseline, while the majority of its variance encodes conflict-specific structure. The model represents moral tension itself, not a pre-resolved judgment.

</details>


### [207] [Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27409)
*Siye Wu,Kai Yang,Yuchen Cai,Xin Xu,Peng-Yuan Wang,Jiaxuan Wang,Jiashun Liu,Jiafei Lyu,Yangkun Chen,Saiyong Yang,Yanghua Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种将多领域RLVR专家融合为统一模型的方法：Merge（合并任务向量）、Mix RL（混合数据集训练）和多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD，同时利用两者）。实验表明三者平均性能差异不超过1.4分，但单个benchmark上差距可达8.6分；训练动力学上各有约束：Mix RL依赖领域比例、MOPD受教师上限约束、Merge压缩所有更新。最终提出实际选择准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增强学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）虽能提升大语言模型的特定能力，但覆盖多个能力通常需要分别训练领域专家再整合。三种融合范式（Merge、Mix RL、MOPD）此前大多被孤立研究，缺乏系统性比较，导致如何选择它们不明确。

Method: 使用共享的专家模型和数据，在多个模型尺度上和多领域benchmark套件上，对三种融合范式（Merge合并任务向量、Mix RL混合数据集、MOPD多教师on-policy蒸馏）进行统一对比，并分析其训练动力学、任务向量几何与实际约束。

Result: 三者平均性能差异不超过1.4个点，但单一benchmark上差距可达8.6个点；领域级差异与任务向量几何中可见的跨领域关系一致。三种方法均提升单样本准确率，但未带来解空间覆盖的可测提升，也未损失保留能力。训练动力学揭示各自不同的约束条件。

Conclusion: 提供了一个实用选择指南：已有专家且追求低成本融合时用Merge；无专家时训练统一模型用Mix RL（需按跨领域迁移调整领域比例）；当保留领域特定增益比超越教师或最小化端到端成本更重要时用MOPD。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to choose among them remain unclear. We compare all three using shared experts and data across model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite. Although their average performance differs by at most 1.4 points, the gap reaches 8.6 points on a single benchmark, with domain-level variation tracking cross-domain relations visible in task-vector geometry. Training dynamics expose distinct constraints: Mix RL depends on domain mixture proportions, MOPD remains bounded by its teachers, and Merge compresses all expert updates into one. All three improve single-sample accuracy without measurable gains in solution coverage or losses in held-out capabilities. These results yield a practical guideline: use Merge when experts already exist and cheap fusion is paramount; Mix RL when training a unified model without experts, with domain proportions adjusted for cross-domain transfer; and MOPD when preserving domain-specific gains matters more than surpassing teachers or minimizing end-to-end cost.

</details>


### [208] [Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27420)
*Xingyu Shen,Huishuai Zhang,Peng Li,Yinchun Wang,Dongyan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过引入小模型生成的部分推理轨迹作为外部前缀（outer prefixes）来保持LLM在RLVR训练中生成多样性的方法，有效缓解熵坍缩问题，扩大推理覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR显著提升LLM推理能力，但会导致策略熵下降，使得推理覆盖范围收窄，大k下pass@k性能退化。现有方法主要通过算法正则化缓解熵坍缩，但忽略了跨模型非参数化扰动这一维度。

Method: 利用一个更小、更弱的语言模型生成部分推理轨迹作为前缀，强制目标模型基于这些不熟悉的前缀继续生成答案。通过引入外部前缀打乱目标模型的过度自信，鼓励其探索不同的推理路径。同时实证研究外部前缀对RLVR训练中探索动态的影响机制，特别是分布差异的作用。

Result: 在多个数学基准上的实验表明，该方法始终优于vanilla RLVR。随着k增大，性能增益愈发显著，表明推理覆盖率得到实质性扩展。此外，该方法有效缓解熵坍缩，且无需额外的SFT、复杂的奖励设计或提示工程。

Conclusion: 跨模型的非参数化扰动是一种简单有效的缓解RLVR熵坍缩的手段，通过外部前缀注入分布差异能够显著扩展推理覆盖范围，为大k下的推理性能提供保障。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly improves LLM reasoning but often causes a drop in policy entropy, leading to narrowed reasoning coverage and degraded pass@$k$ for large $k$. While existing methods mitigate this entropy collapse through algorithmic regularizations, cross-model non-parametric perturbation is also neglected. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective approach to preserve the generative diversity of LLMs during RLVR. Instead of relying solely on internal exploration, we force the target model to generate answers based on partial reasoning trajectories generated by a smaller, weaker language models. These unfamiliar prefixes effectively disrupt over-confidence and encourage the exploration of distinct reasoning paths. We empirically study the potential of outer prefixes, revealing the mechanism of the impact of distributional discrepancy to the exploration dynamics in RLVR training. Experiments across multiple mathematical benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms vanilla RLVR. Notably, the performance gain becomes increasingly pronounced as $k$ scales up, demonstrating a substantial expansion of reasoning coverage. Furthermore, our approach efficiently mitigates entropy collapse without requiring additional SFT, intricate reward designs, or complex prompting.

</details>


### [209] [Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27428)
*Vésteinn Snæbjarnarson,Samuel Kiegeland,Manuel de Prada Corral,Ryan Cotterell,Tim Vieira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于无放回重采样的束求和（beam summing）算法，用于估计转导语言模型（TLM）的目标前缀概率，提供无偏估计并可通过递归修正来计算阈值剪枝丢失的质量，在文本和DNA任务上相比先前工作（阈值剪枝束求和和序贯蒙特卡洛）实现更好的计算-方差权衡、更低的误差以及数量级的运行时间缩减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转导语言模型（TLM）由预训练源语言模型与有限状态转导器组合而成。计算目标前缀概率需要对所有映射到该前缀的源字符串的源模型概率求和，该集合可能指数级大甚至无限大。先前工作使用阈值剪枝的束求和进行近似，但只能得到误差未知的下界。

Method: 提出不使用简单的阈值剪枝近似，而是从源前缀中无放回地重采样，并通过对每个选中的前缀按其包含概率的倒数进行加权来矫正偏差。该矫正递归应用可得到目标前缀概率的无偏估计，并可用于估计阈值剪枝丢失的分布质量。束求和算法扩展保留的源前缀同时采样保留哪些前缀，随着已加入运行的估计质量增加而减少保留前缀的数量，保证以概率1停机。

Result: 在百科文本和DNA数据上评测，相比使用有放回重采样的序贯蒙特卡洛基线，该方法在文本上获得更好的计算-方差权衡，在DNA上相同最大粒子数下误差更低。在DNA到氨基酸的转导任务上，相比阈值剪枝束求和，运行时间减少数个数量级，并使长目标字符串的前缀概率估计变得可行。在已发表的阅读时间分析中将阈值剪枝替换为无偏采样后，语料库意外度估计显著降低，但已发表的结论保持不变。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无偏、可终止且计算高效的TLM前缀概率估计方案，在计算效率和估计质量上均优于现有方法，同时改进了下游应用的统计性质而不改变既有结论。

Abstract: Transduced language models (TLMs) compose a pretrained \emph{source} language model with a functional finite-state transducer to induce a language model over \emph{target} strings. Computing the probability of a target prefix under a TLM amounts to summing the source-model probabilities of all source strings that the transducer maps to target strings beginning with that prefix. This set can be exponentially large or infinite. Prior work uses a computational shortcut based on source prefix probabilities, then approximates the resulting sum with threshold-pruned beam summing. This produces a lower bound with unknown error. Instead, we resample source prefixes without replacement and reweight each selected prefix by the inverse of its inclusion probability. We show that applying this correction recursively gives an unbiased estimator of the target prefix probability and lets us estimate the mass lost by threshold pruning. Our beam-summing algorithm extends the retained source prefixes and samples which prefixes to keep, reducing their number as more probability mass is added to the running estimate. This can save computation and guarantees that the run halts with probability one. We evaluate the method on encyclopedic text and DNA against sequential Monte Carlo baselines that resample with replacement. It achieves a better compute--variance tradeoff on text and lower error at the same maximum number of particles on DNA. On a DNA-to-amino-acid transduction, it reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude relative to threshold-pruned beam summing and makes estimating prefix probabilities for long target strings feasible. Replacing threshold pruning with unbiased sampling in a published reading-time analysis substantially lowers the estimated corpus surprisal but leaves the published conclusions unchanged.

</details>


### [210] [TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27448)
*Aozhe Wang,Zhengxi Lu,Jianze Wang,Shangke Lv,Ying Liu,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Hua Yang,Qianglong Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出测试时策略优化（TTPO），一种无需标签的测试时训练方法，通过非对称目标分别处理与多数投票伪标签一致和不一致的rollout，在五个竞赛级基准上达到与标签监督OPSD相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流后训练方法（如RL和OPSD）依赖真实标签，无法用于测试时训练（TTT）。用多数投票伪标签替代真实标签虽然自然，但存在脆弱性问题：一个错误的投票会污染教师模型并误导所有token。

Method: 提出TTPO框架，核心是：(1) 非对称目标：对与伪标签一致的rollout用OPSD蒸馏，对不一致的rollout用分组RL（Grouped RL）惩罚；(2) token级选择：蒸馏时降低已收敛位置的权重，RL只惩罚高置信度错误；(3) 多数投票路由：随着模型改进，获得更紧致的自监督信号。其动机来自观察——与伪标签不一致的rollout无论投票正确与否通常都是错的。

Result: 无需任何标签，TTPO在五个竞赛级基准上匹配标签监督的OPSD；在TTT设置下将Qwen3-1.7B从38.0%提升到45.2%；无思考模式下获得+25.2%到+36.4%的提升；并展现出强跨任务泛化能力。

Conclusion: TTPO通过利用错误的不对称性（与伪标签不一致的rollout总是可疑的），在不依赖标签的情况下实现了与标签监督方法相当的测试时训练性能，证明了伪标签驱动的方法在无监督后训练中的有效性。

Abstract: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.

</details>


### [211] [CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27455)
*Yufan Wu,Yinghui He,Zhengyi Hu,Lang Wei,Ruichen Li,Qifan Yang,Ting Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CritICL是一个新颖的推理时框架，利用弱模型的结构化失败模式作为批评性上下文示例来提升LLM推理性能，相比测试时扩展方法显著降低生成次数和token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法（如重复生成或外部验证）虽然能提升LLM推理性能，但通常计算开销大、效率低。作者观察到同族不同规模LLM的失败模式存在结构化规律，于是提出利用这些失败模式作为引导信号，而非将其视为无用输出。

Method: CritICL包含两个变体：（1）CritICL-dynamic，自适应预测输入特异的失败模式并检索对应批评；（2）CritICL-static，使用全局失败模式画像提供稳定的引导。两者均将弱模型导出的失败模式通过批评式上下文示例融入推理过程。

Result: 实验表明CritICL一致优于标准上下文学习，在性能上与测试时扩展方法相当甚至更优，同时所需的生成次数和token成本显著更少。

Conclusion: CritICL验证了"失败模式可作为有效引导信号"这一洞见，提供了一种高效替代测试时扩展的推理增强方案，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。

Abstract: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL

</details>

### [212] [Multimodal risk trajectories reveal heterogeneous paths to dementia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26210)
*Zhiqi Lee,Haowen Li,Tao Liu,Shiyuan Zhang,Bingjie Wang,Jinzhao Fan,Yunkai Zhang,Zhuonan Wang,Lijun Bai*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: NetMoint是一个多模态框架，整合部分观测的血浆蛋白质组、结构MRI和脑血流动力学表型，可在1、5、10、20年时间范围内预测阿尔茨海默病（AD）、血管性痴呆（VD）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的个体化风险。在104,120名英国生物银行参与者中，平均AUC分别达到0.937、0.930和0.932，并识别出亚型特异性的高风险轨迹及相应分子标志物（如FTD中NDRG1升高、AD中TGFB1降低）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 痴呆症在生物学上具有异质性，但现有风险评估方法无法揭示亚型特异性风险在临床诊断前如何产生和分化，需要一种能够区分痴呆亚型并进行多时间尺度风险预测的框架。

Method: 开发NetMoint多模态框架，整合部分观测的血浆蛋白质组学、结构MRI和脑血流动力学数据，针对AD、VD和FTD在1、5、10、20年四个时间范围内进行个体化风险预测，并通过多时间范围风险描绘识别不同亚型的风险轨迹和分子特征。

Result: 在104,120名参与者中，AD、VD和FTD的平均AUC分别为0.937、0.930和0.932。预测的生物学决定因素随预测时间而变化：短期以结构性脑脆弱性为主，长期转向循环分子特征。识别出AD中0.7%持续极高风险轨迹（20年风险53.50%，TGFB1较低）和FTD中8.3%递增极高风险轨迹（67.17%，NDRG1较高）。在独立ADNI-to-UK Biobank验证中，AD风险预测在138个共享特征对齐后20年AUC为0.741。

Conclusion: NetMoint建立了轨迹分辨的痴呆风险分层多模态框架，能够在痴呆亚型内识别小型但高风险的人群，并将不同的风险轨迹与独特的分子特征联系起来，为亚型特异性的早期干预和精准预防提供了基础。

Abstract: Dementia comprises biologically heterogeneous disorders, yet current risk assessment provides limited insight into how subtype-specific risk emerges and diverges before clinical diagnosis. We developed NetMoint, a multimodal framework integrating partially observed plasma proteomic, structural magnetic resonance imaging and cerebral haemodynamic phenotypes to predict individualized risks of Alzheimer's disease (AD), vascular dementia (VD) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) across 1-, 5-, 10- and 20-year horizons. Among 104,120 UK Biobank participants free of dementia at baseline, NetMoint achieved mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.937, 0.930 and 0.932 for AD, VD and FTD, respectively. The biological determinants of prediction shifted with time, from structural brain vulnerability at shorter horizons towards circulating molecular signatures at longer horizons, with distinct subtype-specific biological profiles. Multi-horizon risk profiling identified distinct temporal trajectories of dementia susceptibility. Among participants who subsequently developed AD, 0.7% followed a persistently very-high-risk trajectory, with predicted risk reaching 53.50% at 20 years, whereas 8.3% of those who developed FTD followed an increasing very-high-risk trajectory, reaching 67.17%. These high-risk trajectories were marked by distinct molecular signatures, with lower TGFB1 characterizing the AD group and higher NDRG1 the FTD group. In an independent ADNI-to-UK Biobank analysis, AD risk prediction remained informative after harmonization to 138 shared features, with an AUC of 0.741 at 20 years. Together, these findings establish a multimodal framework for trajectory-resolved dementia risk stratification, identifying small but high-risk populations within dementia subtypes and linking their divergent risk trajectories to distinct molecular signatures.

</details>


### [213] [PathoMIC: A Benchmark for Cross-Species Antimicrobial Peptide Activity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26228)
*Yeqing Lu,Xiaoyan Zhao,Fuli Feng*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出PathoMIC，一个包含74,751个MIC实验测量值和424个病原物种的最大统一数据集，用于定量预测抗菌肽的最小抑菌浓度。该数据集整合了肽序列、标准化MIC值、病原描述和分类学关系，并建立了少样本和零样本跨物种评估协议。基于知识增强框架，该方法在低资源物种上取得显著改进，但对完全未见物种的预测仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抗菌肽MIC预测器主要基于少数代表性病原菌训练，很少利用跨物种的生物学关系，导致对低资源及未见病原菌的泛化能力受限，难以在实验验证前有效筛选候选抗菌肽。

Method: 构建PathoMIC数据库，整合肽序列、标准化MIC值、病原描述和分类学关系；提出基于知识增强的预测框架，利用病原描述和分类学信息促进相关物种间的知识迁移；建立少样本与零样本跨物种评估协议。

Result: 该框架在监督数据有限的低资源物种上取得显著改进，但完全未见物种的预测性能提升有限，揭示了零样本跨物种MIC预测的固有难度。

Conclusion: PathoMIC为跨物种活性建模和病原特异性虚拟筛选提供了标准化基础，同时指出完全未见病原菌的零样本MIC预测仍是开放难题。

Abstract: With activity against multidrug-resistant pathogens and mechanisms distinct from conventional antibiotics, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) offer a promising approach to combating antibiotic-resistant infections. However, their potency varies substantially across pathogen species, making accurate prediction of the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) for specific peptide-pathogen pairs essential for prioritizing candidates before costly experimental validation. Existing predictors are trained mainly on a few well-represented pathogens and rarely exploit biological relationships across species, limiting their generalization to low-resource and unseen pathogens. We introduce PathoMIC, the largest and most pathogen-diverse unified dataset for quantitative antimicrobial peptide activity prediction, containing 74,751 experimentally reported MIC measurements across 424 pathogen species. PathoMIC integrates peptide sequences, standardized MIC values, pathogen descriptions, and taxonomic relationships to facilitate knowledge transfer across related species. We establish few-shot and zero-shot cross-species evaluation protocols and develop a knowledge-enhanced framework that leverages pathogen descriptions and taxonomy. The framework yields substantial improvements for low-resource species with limited supervision, while gains for entirely unseen species remain modest, highlighting the difficulty of zero-shot cross-species MIC prediction. PathoMIC provides a standardized foundation for cross-species activity modeling and pathogen-specific virtual screening. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PathoMIC-546D/.

</details>


### [214] [Interpreting Latent Protein Language Model Features with Geometric Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26419)
*Siddharth Setlur,Djordje Mihajlovic,Darrick Lee*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种自动化、可扩展的方法，通过蛋白质Cα主链的几何特征来解读ESM-2蛋白语言模型中SAE（稀疏自编码器）特征的局部残基级语义，填补了传统基于数据库标签和LLM注释方法在捕捉局部几何模式上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白语言模型（pLM）的内部表征难以理解；稀疏自编码器（SAE）虽可用于解耦潜在表征，但现有注释管线主要依赖数据库标签和LLM对top激活序列的注释，无法捕捉SAE特征所编码的残基级局部和几何模式。

Method: 利用蛋白质Cα主链的几何启发特征（如角度、距离、扭转等），在ESM-2 8M模型的各层上对SAE特征进行自动化注释；采用FDR控制的分析流程检验局部几何与SAE特征的统计关联；通过消融实验（在接触预测层面删除几何特征）验证特征的因果影响。

Result: 发现大量SAE特征与局部几何显著关联，预测强度各异，覆盖范围超过数据库和序列方法；几何可区分共享相同数据库注释的不同SAE特征，揭示已知生物学标签下的亚结构；部分SAE特征激活于未注释的宏基因组蛋白序列，可用SAE注释帮助理解这些序列；消融实验显示移除几何特征后接触图预测向描述符方向偏移。

Conclusion: 该方法为SAE神经元激活的蛋白质提供残基级稳健注释框架，在机制可解释性与结构生物学之间建立了桥梁。

Abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) encode information about protein sequences which enable downstream tasks such as structure prediction, but their internal representations are not well understood. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising tool to disentangle latent pLM representations into interpretable features, but existing annotation pipelines largely rely on protein-level annotations derived from database labels and LLM annotations of top activating sequences. Such annotations can overlook the localized residue-level and geometric patterns encoded by sparse features. We introduce an automated and scalable method for interpreting SAE features in ESM-2 by using geometrically inspired features of the protein $\text{C}_α$ backbone. Across ESM-2 8M layers, an FDR-controlled discovery analysis shows that local geometry is significantly associated with many SAE features, with varying levels of predictive strength, expanding coverage beyond database and sequence-based methods. In particular, geometry can distinguish SAE features sharing the same database annotation, revealing substructure within known biological labels. A significant portion of SAE features activate on unannotated metagenomic protein sequences enabling us to use our SAE annotations to better understand these sequences. In addition, ablation experiments at the level of contact prediction show that removing found geometric features shifts ESM-2's predicted contact maps in the direction of the descriptor. This provides a robust method of annotating proteins activated within SAE neurons at a residue level, providing a bridge between mechanistic interpretability and structural biology.

</details>


### [215] [RegimeFormer: A Large Protein Model of Global Perturbation Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26586)
*Siyuan Ma,Yi Chai,Yi Wu,Qixin Zhang,Yajing Yuan,Kanglu Zhao,Zhikang Chen,Haowei Wang,Shuying Cao,Xiaolei Yu,Xiangfei Han,Yun Liu,Yang Liu,Tingting Zhu,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出RegimeFormer（大规模蛋白质扰动模型）和RegimeAtlas（扰动图谱），通过对202,556,313条非冗余蛋白质序列的整合与索引，构建了一个覆盖全球序列空间的蛋白质扰动响应预测框架，能识别可复现的蛋白质水平扰动模式（regime），提升突变特异性预测精度，并改善下游转录组和药物响应建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型虽然能在大规模水平上组织序列和结构信息，但缺乏一种全局性的表征来描述蛋白质对突变的响应，因此需要构建一个可扩展的框架来映射、预测和查询全球序列空间中的蛋白质扰动景观。

Method: 该方法包含两个核心组件：RegimeFormer（大规模蛋白质扰动模型）和RegimeAtlas（扰动图谱）。具体实现为：(1) 整合索引202,556,313条跨生命之树的非冗余蛋白质序列；(2) 构建一个保留多样性的一百万蛋白质子集作为高分辨率训练和推理层，其中995,995个蛋白质产生跨407,048,356个残基的残基级摘要；(3) 按需提供替换特异性预测；(4) 通过实验深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信度和进化约束进行验证。

Result: RegimeFormer能够识别可复现的蛋白质水平扰动模式，组织残基脆弱性、适应性和预测不确定性。Regime条件化显著提升了替换特异性预测，在未见蛋白质、未见家族和低同源性评估下获得最大相对增益。RegimeFormer衍生的分子先验进一步改善了下游转录组和药物响应建模。

Conclusion: RegimeFormer与RegimeAtlas共同提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于在全球序列空间中映射、预测和查询蛋白质扰动景观，弥补了蛋白质语言模型在突变响应全局表征方面的空白。

Abstract: Protein language models organize sequence and structure at scale, but a global representation of how proteins respond to mutation remains lacking. We present RegimeFormer, a large protein perturbation model coupled to RegimeAtlas, constructed by harmonizing and indexing 202,556,313 non-redundant protein sequences across the tree of life. A diversity-preserving one-million-protein subset provides the high-resolution training and inference layer, with 995,995 proteins yielding residue-level summaries across 407,048,356 residues and substitution-specific predictions available on demand. Across experimental deep mutational scanning, molecular benchmarks, structural confidence and evolutionary constraint, RegimeFormer identifies reproducible protein-level perturbation regimes that organize residue fragility, adaptability and predictive uncertainty. Regime conditioning improves substitution-specific prediction, with the largest relative gains under unseen-protein, unseen-family and low-homology evaluation. RegimeFormer-derived molecular priors further improve downstream transcriptomic and drug-response modelling. Together, RegimeFormer and RegimeAtlas provide a scalable framework for mapping, predicting and querying protein perturbation landscapes across global sequence space.

</details>


### [216] [DINIRS: Digital Twin for Individualized Treatment Effects of Non-Invasive Respiratory Support Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26915)
*Md Fantacher Islam,Jarrod Mosier,Vignesh Subbian*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本研究提出并验证了一个名为DINIRS的删失感知数字孪生框架，用于估计急性呼吸衰竭患者接受无创呼吸支持(NIRS)相较于有创机械通气(IMV)的个体化治疗效果(ITE)，涵盖死亡率和通气时长两个维度。基于MIMIC-IV的5,336名患者训练、eICU-CRD的2,540名患者进行外部验证，结果显示DINIRS策略可为每位患者平均多获得2.07个无呼吸机天数，且NIRS获益主要源于幸存者通气时间缩短而非死亡率降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管临床试验和指南提供了群体层面的建议，但急性呼吸衰竭患者在选择NIRS与IMV时存在显著的个体异质性治疗效果，临床上缺乏能够识别哪些患者更受益于NIRS的工具。现有方法未能同时考虑删失数据并分解死亡率和通气时长两个结局维度，因此亟需一个能够估计个体化治疗效果的框架。

Method: 使用MIMIC-IV中5,336名急性呼吸衰竭患者ICU前24小时内的23项基线临床变量进行训练；采用带生存注意力门的Transformer编码器将28天无呼吸机天数(VFD-28)分解为生存概率和条件通气时长；使用交叉拟合的双鲁棒学习器估计个体化治疗效果(ITE)；在eICU-CRD数据集的2,540名患者上进行外部验证。

Result: DINIRS策略相比观察到的临床实践，每位患者平均多获得2.07个无呼吸机天数（每100名患者共207天）。NIRS获益在器官功能障碍较轻的患者中更高（88.4%对比49.0%），且在不同低氧血症严重程度中均存在。外部验证无需重新训练即可复现该模式。

Conclusion: 研究证实了利用ICU数据实现NIRS获益的个体化估计是可行的，NIRS的获益机制主要源于避免气管插管相关并发症而缩短幸存者通气时间而非降低死亡率。在将这些估计用于指导治疗决策之前，仍需前瞻性验证。

Abstract: Objective: Choosing between noninvasive respiratory support (NIRS) and invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) for patients with acute respiratory failure is a complex, time-sensitive decision with heterogeneous treatment effects across patient subgroups. Although clinical trials and guidelines provide population-level guidance, it remains unclear which patients benefit more from NIRS than IMV. We developed and validated a censoring-aware Digital Twin framework for Individualized Treatment Effects of Non-Invasive Respiratory Support (DINIRS) to estimate individualized treatment effects (ITEs) that capture mortality and ventilation duration.
  Materials and Methods: We trained DINIRS on 23 baseline clinical variables from the first 24 ICU hours in 5,336 MIMIC-IV patients with acute respiratory failure. We used a transformer encoder with a survival attention gate to decompose 28-day ventilator-free days (VFD-28) into survival probability and conditional ventilation duration. A cross-fitted, doubly robust learner estimated ITEs. We externally validated DINIRS in 2,540 patients from the multi-site eICU-CRD dataset.
  Results: The DINIRS policy achieved a mean benefit of 2.07 ventilator-free days per patient (207 per 100 patients) compared with the observed practice. Predicted NIRS benefit was higher among patients with less organ dysfunction (88.4% versus 49.0%) and persisted across hypoxemia severity. External validation reproduced this pattern without retraining.
  Discussion: Our analysis revealed that the NIRS benefit stemmed from shorter ventilation among survivors rather than from reduced mortality, indicating that avoiding intubation-associated complications was the primary mechanism.
  Conclusion: This study demonstrated individualized estimation of NIRS benefit using ICU data, though prospective validation is needed before these estimates inform treatment decisions.

</details>


### [217] [Surf_2_Volume: a workflow for converting CIFTI parcellations to NIfTI volume space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27012)
*Shuguang Yang,Ziyi Wang,Yujing Shen,Junyi Li,Yujing Nie,Feizhen Cao,Suiping Wang*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出Surf_2_Volume工作流，用于将CIFTI格式的皮层和皮层下脑区划分转化为NIfTI体积格式，其性能显著优于现有Connectome Workbench的转换设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIFTI格式的脑区划分无法直接在需要体积输入的许多分析程序中使用，现有转换选项可能遗漏皮层灰质体素或错误地将标签分配到灰质之外，亟需一种更精确的转换方法。

Method: 该工作流结合Connectome Workbench、FreeSurfer、AFNI、neuromaps及Python图像处理工具，分离皮层和皮层下组件，通过fsaverage与目标MNI152模板的曲面表示传递皮层标签，使用可调节的灰质概率阈值限制体素分配，最终重组各组件。

Result: 在Cole-Anticevic脑宽网络分区测试中，Surf_2_Volume的调整后Dice分数为0.776，而评估的最佳Connectome Workbench设置为0.637；在Schaefer 2018 17网络体积图谱测试中，Surf_2_Volume得分0.727，Workbench最佳设置为0.535。两种测试中Surf_2_Volume均优于Workbench。

Conclusion: Surf_2_Volume工作流提供了一种在需要NIfTI输入的软件中使用表面脑区划分的方法，同时允许对灰质覆盖范围进行显式控制。

Abstract: Parcellations distributed in Connectivity Informatics Technology Initiative (CIFTI) format cannot be used directly in many analysis programs that require volume input. Existing conversion options may leave voxels in cortical gray matter unlabeled or assign labels outside gray matter, depending on the mapping parameters. We present Surf_2_Volume, a workflow that combines Connectome Workbench, FreeSurfer, AFNI, neuromaps, and Python image processing to convert cortical and subcortical CIFTI parcellations into Neuroimaging Informatics Technology Initiative (NIfTI) volumes. The workflow separates cortical and subcortical components, transfers cortical labels through fsaverage and a surface representation of the target MNI152 template, restricts voxel assignment using an adjustable probability threshold for gray matter, and recombines the components. Using the Cole-Anticevic Brain-wide Network Partition, Surf_2_Volume had an adjusted Dice score of 0.776, compared with a maximum of 0.637 among the evaluated Connectome Workbench settings. In a separate test using the Schaefer 2018 17-network volume atlas, the scores were 0.727 for Surf_2_Volume and 0.535 for the best Workbench setting. Across both atlas evaluations, Surf_2_Volume had higher adjusted Dice scores than the evaluated Workbench settings. The workflow provides a way to use surface parcellations in software that requires NIfTI input while allowing explicit control over gray matter coverage.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

### [218] [SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing for Labeled Property Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26132)
*Michal Podstawski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing架构，将小型语言模型集成到图神经网络的图消息选择中。该架构利用拓扑GNN提供稳定的结构锚定表示，并通过SLM生成目标条件化路由查询，先在关系类型内部选择相关消息，再跨关系级别汇聚信息，最终以有界残差方式更新拓扑表示，实现了结构证据与语言语义的有效融合及可解释分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图神经网络将节点和关系上的异构文本与分类属性编码为静态特征向量，无法根据具体预测目标动态判断哪些语义证据应影响消息传播，限制了模型对语义信息的选择性利用能力。

Method: 架构包含三部分：1) 拓扑GNN作为结构表示与预测锚点；2) 每个目标节点的关联消息融合邻居结构状态、节点属性编码、关系属性编码和关系类型；3) 参数高效的SLM处理结构化图软令牌，生成目标条件化路由查询，先在关系类型内部选择消息，再跨关系级摘要路由信息。最终表示以有界残差更新拓扑锚点。

Result: 该方法支持在邻居级别和关系类型级别进行可解释分析，并通过有界残差更新在保留结构证据的同时允许上下文语义信息调整预测，为属性丰富的图学习提供了语言语义融合的通用机制。

Conclusion: SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing提供了一种将语言模型语义能力嵌入图消息选择的新范式，在保持拓扑结构稳定性的同时实现目标条件化的语义路由，兼具可解释性和通用性。

Abstract: Labeled property graphs combine relational structure with heterogeneous textual and categorical properties attached to both nodes and relationships. Conventional graph neural networks typically represent these properties as static feature vectors, limiting their ability to determine which semantic evidence should influence message propagation for a particular prediction target. We propose SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing, an architecture that integrates a small language model directly into graph message selection. A topology GNN provides a stable structural representation and prediction anchor. For each target node, incident messages combine the neighbor's structural state, node-property encoding, relationship-property encoding, and relationship type. A parameter-efficient SLM processes structured graph soft tokens and produces a target-conditioned routing query. This query first selects relevant messages within each relationship type and subsequently routes information across relation-level summaries. The resulting representation provides a bounded residual update to the topology anchor, preserving structural evidence while allowing contextual semantic information to modify the prediction. The architecture supports interpretable analysis at both the neighbor and relationship-type levels and provides a general mechanism for integrating language-derived semantics into property-rich graph learning.

</details>


### [219] [NeuronFuzz: Safety Neuron Guided Fuzzing for LLM Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26222)
*Zhiyuan Xu,Muhammad Firhard Roslan,Joseph Gardiner,Sana Belguith,Lichao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuronFuzz是一个白盒模糊测试框架，利用LLM内部安全神经元的激活作为连续执行反馈进行安全评估，可消除目标模型响应生成的开销，在21个文本和多模态模型上实现了76-100%的越狱发现率，并在黑盒目标模型上实现了显著的零样本迁移攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化LLM安全测试方法依赖响应级反馈，即每个候选提示需要生成目标模型的完整响应来评估攻击效果，这在强对齐模型上成本高昂且反馈稀疏（大多数候选被拒绝且结果相同），缺乏细粒度的指导信号。

Method: NeuronFuzz通过三个关键设计实现：(1) SafetyOracle——将模板不变的恶意/良性输入和稳定性感知选择相结合，识别紧凑的安全神经元集合，将其激活转化为连续的"安全报警分数"，该分数可在预填充阶段获取，从而将响应生成排除在模糊测试循环之外；(2) 利用安全报警分数的可微性，通过梯度识别对安全敏感的模板位置；(3) 使用掩码语言模型生成流畅且上下文兼容的突变，同时保留原始恶意载荷并避免额外优化变量。

Result: 在5个白盒源模型上实现76-100%的越狱发现率，比基线高出最多48个百分点；优化后的模板零样本迁移到开放权重模型和6个专有目标模型，平均ASR和top-5集成ASR(EASR)分别达到69.6%/92.6%和44.1%/60.0%。

Conclusion: NeuronFuzz证明了利用内部安全神经元作为连续模糊测试反馈的有效性，通过消除响应生成依赖显著提高安全评估效率，同时生成的高质量模板具有良好的跨模型迁移能力，为LLM安全评估提供了一种新的白盒测试范式。

Abstract: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcome.
  This paper presents NeuronFuzz, a white-box fuzzing framework that exploits internal safety neurons as continuous execution feedback for LLM safety evaluation. A SafetyOracle converts safety-neuron activations into a continuous safety alarm score that serves as feedback for fuzzing and can be obtained during prefill, eliminating response generation from the fuzzing loop. To construct the SafetyOracle, NeuronFuzz uses template-invariant harmful and benign inputs and stability-aware selection to identify a compact set of safety neurons whose activations capture harmful-intent recognition. Moreover, since the safety alarm score is differentiable, NeuronFuzz uses its gradients to identify safety-sensitive template positions and a masked language model to generate fluent, context-compatible mutations while preserving original harmful payload and avoiding additional optimization variables. We evaluate NeuronFuzz across 21 text and multimodal models. Across five white-box source models, it achieves a 76-100% jailbreak discovery rate, outperforming baselines by up to 48 percentage points. Its optimized templates further transfer zero-shot to open-weight and six proprietary target models, achieving average ASR and top-5 ensemble ASR (EASR) of 69.6%/92.6% and 44.1%/60.0%, respectively.

</details>


### [220] [Pruning Binarized Neural Networks: A Dedicated Framework and Globally Weighted Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26233)
*Roan Rubiales,Jean Pierre David*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于PyTorch的研究型框架，用于设计和优化二值化神经网络，并提出了一种跨抽象层次考虑参数相对重要性的新型剪枝方法。该方法在VGG11上实现了70%的剪枝率且精度不变，远优于现有最先进的41%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的极端压缩（直至完全二值化）能大幅降低内存占用和算术复杂度，便于在FPGA和微控制器等边缘硬件上部署。虽然二值化与剪枝结合有望带来额外效率提升，但现有剪枝策略不适用于二值化表示，且很少能转化为有意义的硬件收益。

Method: 提出了一个基于PyTorch的研究型框架，包含冻结（freezing）和剪枝（pruning）机制，用于设计和优化二值化神经网络。在此基础上，提出一种新的剪枝方法，该方法考虑学习参数在不同抽象层次上的相对重要性，通过全局加权机制来指导剪枝决策。

Result: 所提出的全局加权剪枝机制在模型精度与剪枝率之间取得了更优的权衡：在VGG11上实现了70%的剪枝率且保持精度不变，而二值化设定下的最先进方法仅达到41%的剪枝率。

Conclusion: 该框架支持对最先进方法的快速可复现评估以及新方法的快速原型开发，所提出的全局加权剪枝方法在二值化神经网络中显著优于现有剪枝策略，为边缘部署提供了更高效的模型优化方案。

Abstract: Extreme compression of deep neural networks, up to full binarization, dramatically reduces memory footprint and arithmetic complexity, facilitating deployment on constrained edge hardware with field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and microcontrollers. Although combining binarization with pruning promises additional efficiency gains, existing pruning strategies are ill-suited to binarized representations and rarely translate into meaningful hardware savings. We introduce a PyTorch-based, research-oriented framework that incorporates freezing and pruning mechanisms for designing and optimizing binarized neural networks. The framework enables rapid and reproducible evaluation of state-of-the-art approaches and the fast prototyping of new ones. Leveraging this framework, we propose a novel pruning method that accounts for the relative importance of learned parameters across abstraction levels. Such a global weighting mechanism consistently achieves a superior trade-off between model accuracy and pruning rate, achieving a 70% pruning rate on VGG11 with constant accuracy, while state-of-the-art results reach only 41% in the binarized setting.

</details>


### [221] [Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz: The Smoothing Benefit in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26288)
*Mingyi Li,Taira Tsuchiya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了Muon优化器中有限深度的Newton-Schulz迭代对非光滑非凸优化是有益的而非有害的。通过在线到非凸的转换框架，作者证明Newton-Schulz迭代将不连续极坐标映射平滑化为Lipschitz映射，使得Muon能够收敛到驻点，而使用精确极坐标更新的Muon反而可能无法收敛。所需Newton-Schulz深度仅随目标精度对数增长，样本复杂度匹配非光滑非凸优化的最优已知界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon作为一种针对大语言模型预训练中矩阵值参数的高效优化器，使用有限次Newton-Schulz迭代来近似正交化动量。但现有理论要么用精确极坐标分解替代该迭代，要么将其视为近似误差，导致理论框架无法解释Muon实际运行的有限深度迭代，甚至认为它只会损害收敛保证。作者希望从理论上证明有限Newton-Schulz迭代实际上是Muon成功的关键因素。

Method: 作者采用在线到非凸转换（online-to-nonconvex conversion）框架分析Muon。将更新规则视为在线学习器，并将其后悔界转换为驻点性保证。关键洞察是：有限Newton-Schulz迭代将不连续的极坐标映射平滑化为关于奇异值的Lipschitz映射，从而使Muon可以被视为具有平滑谱势函数的在线学习器。作者进一步将证明推广到所有具有相同平滑性质的通用谱映射。

Result: 作者证明Newton-Schulz深度仅需随目标精度对数增长即可保证非光滑非凸优化收敛到驻点，而精确极坐标更新的Muon可能无法收敛。样本复杂度界匹配非光滑非凸优化的最优已知结果，且在光滑非凸优化中达到问题相关因子意义下的最优。

Conclusion: 有限Newton-Schulz迭代的平滑效应是非光滑非凸优化中Muon收敛性的关键，纠正了此前将有限迭代视为纯近似误差的观点。该理论框架不仅适用于Newton-Schulz，还适用于任何具有相同平滑性质的谱映射，为理解Muon类优化器的实际行为提供了更深层的理论解释。

Abstract: Muon has emerged as a strong optimizer for the matrix-valued parameters in large language model pretraining, approximately orthogonalizing its momentum with a few Newton-Schulz iterations. Existing theory either replaces this iteration with the exact polar factor it approximates, or treats its finite depth as an approximation error, and thus the iteration Muon actually runs can only hurt the guarantees. We show that finite Newton-Schulz can instead be beneficial for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. To this end, we analyze Muon through the online-to-nonconvex conversion, which views the update rule as an online learner and converts its regret bound into a stationarity guarantee. The finite Newton-Schulz iteration smooths the discontinuous polar map into a Lipschitz map of the singular values, and Muon with finite Newton-Schulz can be regarded as an online learner with a smoothed spectral potential. This smoothing is exactly what the conversion needs: we prove that a Newton-Schulz depth growing only logarithmically in the target accuracy suffices for convergence to stationary points in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, whereas Muon with the exact-polar update may fail to converge. The resulting sample complexity bounds match the best-known guarantees for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and are optimal for smooth nonconvex optimization up to problem-dependent factors. The argument extends beyond Newton-Schulz to general spectral maps with the same smoothing property.

</details>


### [222] [Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26309)
*Antonia van Betteray,Jonathan Klees,Miriam Schäfers,Matthias Rottmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AMELS，一种基于代数多重网格加速的高效标签传播框架。通过快速构建邻域图和引入代数多重网格求解器替代传统随机游走迭代，AMELS能够在单个多重网格循环中跨任意规模的图传播标签信息，显著降低计算复杂度和内存开销，在大型高维图像数据集上实现高效且鲁棒的半监督学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习模型依赖大量标注数据，但大规模数据集的人工标注成本高昂且耗时。标签传播作为一种半监督学习技术虽能利用少量标注样本传播信息到未标注数据，但在大规模高维数据集上受到计算成本和内存限制的制约，亟需一种可扩展的高效解决框架。

Method: AMELS框架包含两个核心创新：(1)快速构建邻域图，解决大规模数据的图构建瓶颈；(2)引入代数多重网格(AMG)求解器，利用其多层结构替代传统标签传播中的随机游走迭代。AMG求解器通过多重网格循环在单次迭代中完成跨任意规模图标签信息的传播，大幅降低计算开销。

Result: 实验表明AMELS相比现有实现实现了显著的运行时间缩减，同时在运行时和分类准确率方面对超参数选择更具鲁棒性，即使在仅有少量标注样本的情况下也能在大型图像数据集上生成准确的标签。

Conclusion: AMELS框架成功克服了标签传播在大规模高维数据集上的可扩展性瓶颈，为半监督学习在真实大规模图像场景中的应用提供了高效且可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models rely on large amounts of labeled data. However, manual annotation of large-scale datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Label spreading is a semi-supervised learning technique that addresses this challenge by propagating information from a few labeled examples to a larger pool of unlabeled data. Despite its effectiveness, its application to large-scale, high-dimensional datasets is limited by computational costs and memory constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading (AMELS), an efficient label spreading framework that improves scalability by fast construction of neighborhood graphs and the incorporation of algebraic multigrid solvers. The latter is an iterative solver that replaces the ordinary random walk iteration typically performed in label spreading. Due to the multilevel nature of algebraic multigrid solvers, AMELS spreads given label information across a graph of any size in a single multigrid cycle. We demonstrate that AMELS achieves significant runtime reductions compared to existing implementations while also being more robust to hyperparameter choices in terms of both runtime and classification accuracy. Our framework therefore enables efficient label spreading on large-scale image datasets and produces accurate labels even when only a few labeled samples are available.

</details>


### [223] [Privacy Without Regret: Differentially Private Inference-Time Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26324)
*Ishi Jain,Nandini Bhattad,Sayak Ray Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种私有化Best-of-N采样方法：PrivBoN（通过Gumbel噪声同时实现ε-差分隐私和KL正则化对齐）和PrivITP（结合χ²正则化拒绝采样与两阶段高斯机制，实现ex-post (ε,δ)-DP且隐私成本与响应数n无关），两者均能同时解决奖励黑客和隐私保护问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N采样是最广泛部署的推理时对齐策略，但存在两个关键问题：一是奖励黑客（奖励模型误差被恶意利用），二是训练奖励模型所使用的人类偏好数据缺乏隐私保护。现有方法通常分别处理这两个问题，本文旨在通过单一干预同时解决二者。

Method: 核心创新是在选择响应前向奖励分数添加校准噪声。具体提出：(1) PrivBoN：利用Gumbel噪声，在适当尺度下同时实现ε-差分隐私和KL正则化对齐，证明了当隐私预算超过临界阈值ε*时，隐私强制噪声即是最优正则化，隐私不产生额外对齐成本；(2) PrivITP：结合χ²正则化拒绝采样与两阶段高斯机制，实现与响应数n无关的隐私成本，将正则化参数与隐私参数解耦。

Result: 实验在多种语言模型、数据集和奖励模型上验证：PrivBoN和PrivITP具有缩放单调性（而BoN在n超过临界值后性能退化），PrivITP在同等隐私水平下匹配或优于PrivBoN，在强隐私场景下增益最大。

Conclusion: 通过单一的噪声注入干预即可同时解决Best-of-N的奖励黑客和隐私保护问题，且隐私保护在超过临界预算时不会带来额外对齐成本，达到信息论层面的最优性能。

Abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is the simplest and most widely deployed inference-time alignment strategy, but it suffers from two distinct problems: reward hacking, in which the selected response exploits errors in the proxy reward model, and the absence of any privacy protection for the sensitive human preference data used to train that reward model. We show that a single intervention-adding calibrated noise to reward scores before selection-resolves both. Our first result, Private Best-of-N (PrivBoN), establishes that Gumbel noise at an appropriate scale simultaneously provides $ε$-differential privacy and implements KL-regularized alignment. Whenever the privacy budget exceeds a critical threshold $ε^*$, the privacy-mandated noise is the regret-optimal regularization, and privacy imposes zero additional alignment cost-matching the information-theoretic skyline of Huang et al. (2025). Because $ε^*$ depends on an unknown coverage coefficient, we introduce Private Inference-Time Pessimism (PrivITP), which combines $χ^2$-regularized rejection sampling with a two-phase Gaussian mechanism. PrivITP achieves ex-post $(ε,δ)$-DP with a privacy cost independent of the number of responses $n$, cleanly decouples the regularization parameter from the privacy parameter, and attains the skyline up to a noise-inflation term. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm our results: PrivBoN and PrivITP are scaling-monotonic (unlike BoN, which degrades past a critical $n$), and PrivITP matches or outperforms PrivBoN at equivalent privacy levels, with the largest gains in the strong-privacy regime.

</details>


### [224] [GRAS: Guided Reduced-Variance Proposals and Adaptive Selection for Training-Free Reward Alignment in Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26585)
*Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GRAS（Guided Reduced-variance proposals and Adaptive Selection）方法，通过降低梯度估计方差（Rao-Blackwellized reveal与leave-one-out baseline）和自适应重采样温度（group-relative advantage），在无需重新训练的离散扩散模型推理阶段引导中取得最优奖励表现，甚至在非可微奖励情况下仍保持有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型已成为序列数据生成的主流方法，推理阶段无需训练即可引导其朝下游奖励方向生成越来越重要。当前训练-free引导通过梯度引导、搜索或两者结合实现，但组合形式存在两个弱点：一是引导提议从单噪声样本估计梯度，方差大；二是搜索阶段以固定温度重采样粒子，忽略了奖励在各去噪步骤中的分布差异。

Method: 对提议部分，对可微奖励采用Rao-Blackwellized reveal降低估计器方差，对非可微奖励采用leave-one-out baseline；对搜索部分，将每步值标准化为group-relative advantage，并证明其可简化为单一关键要素——自适应重采样温度。这些改动不增加任何去噪器成本。

Result: 在调控DNA和蛋白质设计任务上，GRAS取得最优训练-free奖励，超越先前训练-free方法，匹配或超过奖励微调模型，并在非可微奖励场景下依然保持有效性。

Conclusion: GRAS以极简改动同时解决梯度估计高方差与搜索温度固定两个问题，在不增加去噪器成本的前提下实现高效训练-free引导，验证了组合式引导在离散扩散模型中的潜力。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have become a strong, widely adopted class of generators for sequence data, and steering them toward a downstream reward at inference time, without any retraining, is increasingly important. Such training-free steering is done by gradient guidance, by search, or by combining the two. We study the combined regime and identify two weaknesses in how it is usually run: the guided proposal estimates its gradient from a single noisy sample, and the search then resamples particles at a fixed temperature that ignores how rewards spread across each denoising step. We address both with a small set of changes that add no denoiser cost. For the proposal, we lower the estimator variance with a Rao-Blackwellized reveal for differentiable rewards and a leave-one-out baseline for non-differentiable ones; for the search, we standardize the per-step values into a group-relative advantage and prove it collapses to a single active ingredient, an adaptive resampling temperature. We call the resulting method Guided Reduced-variance proposals and Adaptive Selection (GRAS). GRAS is simple yet effective: across regulatory DNA and protein design it attains the best training-free reward, outperforming prior training-free methods and matching or surpassing a reward-fine-tuned model, and it remains effective even for non-differentiable rewards.

</details>


### [225] [Beyond Capability Benchmarks: Learning Operational Fingerprints of LLM Cloud Services from Production Incident Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26332)
*Meiwei Zhang,Eduardo Miranda,Bruce Baynes,Suvigya Jain,Wanlong Chen,Tao He,Sergey Borodavkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OpEmbed框架，利用结构化、隐私保护的工单元数据（而非工单文本），为LLM云服务学习紧凑的操作指纹（operational fingerprints）。在Google Cloud 26个月、33,000+生产工单、7个LLM家族上验证，OpEmbed能恢复可解释的家族/版本结构，提升leave-one-model-out操作预测性能，在有限早期窗口数据下依然有效，并支持跨模型故障类型迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有托管LLM服务已进入真实生产系统，但模型选择和服务规划仍主要依赖能力基准（capability benchmarks），这些基准对部署后的实际运行行为（operational behavior）揭示甚少。因此需要一个基于真实运行数据（支持工单）的框架来刻画模型的操作特征。

Method: OpEmbed将模型-时间窗口聚合为八通道操作签名（eight-channel operational signature），并通过时间对比学习（temporal contrastive learning）、跨视角重建（cross-view reconstruction）以及生成序序正则化（generational-ordinality regularization）学习低维表示。使用结构化、隐私保护的工单元数据，不依赖工单文本内容。

Result: 在Google Cloud超过33,000个生产支持工单、7个LLM家族、26个月的数据上，OpEmbed：1) 恢复了可解释的家族级与版本级结构；2) 在leave-one-model-out操作预测中优于非学习方法基线；3) 在有限早期窗口数据下仍保持有效；4) 支持跨模型故障类型迁移。

Conclusion: OpEmbed为LLM云服务的模型上线、支持就绪度评估与操作监控提供了实用工具，并总结了构建此类生产级评估工具的实际经验教训。

Abstract: Managed LLM services are now part of real production systems, but model selection and service planning still rely heavily on capability benchmarks that reveal little about operational behavior after deployment. We present Operational Embedding (OpEmbed), a framework for learning compact operational fingerprints of LLM cloud services from structured, privacy-preserving support-case metadata, without using case text. OpEmbed aggregates model--time windows into an eight-channel operational signature and learns a low-dimensional representation via temporal contrastive learning, cross-view reconstruction, and generational-ordinality regularization. Evaluated on more than 33,000 production support cases spanning seven LLM families over 26 months at Google Cloud, OpEmbed recovers interpretable family- and version-level structure, improves leave-one-model-out operational forecasting over non-learned baselines, remains useful under limited early-window data, and supports cross-model fault-type transfer. We report the practical lessons learned from building and evaluating this tool for model onboarding, support readiness assessment, and operational monitoring.

</details>


### [226] [CG4AI: A Column Generation Framework for Training AI Models Under Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26375)
*Youcef Magnouche,Abderrahmane Driouch,Sébastien Martin,Pierre Bauguion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CG4AI框架，通过列生成（column generation）技术构建AI模型的凸组合，并在线性约束下保证输出可行性。主线性规划确定最优混合权重，定价子问题利用对偶变量生成新模型，切割平面法将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外。在MNIST分类和多商品流路由问题上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准机器学习训练仅最小化损失函数，无法保证模型输出满足预定义规则或约束。在许多实际应用（如自动驾驶、网络路由）中，这种约束满足性是至关重要的。现有方法缺乏在保证约束可行性的同时保持高精度的系统性框架。

Method: CG4AI框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 主线性规划负责确定AI模型凸组合的最优混合权重；(2) 定价子问题利用LP对偶变量作为指引，生成聚焦于最违反约束区域的新模型；(3) 切割平面过程将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外的样本。整体形成类似列生成（column generation）的迭代求解框架。

Result: 在MNIST上展示了约束的四种用途：仅从约束学习、提升对抗鲁棒性、修正错误分类样本、强制输出重标记。在多商品流问题中，对神经网络路由预测器施加链路容量约束。实验表明CG4AI在标准SNDLIB基准网络上可靠地产生可行预测器，且精度优于单一模型基线。

Conclusion: CG4AI能够通过多个AI模型的凸组合在满足线性约束的前提下获得优于单一模型的精度，为约束机器学习提供了一种有理论支持的通用框架。列生成方法的引入有效解决了约束驱动的模型生成问题，切割平面策略则增强了模型的泛化可行性保证。

Abstract: Standard machine-learning training minimizes a loss function over a dataset, but does not guarantee that the resulting model will satisfy predefined rules or constraints on its outputs. In many real-world applications, ranging from autonomous systems to network routing, such guarantees are essential. We propose CG4AI, a framework that builds a convex combination of AI models while enforcing linear constraints on the combined output. A master linear program (LP) determines the optimal mixture weights, while a pricing subproblem generates new models guided by LP dual variables, focusing attention on the most violated constraints. A cutting-plane procedure extends feasibility guarantees beyond the training set. We apply CG4AI to two problems: (i) digit classification on MNIST, where we demonstrate four distinct uses of constraints, learning from constraints alone, improving adversarial robustness, correcting misclassified examples, and enforcing output relabeling; and (ii) the multi-commodity flow problem, where link capacity constraints are enforced on neural-network routing predictors. Experiments on MNIST and standard SNDLIB benchmark networks show that CG4AI reliably produces feasible predictors while achieving better accuracy than single-model baselines.

</details>


### [227] [The Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy: A Framework for Constructing Classifiers and Diagnosing Their Decisions, Applied to Prompt Injection Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26423)
*Jaturong Kongmanee,Smile Thanapattheerakul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy框架，用于构建分类器作为安全防护层，并开发补充诊断工具来识别分类器可信的自信决策。该框架包括维度优化的分类器构建、潜在支持向量的定位（约29%训练样本），以及利用这些令牌和攻击幅度构建诊断分类体系，将提示词分为可安全依赖、启发式偏差/覆盖风险、以及需要人工审查的上下文不足三类。在公开提示注入数据集上，约77%的自信决策在移除单个令牌后不再稳健，暴露出两种不同失败模式：置信度校准失败和可被利用的捷径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分类器在作为安全防护层时，其自信决策并不总是可靠，但缺乏系统方法来区分哪些决策可以信任、哪些需要额外处理。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一个端到端的诊断框架，使分类器不仅能做出预测，还能指示预测的可信度及所需的补救措施。

Method: 框架由三部分组成：(i) 构建维度优化分类器，嵌入维度通过交叉验证性能经验选择而非事先固定；(ii) 定位一小部分潜在支持向量（约占训练样本29%），代表影响分类器预测标签的关键提示令牌；(iii) 利用这些令牌及其关联的攻击幅度构建诊断分类体系。该体系将提示词划分为四类：安全依赖、启发式偏差、启发式覆盖和上下文不足。

Result: 在公开提示注入数据集上的实验表明，约77%的自信决策在移除单个令牌后变得不稳健，且这种脆弱性分为两种截然不同的失败模式：一种与置信度校准失败有关，另一种是真正可被利用的捷径。框架为每个分类区域提供了相应的补救策略建议。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个完整的分步诊断流程，能够识别分类器自信决策中的不可靠部分，区分置信度校准问题和真实安全漏洞，并为不同故障类型提供针对性的处理策略，从而增强分类器作为安全防护层在实际部署中的可靠性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a framework for constructing a classifier as a safeguard layer, and for developing a complementary diagnostic that identifies which of the classifier's confident decisions can be trusted. This framework, the Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy, consists of (i) constructing a dimensionality-optimized classifier, in which the embedding dimensionality is empirically selected via cross-validated performance rather than fixed a priori, (ii) locating a relatively small set of latent support vectors (~ 29% of total training examples) representing influential prompts for identifying tokens that alter the classifier's predicted labels, and (iii) utilizing such tokens and their associated attack magnitudes for constructing a diagnostic taxonomy. This diagnostic taxonomy provides an end-to-end guideline for flagging prompts that require different treatments: rely Safely on the classifier's decision; flag Heuristic Bias and Heuristic Override cases; route Insufficient Context cases for further human/safety review. Applying the framework to a classifier trained on a public prompt injection dataset, we find that a substantial fraction of its confident decisions (~ 77%) are not robust to removing a single token, and that this brittleness separates into two distinct failure patterns: a confidence calibration failure and a genuinely exploitable shortcut. For each zone of the taxonomy, we also recommend strategies for remediating diagnosed prompts. We illustrate the framework as a series of steps, demonstrating how each step operates.

</details>


### [228] [FedCMAPSS: A Benchmark for Federated Learning in Remaining Useful Life Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26433)
*Amelia Sorrenti,Matteo Pennisi,Concetto Spampinato,Simone Palazzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了FedCMAPSS，一个基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集的联邦剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计基准，定义了五个标准化任务来模拟从IID到极端统计异质性的真实工业挑战，并系统评估了多种联邦优化算法和神经网络架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管联邦学习为在无需共享传感器数据的情况下协作训练RUL预测模型提供了有前景的范式，但现有研究缺乏统一的评估框架，难以公平比较和复现不同方法，阻碍了联邦预测性维护领域的发展。

Method: 基于广泛使用的NASA C-MAPSS数据集构建FedCMAPSS基准，设计五个标准化联邦学习任务（从理想IID设置到极端统计异质性），系统性地对多种最先进的联邦优化算法在不同神经网络架构上进行评估，并公开源代码和数据划分。

Result: 建立了可复现的基线结果，通过公开源代码和数据划分，为联邦预测性维护解决方案的开发与比较提供了标准基础。

Conclusion: FedCMAPSS填补了联邦RUL估计领域缺乏统一评估框架的空白，为研究人员提供了标准化、可复现的基准平台，有望推动该领域的持续发展。

Abstract: Data-driven prognostics and health management has emerged as a key enabler for Industry 4.0, yet the development of robust remaining useful life (RUL) estimation models is often limited by the scarcity of run-to-failure data. While federated learning offers a promising paradigm to collaboratively train predictive models without sharing sensor data, research efforts have operated so far in the absence of a common evaluation framework. To address this gap, this paper introduces FedCMAPSS, a benchmark for federated RUL estimation based on the commonly-used NASA C-MAPSS dataset. We define a set of five standardized tasks designed to simulate real-world industrial challenges, ranging from ideal IID settings to extreme statistical heterogeneity, and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art federated optimization algorithms across multiple neural architectures. By establishing reproducible baselines and making the source code and data splits publicly available, this work aims to provide a standard foundation for developing and comparing federated predictive maintenance solutions.

</details>


### [229] [Distributed Training using an Intelligent Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26453)
*Nihar Shah,Ben Blier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出让广域网（WAN）网络本身作为训练过程的主动参与者，利用多播技术复制出站流量和内联FPGA聚合入站流量，并结合优化框架生成围绕网络拓扑的同步调度方案（旋转的集群），在DoubleZero九城拓扑上验证可缩小与本地协同训练的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广域网上的分布式训练面临受限带宽、高延迟和不均匀拓扑等挑战，跨域计算岛间的连续参数交换效率低下，需要新的方法克服这些瓶颈，尽可能接近本地协同训练的黄金标准。

Method: （1）系统层面：利用多播技术复制出站流量缓解出口瓶颈，利用内联FPGA聚合入站流量缓解入口瓶颈，将原本仅用于数据中心内训练的技术扩展到WAN；（2）算法层面：开发优化框架，围绕底层网络拓扑和上述技术生成丰富的同步调度方案（即旋转的集群），最大化信息交换效率。

Result: 在基于DoubleZero网络的九城市拓扑上进行了验证，展示了最优调度方案如何随网络能力变化而变化，结果表明这些方法能够缩小与本地协同训练（黄金标准）之间的性能差距。

Conclusion: 通过让网络主动参与训练过程，结合多播、FPGA聚合技术和拓扑感知的同步调度优化，可以显著缓解WAN分布式训练的通信瓶颈，弥合与数据中心内协同训练的性能差距。

Abstract: Distributed training across a wide area network (WAN) is challenging, as continuous parameter exchange by islands of compute is constrained by limited bandwidth, high latency, and uneven topology. We propose making the network an active participant in training. On the systems side, such networks should leverage (i) multicast technology to replicate outbound traffic and (ii) in-line FPGAs to aggregate inbound traffic, to ease egress and ingress bottlenecks. These technologies are used for training across workers within a data center, but this paper extends them to the WAN. On the algorithms side, we develop an optimization framework that produces rich synchronization schedules (namely, rotating cliques of islands) around the underlying network topology and these technologies, to maximize information exchange. Finally, we illustrate this on a nine-city topology modeled on the DoubleZero network, a live programmable WAN equipped with both technologies, and show how the optimal schedules shift with the network's capabilities. Together, these can narrow the gap to the gold standard of colocated training.

</details>


### [230] [NeoTriFuse: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Fusion under Missingness Heterogeneity for Neonatal Mortality Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26436)
*Jiyuan Tian,Qincheng Shen,Ye Lin,Yu Gao,Haohui Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeoTriFuse，一种可靠性感知的多模态融合框架，用于处理新生儿监护数据中缺失不均匀的问题，通过将缺失建模为可靠性信号来动态调节模态贡献，实现新生儿死亡风险预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新生儿死亡风险预测面临极端类别不平衡、临床风险因素异质、多尺度时间动态和大量数据缺失等挑战。传统多模态方法仅将缺失视为预处理问题，未充分利用缺失本身所携带的可靠性信息。

Method: NeoTriFuse框架包含三部分：静态围产期变量、局部-全局时间编码器、患者级统计摘要，通过可靠性引导的门控机制动态调节各模态贡献；同时联合优化死亡预测主任务和住院时长辅助任务。

Result: F1分数0.6736±0.0216，AUROC 0.9454±0.0056。消融实验表明局部-全局时间架构和患者级统计摘要分支贡献最大，可靠性感知门控在异质观测完整性条件下对阈值相关指标有额外提升，超参数敏感性分析显示性能稳定。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的多模态融合是处理真实临床缺失条件下新生儿死亡预测的实用方法，将缺失信息从噪声转化为有用信号可提升预测性能。

Abstract: Neonatal mortality risk prediction from bedside monitoring data remains challenging due to extreme class imbalance, heterogeneous clinical risk factors, multi-scale temporal dynamics, and substantial missingness. We propose NeoTriFuse, a reliability-aware multimodal fusion framework for missingness-heterogeneous neonatal monitoring data. Unlike conventional multimodal approaches that treat missingness primarily as a preprocessing issue, NeoTriFuse models missingness as an explicit reliability signal that dynamically modulates modality contributions during fusion. The framework integrates static perinatal variables, local-global temporal encoders, and patient-level statistical summaries through reliability-guided gating mechanisms, while jointly optimizing mortality prediction and an auxiliary length-of-stay objective. NeoTriFuse achieves competitive performance, with an F1 score of 0.6736 +/- 0.0216 and an AUROC of 0.9454 +/- 0.0056. Ablation studies indicate that the local-global temporal architecture and patient-level summary branch contribute most substantially to predictive performance, while reliability-aware gating provides additional improvements on threshold-dependent metrics under heterogeneous observation completeness. Sensitivity analyses further suggest stable performance across nearby hyperparameter settings. Overall, the findings support reliability-aware multimodal fusion as a practical approach for neonatal mortality prediction under realistic clinical missingness conditions.

</details>


### [231] [Performance Foundations of Parallel & Distributed Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27046)
*Maciej Besta,Leonard Schmidt,Lara Nonino,Robert Gerstenberger,Pierre Pang,Patrik Okanovic,Ales Kubicek,Tiancheng Chen,Baraq Lipshitz,Torsten Hoefler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了基于强化学习的推理语言模型（RLM）训练范式，从计算中心视角分析了PPO、GRPO等主流算法框架，提出了涵盖传统与新型并行策略的分类体系（基于工作-深度模型），并给出构建高性能、可扩展、低成本RLM的实践指南与开放研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR等强化学习后训练范式虽能显著提升LLM的推理能力（如DeepSeek-R1、o3、Kimi k1.5），但训练计算开销巨大（需数百万GPU小时和紧密耦合的多模型流水线），远超传统监督训练。这使得RLM训练不仅是一个算法问题，更是一个并行与分布式系统问题，亟需系统化的分析框架来指导高效训练。

Method: （1）系统化RL-for-LLM范式，并从计算中心视角分析PPO、GRPO及其变体等主流后训练算法框架；（2）提出面向RL-for-LLM的模型内与模型间并行策略分类体系，覆盖数据、张量、流水线、序列、上下文、专家等传统并行技术，以及解耦放置、阶段融合、混合并行、异步执行等新型多模型训练优化技术；（3）利用并行计算的work-depth模型使分类体系与分析严格且可移植。

Result: 构建了RL-for-LLM的计算中心分析框架和并行策略分类体系，分析了现有RLM训练框架并提炼出实践指南，指出了构建可扩展、快速且成本高效RLM的开放研究方向。

Conclusion: RLM训练应被视为算法与并行分布式系统的交叉问题；通过系统化的并行策略分类和计算分析，可以指导开发同时具备高性能、可扩展性和成本效益的RLM训练系统。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and other RL-style post-training paradigms have been used for aligning large language models (LLMs) with reasoning standards. The resulting recent Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) such as DeepSeek-R1, o3, and Kimi k1.5 show that such RL-style post-training ("RL-for-LLMs") can substantially improve chain-of-thought reasoning, long-horizon planning, and self-correction. However, the computational footprint of these systems is massive: state-of-the-art RLM training requires millions of GPU-hours and tightly coupled multi-model pipelines that stress modern hardware far beyond classical supervised LLM training. This makes RLM training as much a parallel and distributed systems problem as an algorithmic one. In this work, to facilitate developing RLMs that are simultaneously high-performance, scalable, and cost-effective, we first systematize the RL-for-LLM paradigm and provide a compute-centric analysis of prominent post-training algorithmic frameworks: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), as well as their variants. Second, we develop a taxonomy of intra- and inter-model parallelism strategies for RL-for-LLMs, covering both traditional techniques (data, tensor, pipeline, sequence, context, and expert parallelism) as well as novel forms of parallelism and optimization techniques for multi-model RLM training, for example disaggregated placement, stage fusion, hybrid parallelism, and asynchronous execution. We harness the work-depth model of parallel computing to make our taxonomy and its insights rigorous and portable. Finally, we analyze existing RLM frameworks and we distill practical guidelines and outline open research directions for building scalable, fast, and cost-effective RLMs.

</details>


### [232] [Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26437)
*Haohui Lu,jiyuan Tian,Fangyu Zhou,Shahadat Uddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SF-GNN框架，通过识别并随机过滤偏置传播边（利用敏感同质性和结构传播放大器），在消息传递阶段从源头缓解图神经网络的结构性不公平，同时保持预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平性GNN方法主要从全局层面约束表征或预测分布，未能显式控制偏置信息在图聚合过程中传播的局部结构路径，导致基于敏感同质性的偏置信号仍可通过图拓扑和消息传递扩散。

Method: SF-GNN是一种轻量且架构无关的框架，首先结合敏感同质性与结构传播放大器（枢纽节点参与、三元闭包）识别易偏置边，然后在每次消息传递步骤中引入随机边过滤以选择性降权或移除这些边，同时保留其余图结构；训练中引入带有预热调度的统计性均等正则化器以稳定优化。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，SF-GNN在保持有竞争力的预测性能的同时实现了一致的公平性提升，且在公平-准确率权衡上优于近期公平感知GNN基线。

Conclusion: 从结构性偏置的源头进行干预（局部边级过滤）比全局约束更有效，能够在不显著牺牲准确率的前提下实现更好的公平性。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can exhibit unfair behavior even when sensitive attributes are excluded from node features, because graph topology and message passing propagate group-correlated signals under sensitive homophily. Existing fairness-aware GNN methods mainly constrain representations or prediction distributions at a global level, without explicitly controlling the local structural pathways through which biased information propagates during aggregation. We propose Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks (SF-GNN), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that mitigates structural bias at its source. SF-GNN identifies bias-prone edges by combining sensitive homophily with structural propagation amplifiers, including hub participation and triadic closure. It then incorporates stochastic edge filtering into each message-passing step to selectively downweight or remove these edges while preserving the remaining graph structure. Training further incorporates a statistical-parity regularizer with a warm-up schedule to stabilize optimization. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show that SF-GNN achieves consistent fairness improvements while maintaining competitive predictive performance, leading to a better fairness--accuracy trade-off than recent fairness-aware GNN baselines.

</details>


### [233] [Toward Equitable Low-Carbon Mobility: Fairness-Aware Demand Prediction for Expanding Bike-Sharing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26451)
*Man Luo,Yixuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FairGIN，一种面向扩展中共享单车系统的公平感知图神经网络，同时解决冷启动预测和公平资源配置两大挑战，在NYC和Seattle数据集上实现最先进预测精度并显著降低收入差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享单车系统持续扩展带来两个核心问题：(1)新部署站点缺乏历史骑行记录，导致图模型在演化网络上的训练与推理存在分布不匹配（冷启动问题）；(2)历史需求可能编码结构性不平等，低收入社区骑行量低可能反映基础设施不足而非潜在需求弱，直接训练会强化已有的出行不公平。

Method: FairGIN包含三个组件：1) Expansion-Simulated Increment Training：在训练过程中随机模拟网络扩展以缩小冷启动分布差距；2) Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer：结合站点自适应温度缩放与正交嵌入对齐，将数据丰富站点的表示迁移到数据稀疏的新站点；3) Fairness-Aware Optimization：引入收入分层正则化与公平校准部署评分，支持更包容的站点布局。

Result: 在NYC和Seattle数据集上的实验表明，FairGIN在多种扩展场景下达到最先进的预测精度，同时在不牺牲整体系统效率的前提下大幅降低基于收入的预测偏差。

Conclusion: FairGIN有效解决了扩展中共享单车系统的冷启动预测与公平性问题，证实了通过模拟扩展训练、知识迁移和公平感知优化可以同时提升预测准确性与资源配置公平性。

Abstract: Bike-sharing systems are an important component of low-carbon urban mobility, but continued expansion creates challenges in both cold-start prediction and equitable resource allocation. Newly deployed stations lack historical ridership records, causing a mismatch between training and inference for graph-based models on evolving networks. Historical demand may also encode structural inequalities, as lower ridership in low-income neighborhoods can reflect limited infrastructure access rather than weak latent demand. Models trained directly on such data may therefore reinforce existing mobility disparities. We propose FairGIN, a fairness-aware graph neural network for demand prediction in expanding bike-sharing systems. FairGIN integrates three components. Expansion-Simulated Increment Training stochastically simulates network expansion during training to reduce the cold-start distribution gap. Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer combines station-adaptive temperature scaling with orthogonal embedding alignment to transfer representations from data-rich existing stations to data-sparse new stations. Fairness-Aware Optimization introduces income-stratified regularization and an equity-calibrated deployment score to support more inclusive station placement. Experiments on NYC and Seattle demonstrate that FairGIN achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy across diverse expansion scenarios while substantially reducing income-based disparities without compromising overall system efficiency.

</details>


### [234] [Diff Mining: Logit Differences Reveal Finetuning Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26462)
*Greg Kocher,Robert West,Clément Dumas,Julian Minder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Diff Mining框架，通过对比微调模型与基础模型的logits来识别微调模型学到的内容，无需访问模型内部结构，仅需输出logits即可扩展到大型模型，在微调领域检测和偏差识别任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调已成为语言模型改进或引入行为的标准方法，但人们往往不清楚微调过程中具体产生了哪些行为。随着模型能力增强，理解微调过程变得愈发重要，因为微调期间可能产生不良行为，需要有效的审计工具。

Method: Diff Mining包含两个模块化阶段：(1) 在参考语料上提取微调模型与基础模型之间逐上下文的logit差异；(2) 聚合这些信号构建可解释的token集合来表示微调内容。聚合方法探索了两种：简单的Top-K频率方法和基于非负矩阵分解（NMF）的方法，后者可将多个微调目标解耦为不同的token簇。

Result: 在微调领域检测任务上，Diff Mining在识别相关token和下游性能方面显著优于最先进的模型差异对比方法；在注入偏差的模型上，无需针对性探测即可识别超过三分之一的偏差。

Conclusion: Diff Mining框架在开发检测微调目标的审计工具方面展现出前景，其仅需logits即可工作的特性使其可扩展到大型模型，为模型安全和可解释性提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Finetuning has become the gold standard for refining existing behaviors and inducing new ones in language models, yet it often remains unclear exactly which behaviors emerge during this process. As models grow ever more capable, understanding finetuning better becomes increasingly important, particularly since unwanted behaviors may arise during finetuning. In this paper, we introduce Diff Mining, a simple yet effective framework for identifying what a finetuned model has learned by comparing its logits to those of its base model. Diff Mining effectively surfaces salient tokens that are amplified in the finetuned model, serving as a fingerprint of its training -- even on text unrelated to the finetuning domain. Unlike many existing model diffing methods which require model internals, Diff Mining only needs access to output logits and scales to large models. The framework consists of two modular stages: (i) extracting per-context logit differences between the finetuned and base models on a reference corpus, and (ii) aggregating the resulting signals to construct an interpretable token set representing the finetune. For aggregation, we explore both a simple Top-K frequency method and a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF)-based approach for disentangling multiple finetuning objectives into distinct token clusters. Empirically, Diff Mining succeeds across diverse settings: on finetune domain detection, it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art model diffing methods both in identifying relevant tokens and in downstream performance when an interpretability agent is given access to the extracted token set; on models with injected biases, it identifies more than one third of the biases without targeted probing. Overall, our framework shows promise in developing auditing tools to detect finetuning objectives.

</details>


### [235] [Active Curriculum Refinement for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26469)
*Zhenya Liu,Yuxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PATH框架，一个在强化学习中利用前提关系形成的DAG课程图进行主动学习的课程学习方法，通过采样多样的课程路径扩展覆盖，并将训练资源重新分配到未掌握区域，以实现更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多强化学习环境中，环境之间存在前提关系（如难度递增的编辑或参数增量），形成有向无环课程图（DAG）。然而这种结构通常仅被隐式利用，显式建模该结构有望提升训练效果。作者旨在通过显式利用课程图结构来改进强化学习训练。

Method: PATH框架的核心包含两个阶段：(1) 覆盖扩展阶段——通过采样多样的课程路径来扩展训练覆盖面；(2) 资源再分配阶段——将训练重心重新分配到尚未掌握的区域。整个过程在课程图（DAG）上进行主动学习。

Result: 在多种不同的环境中进行的实验表明，PATH通过显式利用图结构实现了强鲁棒性和良好的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模并利用课程图结构（DAG）进行主动学习，相比隐式利用该结构能够更有效地训练强化学习智能体，PATH框架验证了这一思路的有效性，在鲁棒性和泛化方面均表现优异。

Abstract: In many reinforcement learning (RL) domains, environments are connected by prerequisite relations, such as difficulty-increasing edits or parameter increments, which induce a directed acyclic curriculum graph (DAG). Although this structure is often exploited only implicitly, explicitly modeling it can improve training. We introduce PATH, a curriculum-learning framework that performs active learning over the curriculum graph. PATH first expands coverage by sampling diverse curriculum paths and then reallocates training toward regions that remain unmastered. Experiments across diverse environments show that PATH explicitly leverages the graph structure to achieve strong robustness and generalization.

</details>


### [236] [Shared Actors Need Not Share Critics: Effects of Value Mismatch in Parallel Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26481)
*Zhenya Liu,Yang Meng,Zhuokai Zhao,Xuefeng Liu,Yuxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了并行强化学习中共享 critic 在不同环境间因价值目标不一致导致的价值错配问题，理论分析揭示其使采样策略更新偏向无用动作且削弱有用动作，并提出给 critic 提供环境索引的最小干预方案，在 Procgen 等基准上显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行强化学习（如程序化生成关卡、随机动力学或课程学习）中，通常使用单一 critic 覆盖所有采样环境。但不同环境对同一可见输入可能有不同的期望回报，导致无环境信息的 critic 被迫调和相互冲突的价值目标，系统性偏移优势函数估计，进而劣化学习动态。作者旨在从理论上阐明该机制，并寻求轻量有效的解决方案。

Method: 通过多环境共享最优臂的bandit模型进行理论分析，刻画价值错配如何重新分配策略更新的方向与幅度；对比无baseline、共享价值、环境特异价值三种oracle处理在固定策略下的平均logit更新差异。基于理论提出最小干预：向critic额外输入一个日志化的环境索引，使其能分离价值目标。在CartPole、MuJoCo、BipedalWalker及全部16个Procgen游戏上做受控实验验证。

Result: 理论表明三类oracle在固定策略下的平均logit更新相同且收敛到同一最优策略，但学习路径差异显著。受控CartPole/MuJoCo实验证实了预测的价值偏移、优势偏移与性能差距。BipedalWalker与Procgen中，多头条件critic带来更稳定的学习和更高回报；在全部16个Procgen游戏、每个游戏600个未见关卡上，归一化聚合回报提升40.8%。

Conclusion: 价值错配是critic共享劣化随机学习动态的直接机制，且无法仅由标量估计器方差解释；对critic进行环境索引条件化在当前并行强化学习中具有广泛有效性，是一种简单且通用的改进手段。

Abstract: When a single policy is trained in parallel across multiple environments of the same task, such as procedurally generated levels, randomized dynamics, or curricula, implementations commonly use one critic across all sampled environments. Yet different environments can assign different expected returns to the same input visible to the critic. A critic without environment information must then reconcile distinct value targets, systematically shifting the sampled advantages within individual environments. Using illustrative bandit models with multiple environments and a common optimal arm, we characterize how this value mismatch redistributes sampled policy updates, reinforcing unhelpful actions while attenuating or even reversing useful ones. The oracle processes using no baseline, the shared value, or the value specific to the sampled environment have the same mean logit update at a fixed policy and converge to the same optimal policy, yet their realized learning paths can differ sharply. The analysis motivates a minimal intervention: give only a logged environment index to the critic so that it can separate the value targets. Controlled CartPole and MuJoCo experiments expose the predicted shifted values, advantages, and performance gaps. In the more complex BipedalWalker and Procgen settings, the same intervention yields more stable learning and higher returns. Across all $16$ Procgen games, the multihead conditional critic improves aggregate normalized return on $600$ unseen levels per game by $40.8\%$. In conclusion, the theory identifies value mismatch as a direct mechanism through which critic sharing can degrade stochastic learning dynamics, not captured by scalar estimator variance alone, and the experiments show that conditioning on an index is broadly effective in parallel reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [237] [Bayesian methods and Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms for curve reconstruction and point cloud data analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26490)
*Asir Intesar Tushar,Ioannis Sgouralis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个全贝叶斯框架用于点云数据的封闭曲线重建，将观测点建模为潜在位置的噪声扰动，并通过非参数先验对底层曲线进行正则化，采用定制MCMC采样器进行后验推断，实现对重建曲线的不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点云数据分析受到数据量大、定位噪声和缺失信息的阻碍，且现有重建流程通常只返回单一最佳拟合结构而缺乏不确定性量化。为此需要引入一个能够同时处理噪声特征并提供不确定性度量的贝叶斯重建框架。

Method: 提出全贝叶斯框架，将观测点建模为受限于底层曲线上的潜在位置的噪声扰动，用非参数先验对曲线进行正则化；后验推断采用一系列针对点云特性定制的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样器。

Result: 在合成数据和真实LiDAR数据集上的数值实验表明，该框架能够实现准确的重建，并对恢复的曲线提供量化不确定性。

Conclusion: 该贝叶斯框架有效解决了点云重建中的不确定性量化问题，在合成与真实场景中均展现出准确重建能力和可靠的不确定性表达。

Abstract: Point-cloud data routinely captured by modern imaging and sensor technologies provide detailed geometric descriptions of objects and environments, but their analysis is hindered by large data volumes, localization noise, and missing information. In addition, existing point-cloud reconstruction pipelines typically return a single best-fit structure without uncertainty quantification. We introduce a fully Bayesian framework for representing point-cloud data and reconstructing closed curves, in which observed points are modeled as noisy perturbations of latent locations constrained to lie on the underlying curve that is regularized by a non-parametric prior. Posterior inference in our framework is carried out using a series of Markov chain Monte Carlo samplers tailored to point-cloud characteristics. Numerical experiments, including synthetic examples and real-world LiDAR datasets, show accurate reconstructions and quantified uncertainty over the recovered curves.

</details>


### [238] [A Unified Framework for Fair and Personalized Decentralized Learning under Communication Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26493)
*Krishnendu S. Tharakan,Carlo Fischione*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DMFL-SQ算法，在通信受限的分散式学习中联合实现个性化模型训练、不可知公平性目标和稀疏化/量化/事件触发通信，在总通信量大幅降低的同时保持最优收敛速率，并在CIFAR-10和MUSMET EEG数据集上验证了性能与公平性的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分散式学习系统虽然改善了可扩展性、隐私性和鲁棒性，但加剧了统计异质性、客户端级公平性和通信约束三大挑战。已有研究往往分别处理这些问题，缺少一个在通信受限条件下统一考虑个性化和公平性的理论框架。作者提出核心问题：在有限通信下分散式学习能达到多公平？

Method: 提出统一的分散式学习框架DMFL-SQ，将图上的个性化多任务学习与不可知混合公平目标相结合，并融合稀疏化、量化和事件触发同步三种通信压缩技术。理论上对一般非凸目标建立收敛性保证，推导期望平方Moreau包络平稳性的O(T^{-1/2})收敛速率，并对公平感知混合目标给出PAC-Bayes泛化界。

Result: 理论结果表明DMFL-SQ在稀疏、量化和事件触发通信下仍保持O(T^{-1/2})的主导收敛速率。在CIFAR-10和MUSMET EEG真实数据集上的实验表明，DMFL-SQ在保持预测性能的同时显著降低通信开销，并改善了客户端间的公平性。

Conclusion: 个性化、公平性和通信效率可以在分散式学习中联合实现，且不牺牲主导收敛速率。这一结果回应了"有限通信下分散式学习能有多公平"这一核心问题，为实际分散式学习系统的设计提供了理论与实践依据。

Abstract: Decentralized learning systems aim to collaboratively train models across multiple clients without relying on a central coordinator. While decentralization improves scalability, privacy, and robustness, it also exacerbates three fundamental challenges: statistical heterogeneity across clients, fairness in client-level performance, and stringent communication constraints. This raises a natural question: \emph{how fair can decentralized learning be under limited communication?} We address this question by presenting a unified framework for decentralized learning under communication constraints, bringing together graph-based personalization, agnostic fairness, and compressed event-triggered communication.
