Abstract: This paper investigates decentralized multitask learning over networks when the underlying task relationships are unknown. While existing graph-regularized multitask frameworks typically assume a known structure, practical settings often require learning inter-task dependencies directly from distributed data. We propose a decentralized two-phase strategy that first estimates a generalized graph Laplacian from noisy non-cooperative stochastic gradient iterates, and subsequently exploits the learned graph to enable cooperative multitask diffusion learning. This framework is motivated by a Gaussian Markov random field prior, which gives rise to a decentralized maximum likelihood estimator for the graph Laplacian. The analysis quantifies the Laplacian estimation error and its propagation to the steady-state performance of the multitask diffusion recursion, and introduces a topology sensitivity index to capture the effect of network heterogeneity. Simulation results corroborate the theoretical findings and demonstrate that cooperation enabled by the learned task graph significantly improves performance over non-cooperative learning, while approaching the true-graph baseline when the estimation stepsize is sufficiently small.

</details>


### [272] [Benchmarking_Fast_Domain_Adaptation_for_Unsupervised_Speech_Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26992)
*Robin San Roman,Manel Khentout,Tu Anh Nguyen,Paul Michel,Yossi Adi,Emmanuel Dupoux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ABX-Accent基准，基于AESRC数据集包含10种英语口音，每个口音提供小于10小时的无标签训练集，并适配了Zero Resources Challenge的ABX评估指标。通过自适应域归一化对预训练的CPC模型进行微调，在LibriSpeech上开发方法后应用到该基准上，跨说话人ABX分数平均相对提升23.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示学习虽在预训练中表现良好，但很少关注其如何处理域外语音以及如何在少样本情况下适应新域，尤其是口音语音存在长尾分布问题——大量口音偏离标准口音。因此需要一个基准来系统评估和促进口音域适应研究。

Method: 构建ABX-Accent基准：基于AESRC数据集涵盖10种英语口音，每个口音提供小于10小时的无标签训练集，并适配ZRC ABX评估指标到每种口音。提出基线方法：使用自适应域归一化（adaptive domain normalization）对预训练的对比预测编码（CPC）模型在口音数据上进行微调。方法先在LibriSpeech上使用男/女划分进行开发。

Result: 在ABX-Accent基准上，所提出的自适应域归一化微调方法相比未适应模型，跨说话人ABX分数平均取得23.6%的相对提升。

Conclusion: ABX-Accent为口音语音的少样本域适应提供了标准化的评测基准，且自适应域归一化方法被证明能有效提升口音域适应性能。数据和指标将在论文被接收后开源。

Abstract: Representation learning has attracted great atten- tion and managed to reach good performances as a pretraining method for downstream tasks or as a first step towards unsu- pervised speech modeling. Yet, little is known about how such methods deal with out-of-domain speech and how could they be adapted in a few shot to new domains. This is important especially for accented speech where one observes a long tail of accents that diverge from the standard ones. We introduce ABX- Accent, a benchmark based on the AESRC dataset that features 10 different accents of English. It includes a small (< 10 hours) unlabelled training set in each of the accents and adaptations of the Zero Resources Challenge ABX evaluation metrics to each of the accents. We illustrate this benchmark with a baseline model that uses adaptive domain normalization to fine tune a pretrained Contrastive Predictive Coding model on the accents. This method is first developed on LibriSpeech using a male/female split. When applied to the new benchmark, the proposed method yields a relative improvement of 23.6% on across-speaker ABX scores on average compared to non adapted models. The data and metrics will be open sourced upon paper acceptance

</details>


### [273] [Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27032)
*Ivan Kruzhilov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了DPO中β系数将逆偏好噪声尺度与优化动力学耦合在一起的双重角色，导致在固定学习率下策略偏差随β非单调变化（小β死区、中间峰值、大β下降），且不同β间的loss不可直接比较。作者提出centered-softplus重构，使β>0时与DPO argmin等价，同时将两个效应解耦并可独立调参，且该目标在β→0时存在连续端点退化为线性偏好边际目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DPO中的β被普遍解释为控制对参考策略的KL约束，但实际上β同时影响逆偏好噪声尺度和优化步长（有效学习率），这种纠缠使得β的角色被掩盖，导致对超参数选择敏感、学习率调度复杂化，且不同β设置下的训练结果难以比较。

Method: 分析β的双重角色（逆偏好噪声尺度+优化动力学缩放），证明固定学习率下策略偏差对β非单调；提出centered-softplus重构损失，使β>0时与原DPO的argmin等价，但将逆偏好噪声尺度和学习率效应显式解耦，可独立调节；归一化的centered-softplus目标在β→0时存在连续极限，退化为线性偏好边际目标。

Result: 证明了固定学习率下策略偏差随β呈非单调变化（死区、峰值、递减三段）；发现标准DPO loss在不同β间不可比较，近乎相同的loss曲线可对应数倍不同的KL偏差；提出的centered-softplus公式在β>0时保持argmin等价，同时实现两效应的解耦，并提供β→0的连续端点。

Conclusion: 通过对DPO目标的结构性分析，提供了一个参数解耦的等价重构，使β的语义更清晰、超参数调优更稳定、学习率调度更简单，并建立了DPO与线性偏好边际目标之间的连续联系。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used objective for aligning language models from preference data, with the coefficient $β$ commonly interpreted as controlling the KL constraint to a reference policy. We show that $β$ entangles two distinct roles: it governs the effective inverse preference-noise scale and simultaneously rescales the optimization dynamics, coupling this scale with the effective step size. As a consequence, at a fixed learning rate the achieved policy deviation is non-monotone in $β$: it vanishes in a dead zone at small $β$, reaches a peak at an intermediate value, and decreases again for larger $β$. Moreover, standard DPO loss values are not comparable across $β$: runs with nearly identical loss curves can differ several-fold in KL divergence from the reference model. This entanglement obscures the role of $β$, increases sensitivity to hyperparameter choices, and complicates learning-rate scheduling. We propose a centered-softplus reformulation that is argmin-equivalent to DPO for $β>0$, while making the inverse preference-noise-scale and learning-rate effects explicit and independently tunable. The normalized centered-softplus objective also admits a continuous $β\to0$ endpoint that reduces to a linear preference-margin objective.

</details>


### [274] [Soft Active Electromyography Interface for Machine Learning-Enabled Silent Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27048)
*Yuta Kurotaki,Shusuke Yamakoshi,Reitaro Yoshida,Yutaka Isoda,Tamami Takano,Yuji Isano,Yusuke Miyake,Kentaro Kuribayashi,Hiroki Ota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种佩戴在手上的柔性主动肌电(EMG)接口，通过指尖电极在需要时靠近唇部采集肌电信号，结合液态金属互连、透明柔性印刷电路板电极和弹性体封装，实现单词级无声语音识别。基于深度学习模型，在30词词汇表上实现了97.2±1.3%的平均准确率，并成功实现实时无人机控制，验证了其在嘈杂、注重隐私环境中的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无声语音识别(SSR)受限于需要持续面部佩戴设备、隐私担忧以及信号采集不稳定等问题，亟需一种更便捷、稳定且不侵入的替代方案。

Method: 设计了一种佩戴在手上的软性主动EMG接口：指尖电极仅在需要时靠近唇部采集EMG信号；集成液态金属互连、透明FPC电极和弹性体封装保证手指运动中的机械稳定性；使用深度神经网络对EMG信号进行分类实现单词级识别。

Result: 在3名受试者上对30词词汇表进行分类，平均准确率达到97.2±1.3%；进一步通过实时无人机控制验证了该方法在嘈杂和隐私敏感环境中的可行性。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了软性可穿戴EMG系统作为安全、直观的人机交互界面的潜力，为无声语音识别提供了一种无需持续面部贴附、保护隐私且信号稳定的新途径。

Abstract: Silent speech recognition (SSR) provides an alternative communication pathway in the absence of audible speech. However, conventional approaches are limited by the need for constant facial attachment, privacy concerns, and unstable signal acquisition. Here, we propose a soft, active electromyography (EMG) interface that enables word-level SSR using machine learning. Worn on the hand, the device uses a fingertip electrode that can be positioned near the lips to acquire EMG signals only when needed. The interface integrates liquid metal (LM) interconnects, transparent flexible printed circuit (FPC) electrodes, and elastomer encapsulation to ensure high mechanical stability during finger motion. A deep neural network trained on these stable signals achieved a mean accuracy of 97.2 $\pm$ 1.3% across three subjects in classifying a 30-word vocabulary, demonstrating robust linguistic discrimination. Furthermore, real-time drone control validates the practicality of this approach in noisy and privacy-sensitive environments where conventional voice recognition fails. This study highlights the potential of soft, wearable EMG systems as secure and intuitive human-machine interfaces.

</details>


### [275] [Unifying Detection and Adaptation in Task-Free Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27070)
*Dezheng Han,Anbang Zhang,Zhihao Zhu,Shuaishuai Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一个名为FiUni的框架，利用预训练模型Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）中K-FAC近似的主子空间正交性进行批次级任务检测，并指导参数高效的持续学习（LoRA），无需显式任务边界即可实现动态知识共享与任务隔离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型持续学习方法通常依赖显式任务边界进行参数约束或引入任务特定模块，这在现实的无任务（task-free）场景中不适用。需要一种无需任务边界即可检测任务并实现参数高效持续适应的机制。

Method: FiUni框架包括两个核心组件：(1) 利用预训练模型K-FAC近似Fisher信息矩阵的主子空间正交性来度量不同任务间的相似性；(2) 构造FIM衍生的冻结子空间以指导LoRA（低秩适配）训练，同时将每个输入批次窗口的Fisher主子空间与历史子空间进行匹配，自适应决策是复用已有知识、扩展相关子空间还是创建新子空间，从而动态平衡知识共享与任务隔离。

Result: 实验表明，FiUni能够有效推断潜在的任务批次级隶属关系，在更少可训练参数的情况下，达到与需要任务感知（task-aware）的高级持续学习方法相当的竞争性性能。

Conclusion: FiUni验证了预训练模型FIM的K-FAC主子空间结构可以作为一种无需任务标签的信号，用于无任务场景下的任务检测与持续学习，为参数高效的task-free CL提供了一条新路径。

Abstract: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in downstream continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs), existing methods typically constrain parameter updates or introduce task-specific adaptation modules. However, these methods often rely on explicit task boundaries during training, limiting their applicability to realistic task-free scenarios. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{Fi}sher-guided \textbf{uni}fied (\textbf{FiUni}) framework for batch-level task detection and parameter-efficient continual adaptation. FiUni is motivated by a key observation about the Fisher information matrix (FIM) of pre-trained models: the orthogonality among the principal subspaces of its Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) approximation, estimated from a small number of downstream task samples, can reflect the similarity between different tasks. Based on this observation, FiUni constructs FIM-derived frozen subspaces to guide low-rank adaptation (LoRA), while matching the Fisher principal subspace of each incoming batch window with historical subspaces. This enables FiUni to adaptively determine whether to reuse existing knowledge, expand a related subspace, or create a new subspace, dynamically balancing knowledge sharing and task isolation. Experiments show that FiUni can effectively infer latent batch-level task affiliations and achieve competitive performance against advanced task-aware CL methods with fewer trainable parameters.

</details>


### [276] [Emotional Preferences as Goal-Priority Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27072)
*Shiqi Liu,Yihua Tan,Hu Fu,Guanyu Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过强化学习实现"涌现情感偏好"的计算框架：高层目标自主诱导对竞争性低层目标的偏好调节，而非外部预设。该框架由多目标强化学习内控制器（提供偏好条件化行为库）和外偏好生成器（基于高层目标学习状态到偏好的映射）组成，并在自建多目标探索环境中验证了偏好函数的上下文优先级切换、分级权衡和时间持续性等特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心动机是探究智能体能否通过高层目标自主生成的情绪偏好来自动决定竞争性低层目标的相对优先级，而非依赖外部预设。在外部环境变化和内部状态演化的情境下，情绪在调节竞争目标优先级中具有重要的功能性作用，但如何在计算上实现这一过程尚不明确。

Method: 受情绪目标导向理论启发，提出"涌现情感偏好"概念：高层目标通过强化学习自主诱导状态依赖的低层目标偏好。具体框架为：(1) 内控制器——基于多目标强化学习生成偏好条件化的目标导向行为库；(2) 外偏好生成器——通过高层目标的强化学习学习从当前状态到目标偏好的映射。同时刻画了偏好调节诱导的策略空间，并推导出以内部行为库表示误差为函数的最优性差距上界。

Result: 在自建多目标探索环境中，学习到的偏好函数表现出三种关键特性：上下文优先级切换、分级权衡和时间持续性，并在性能上优于所评估的固定偏好策略和手工设计偏好策略。

Conclusion: 当最优策略可由可获得的偏好条件化策略表示时，最优性差距趋于零。实验结果验证了情感偏好作为一种状态依赖的目标优先级调节机制，可以通过优化过程自然涌现，为自主智能体的目标优先级调节提供了计算实现路径。

Abstract: A core question in decision-making for agents is whether the relative priorities of competing lower-level objectives can be determined by emotional preferences autonomously generated by higher-level goals, rather than being externally prespecified. Under changing external environments and evolving internal states, emotions play an important functional role in regulating the relative priorities of competing goals. Inspired by the goal-directed theory of emotion, this paper studies how such preference regulation can be computationally realized through reinforcement learning. We first propose a conception of emergent emotional preference: a high-level goal autonomously induces state-dependent preferences over competing lower-level objectives. This conception is built upon a framework consisting of a multi-objective reinforcement learning inner controller and an outer preference generator. The inner controller provides a repertoire of preference-conditioned goal-directed behaviors, while the outer preference generator learns a mapping from the current state to objective preferences through reinforcement learning on a high-level goal. We operationalize emotional preference as a state-dependent regulation of relative goal priorities that emerges through optimization. Furthermore, we characterize the policy space induced by preference regulation and derive an upper bound on the optimality gap in terms of the representation error of the inner behavioral repertoire. We show that the gap vanishes when the optimal policy can be represented by the available preference-conditioned policies. Experiments in self-constructed multi-objective exploration environments show that the learned preference function exhibits contextual priority switching, graded trade-offs, and temporal persistence, and outperforms the evaluated fixed-preference and handcrafted-preference strategies.

</details>


### [277] [Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27076)
*Joshua Le Grice*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究美股量化交易中的股票收益预测模型，提出在贝叶斯超参数优化中显式针对市场制度（regime）鲁棒性进行配置，比较五类模型在约300只大盘股、11年日频数据上的表现。结果显示：制度鲁棒的超参数选择可提升样本外泛化；无单个表格深度学习架构优于梯度提升树；但将XGBoost与TabNet通过秩聚合组成Hybrid集成后，年化收益达51.26%，夏普比率2.44，CAPM alpha显著为正（0.423，p=0.011）且beta接近零，表明超额收益来自选股而非市场暴露。另发现另类数据的作用是次要的、偏空头且因模型而异。论文还提供了交互式应用便于实时探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法交易市场规模已超200亿美元，信号鲁棒性的微小提升可带来显著经济回报。现有股票预测模型评估在超参数选择时未显式考虑市场制度（regime）鲁棒性，导致模型在跨越不同市场状态时的泛化能力缺少保障。作者希望填补这一空白，构建一个在超参数优化阶段就兼顾制度鲁棒性的评估框架。

Method: 使用约300只美国大盘股11年的日频观测数据，训练五类模型（含梯度提升树及多种表格深度学习架构）。采用贝叶斯优化进行超参数搜索，并以跨三个统计上不同的市场制度的交易表现作为优化目标，实现制度鲁棒的超参数选择。通过秩聚合（rank aggregation）的方式将XGBoost与TabNet组合为Hybrid集成模型。同时引入模拟输入噪声测试信号退化行为，并进行数据源贡献分析，评估技术/基本面特征与另类数据的相对作用。

Result: 制度鲁棒的超参数选择带来良好样本外泛化：测试期四个季度的信号精度均高于随机基线；组合表现在模拟噪声下缓慢退化，超过阈值后才崩溃。无单个表格深度学习模型优于XGBoost，但Hybrid集成（XGBoost+TabNet秩聚合）表现最佳：年化收益51.26%、夏普比率2.44、CAPM alpha=0.423（p=0.011）、beta接近零。另类数据在技术/基本面特征之后贡献次要，短边贡献强于长边，且因模型类别而异。

Conclusion: 制度感知的超参数优化是提升股票预测模型样本外鲁棒性的有效手段；表格深度学习目前难以单独超越梯度提升树，但集成策略（秩聚合）可有效融合两者优势。纯选股驱动的正alpha揭示了组合收益的可持续性。另类数据的边际价值有限且具有方向性与模型依赖性，实践部署前仍需接入实时数据流。

Abstract: Algorithmic trading now represents a market exceeding $20 billion, where even marginal gains in signal robustness can translate into economically significant returns. Existing evaluations of equity prediction models do not explicitly target regime robustness during hyperparameter selection. Five model classes are trained on daily observations from approximately 300 large-cap US equities over eleven years, with Bayesian optimisation configured to target trading performance across three statistically different market regimes. Regime-robust hyperparameter selection is associated with out-of-sample generalisation, as signal precision remains above the random baseline across all four quarters of the test period, and portfolio performance slowly degrades under simulated input noise before collapsing beyond a defined threshold. No individual tabular deep learning architecture outperforms gradient-boosted trees, but combining XGBoost and TabNet using rank aggregation produces a Hybrid ensemble with an annualised return of 51.26%, a Sharpe ratio of 2.44, and a statistically significant CAPM alpha of 0.423 (p = 0.011). A near-zero beta indicates this outperformance is driven by stock selection, not market exposure. Alternative data plays a secondary role once technical and fundamental features are accounted for, as well as contributing more strongly on the short side than the long, and varies by model class. An interactive application makes these results explorable in real time, with live data integration the remaining step toward practical deployment.

</details>


### [278] [Cone Extended Rayleigh Quotients for Directed Graph Learning: Minimax Spectral Certificates, Sensitivity, and Adaptive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27122)
*Yavdat Sh. Il'yasov,Nur F. Valeev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向有向图学习的非对称传播算子频谱认证、灵敏度分析与控制方法，基于双面锥Rayleigh框架处理广义铅笔Bθ-λG，无需对称性、非负性或锥保持假设。在正象限设置下提供可计算的锥界以进行后验包络，并通过平滑soft-min/max代理保持严格单侧界和可微性。对简单内层，右左模态满足Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C，支持一阶最优图干预和自适应频谱控制。实验表明该方法超越锥保持算子，在Cora有向引文网络上将频谱水平降低约21.5%，同时不损失测试精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有向图学习自然产生非对称的传播算子，具有截然不同的左右谱结构。现有方法往往依赖对称性、非负性或锥保持等假设，限制了在广义有向图上的适用性。作者旨在开发一种不需要这些约束的学习导向方法论，用于频谱认证、灵敏度分析和控制。

Method: 基于广义铅笔Bθ-λG的双面锥Rayleigh框架，建立非对称算子的频谱分析方法。具体包括：(1) 在正象限下推导可计算的上下锥界，提供锥水平的后验包络；(2) 设计平滑soft-min/max代理函数，保留严格的单侧界并给出显式逼近误差，同时对可训练参数可微；(3) 对简单内层使用右左模态导数Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C进行一阶最优图干预；(4) 通过自适应谱控制迭代调整边权重。

Result: 实验表明该方法适用于锥保持算子之外的情形和有向学习设置。符号非对称扰动揭示了从内特征对到边界互补准对的转变，包括非谱锥水平。对照实验显示对称化会移除仅由边方向携带的预测信息。在Cora有向引文网络上，自适应重计算左右灵敏度在累计边权重缩减预算0.5%下将频谱水平降低约21.5%，且训练模型和评测数据划分的测试精度不变。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了适用于一般非对称有向图算子的频谱分析理论框架，克服了对称性和锥保持假设的限制，并通过数值实验验证了其在实际有向学习任务中的有效性。谱灵敏度公式Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C为图结构干预提供了理论依据，而自适应重计算方法展示了在保证模型性能的前提下实现频谱控制的实际可行性。

Abstract: Directed graph learning naturally leads to trainable nonsymmetric propagation operators with distinct right and left spectral structures. Building on the two-sided cone Rayleigh framework for generalized pencils \[ B_θ-λG, \] we develop a learning-oriented methodology for spectral certification, sensitivity analysis, and control without requiring symmetry, nonnegativity, or cone preservation. In the positive-orthant setting, computable lower and upper cone bounds provide an a posteriori enclosure of a distinguished cone level, while smooth soft-min/max surrogates preserve rigorous one-sided bounds with explicit approximation errors and remain differentiable with respect to the trainable parameters.
  For a simple interior level, the right and left modes satisfy \[ Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C, \] yielding first-order optimal graph-supported interventions under prescribed perturbation budgets and motivating adaptive spectral control. Numerical experiments demonstrate the applicability of the approach beyond cone-preserving operators and in directed learning settings. Signed nonsymmetric perturbations reveal a transition from interior eigenpairs to boundary complementary quasi-pairs, including non-spectral cone levels, while controlled experiments show that symmetrization can remove predictive information carried solely by edge direction.
  On the directed Cora citation network, adaptive recomputation of the right--left sensitivity reduces the distinguished spectral level by approximately $21.5\%$ under a cumulative edge-weight reduction budget of $0.5\%$, with no observed change in test accuracy for the trained model and data split considered.

</details>


### [279] [TRACE-CRC: Trajectory-Adaptive Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Step Channel State Information Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27124)
*Kiarash Rezaei,Mehdi Sattari,Javad Aliakbari,Tommy Svensson,Paolo Monti,Carlos Natalino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE-CRC，一种针对多步CSI预测的轨迹感知不确定性量化方法，通过Frobenius范数不确定性球和保形风险控制来保证整个预测轨迹至少有一帧未被覆盖的风险可控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习CSI预测器仅提供点预测，缺乏校准的不确定性估计。在多步CSI预测中，下游决策（如波束成形、调度）可能因预测轨迹中任何一帧不可靠而失败，因此需要轨迹级的不确定性量化。

Method: TRACE-CRC结合了三个关键组件：(1) 围绕预测CSI矩阵构建Frobenius范数不确定性球；(2) 将来逐步依赖的误差分析、轨迹难度分层和learn-then-test (LTT)风险控制相结合；(3) 控制至少一个未来帧未被覆盖的风险，而非独立校准每一未来步。

Result: 实验表明TRACE-CRC在显著缩小不确定性球尺寸的同时实现了可靠的轨迹级覆盖率，优于保守的多步校正方法，并避免了紧凑逐步和自适应保形基线的轨迹覆盖不足问题。

Conclusion: TRACE-CRC为多步CSI预测提供了更准确且计算高效的不确定性量化方法，能够在保证轨迹级可靠性前提下生成更紧致的不确定性估计，对实际无线通信系统中的风险评估和决策支持具有重要意义。

Abstract: Reliable prediction of time-varying channel state information (CSI) is essential for efficient wireless communication. Each CSI frame is a matrix-valued representation of the wireless channel response, and a sequence of CSI frames forms a temporal channel trajectory. Modern deep learning-based CSI predictors, however, often provide only point predictions and lack calibrated uncertainty estimates. This limitation is particularly problematic in multi-step CSI prediction, where the target is a sequence of future CSI matrices, and downstream decisions such as beamforming or scheduling may fail if any part of the predicted trajectory is unreliable. We propose trajectory-adaptive calibration and error profiling with conformal risk control (TRACE-CRC), a method for trajectory-aware uncertainty quantification in multi-step CSI prediction. TRACE-CRC constructs Frobenius-norm uncertainty balls around predicted CSI matrices and controls the risk that at least one future frame is uncovered. Instead of calibrating each future step independently, TRACE-CRC combines future-step-dependent error profiling, trajectory difficulty stratification, and learn-then-test (LTT) risk control. Empirically, TRACE-CRC achieves reliable trajectory-level coverage with substantially smaller uncertainty balls than conservative multi-step corrections, while avoiding the trajectory undercoverage of compact stepwise and adaptive conformal baselines.

</details>


### [280] [Ultra Low-Power, Lightweight, Probabilistic RSS-Based Path Reconstruction: A System for Landscape-Scale Bee Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27152)
*Christopher J. Noroozi,Joseph L. Woodgate,Michael Mangan,Michael T. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于RSS（接收信号强度）的新型低功耗定位跟踪方法，通过最小数量的RSS测量和概率建模推断到达角（AoA），实现对超轻量（38mg）低功耗（<180uW）移动接收器在复杂环境中的跟踪，定位精度约15m，并通过对大黄蜂归巢飞行的演示验证了其在行为生态学等领域的应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在运动生态学、物联网和机器人等领域，需要定位体积小、功耗受限而无法实现GNSS的设备。现有低功耗定位方法依赖大量RSS测量来推断AoA，受限于测量范围和功耗需求，亟需一种用最少RSS测量实现高精度跟踪的方法。

Method: 利用简单旋转高增益发射机（作用距离300m）获取最小数量的RSS测量，通过概率建模推断信号到达角（AoA）；随后使用高斯过程对接收器运动路径建模，并采用双重随机变分推断进行路径重建。

Result: 对仅38mg（含电源）的接收器在可扩展景观范围内实现约15m的跟踪精度，功耗低于180uW；通过增加RSS测量可提升至约10m精度，功耗低于600uW。系统成功应用于跟踪大黄蜂（Bombus terrestris）归巢飞行。

Conclusion: 该方法以极低的功耗和重量代价实现了可扩展范围内的有效定位跟踪，有望支持飞行昆虫物种行为研究等领域的发展。

Abstract: Applications in fields such as movement ecology, Internet of Things or robotics share the need for systems that localize devices that are too small and power constrained to implement GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems). Alternative low-power localization methods often rely on only measurements of RSS (Received Signal Strength) to infer the AoA (Angle of Arrival) of a transmitted radio frequency signal, but are limited by range and the power demand of the large number of RSS measurements required to infer an accurate AoA. In this paper we address these issues with a novel RSS-based method for tracking ultra lightweight and low-power moving receivers across a complex landscape, achieved by using a minimal number of RSS measurements from simple rotating high-gain transmitters with a range of 300m, and applying probabilistic modelling to infer their AoA. The receiver's movement path is then modelled using a Gaussian process and reconstructed using doubly stochastic variational inference, resulting in approximately 15m accuracy tracking of receivers weighing 38mg (including power source) over a scalable landscape range while consuming less than 180uW, increased to approximately 10m accuracy at less than 600uW by taking more RSS measurements. We anticipate that this method will support fields such as the behavioural study of flying insect species, which we demonstrate by applying the system to track Bombus terrestris nest return flights.

</details>


### [281] [Inductive Correlation Clustering with Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27153)
*Francesco Paolo Nerini,Francesco Bonchi,Arijit Khan,André Panisson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用图神经网络(GNN)解决归纳式相关聚类(Inductive Correlation Clustering)问题的框架，该框架能够处理未见过的图实例，相比传统算法推理时间降低最多5个数量级，且近似比保持在最佳基线解的~10%以内，同时可作为可学习的图池化机制用于图分类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有相关聚类(CC)算法存在两大缺陷：一是可扩展性差，无法处理大规模数据；二是本质上是直推式的(transductive)，即对每个新的问题实例都需要从头执行算法。这限制了CC在实际应用中的通用性和效率。

Method: 本文通过图神经网络(GNN)来解决归纳式相关聚类问题，这是一个CC问题的新泛化形式，旨在处理未见过的图实例。框架通过学习训练过程中的常见结构模式和节点特征，能够泛化到来自相同分布的新图，且相对于标准算法仅需极小的计算开销。此外，该框架还被用作可学习的池化机制以增强GNN捕获网络中层析结构信息的能力。

Result: 通过大量实验证明了方法的有效性和可扩展性：在归纳式设置下推理时间降低高达5个数量级，近似比维持在最佳基线解的~10%以内；在标准的直推式CC基准上也取得了有竞争力的结果。作为图分类的池化层时，能够有效提升GNN捕获层级结构信息的能力。

Conclusion: 该方法在归纳式相关聚类中表现出卓越的效率和近似性能，同时成功拓展到图池化任务，表明其不仅是一个高效的相关聚类求解器，还可作为通用的可学习池化层增强GNN的层级结构建模能力。

Abstract: Correlation Clustering (CC) is a natural formulation of clustering in combinatorial optimization, which uses a graph representation of the input and does not require a pre-specified number of clusters. Given $n$ objects and a pairwise similarity function, the goal is to cluster the objects so that similar objects are put in the same cluster and dissimilar objects are put in different clusters. Despite its versatility, existing CC algorithms suffer from significant scalability issues and are inherently transductive: i.e., the algorithm must be executed from scratch for any new problem instance.
  In this work, we bridge this gap by leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to solve Inductive Correlation Clustering, a novel generalization of the CC problem designed to handle unseen graph instances. By learning to exploit common structural patterns and node features during training, our framework generalizes to new graphs drawn from the same distribution with minimal computational overhead with respect to standard algorithms. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach through extensive experiments. Our framework not only excels in the inductive setting, e.g., lowering the inference time up to $5$ order of magnitude, while maintaining an approximation ratio within $~10\%$ of the best baseline solution, but also achieves competitive results on standard (transductive) CC benchmarks. Finally, we showcase a practical application of our framework as a learnable pooling mechanism for graph classification. Our results indicate that our method serves as an efficient pooling layer, enhancing the ability of GNNs to capture hierarchical structural information in networks.

</details>


### [282] [Diffusion Policies for Short-Horizon Planning in Robot Crowd Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27158)
*Wendong Li,Jochen Garcke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了PDPO（Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization），一个离线到在线的强化学习框架，使用扩散策略生成短期动作块用于机器人人群导航，并在修改后的有界基准上取得了优于强基线的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的强化学习方法在每个时间步输出单个反应式动作，难以表征密集、动态、多模态人机交互下的多样化短期避障策略，限制了决策的安全性和效率。

Method: 采用扩散策略生成五步短期动作块，先在碰撞避让演示数据上预训练，再用PPO在线微调，将去噪过程视为内部决策过程；执行时以滚动时域方式应用动作块。同时引入边界违规视为碰撞的新的有界基准设置。

Result: 实验表明PDPO相比于强基线获得了更高的成功率；消融实验证明了动作块在修改后的有界基准中尤为重要。

Conclusion: 通过扩散策略和动作块机制有效提升了人群导航中的避障性能，同时揭示了现有基准中边界无约束的评估缺陷并给出了修正方案。

Abstract: Robot crowd navigation requires safe and efficient decision-making under dense, dynamic, and multimodal human--robot interactions. Existing reinforcement-learning methods typically output a single reactive action at each timestep, which limits their ability to represent diverse short-term avoidance strategies. We propose Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO), an offline-to-online reinforcement-learning framework that uses a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks for crowd navigation. PDPO is first pretrained on collision-avoidance demonstrations and then fine-tuned online with PPO by treating the denoising process as an internal decision process. During execution, the policy generates a five-step action chunk and applies it in a receding-horizon manner. Furthermore, we observe an evaluation artifact in common crowd-navigation benchmarks: without explicit boundary constraints, learned agents may leave the valid domain and bypass dense crowds. To address this, we introduce a setting in which boundary violations are treated as collisions. Experiments show that PDPO obtains an improved success rate over strong baselines, and ablations demonstrate that action chunks are especially important for the modified bounded benchmark.

</details>


### [283] [TraceBench: Controlled Evaluation of LLM Agents for Time-Series Root-Cause Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27182)
*Tommaso Bendinelli,Artur Dox,Christian Holz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TraceBench，一个基于仿真的框架，用于在受控条件下系统性评估LLM智能体在时序数据异常检测和根因分析任务上的表现。实验发现智能体在获得领域上下文时表现显著提升，更倾向通过数值控制台输出而非可视化探索数据，且生成预测脚本的方式比直接提交预测表现更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体已被越来越多地应用于真实系统的异常检测与根因分析，但其在这些任务上的性能从未在受控条件下被系统性评估。现有评估缺乏可控的实验环境和标准化的任务生成手段，难以科学衡量智能体在这些任务中的真实能力与局限。

Method: 作者构建了TraceBench仿真框架，通过模拟物理动态系统生成受控的根因归因任务。每个任务中，智能体接收系统模拟产生的时序观测数据，需判断系统参数是否被改变以及具体是哪个参数。从三个可解释的机械系统中生成任务，并在受控实验条件下系统性评估四个LLM智能体。

Result: 实验表明：智能体在获得领域上下文时获益显著；它们主要通过数值控制台输出而非可视化来探索数据；当需要生成Python脚本将每个样本映射到预测根因标签时，智能体的表现比直接提交预测更差。数据、智能体轨迹、实验结果和排行榜已公开于tracebench.github.io。

Conclusion: TraceBench提供了一个受控的基准测试框架，揭示了LLM智能体在动态系统时序数据分析中的关键行为特征和性能瓶颈，为未来该领域的研究和智能体设计提供了重要参考。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in time-series observations collected from real-world systems; however, their performance on these tasks has not been systematically evaluated under controlled conditions. We introduce TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for generating controlled root-cause attribution tasks. In each generated task, an agent receives time-series observations produced by simulating a physical dynamical system and must determine whether a system parameter was altered during the simulation and, if so, which one. Using TraceBench, we generate tasks from three interpretable mechanical systems and systematically evaluate four LLM agents across controlled experimental conditions, yielding new insights into how these agents analyze time-series observations from dynamical systems. Our results show that agents benefit substantially from domain context and explore data primarily through numerical console output rather than visualizations. We also find that agents generally perform worse when required to produce a Python script that maps each time-series sample to a predicted root-cause label than when they submit predictions directly. We release our datasets, agent trajectories, experimental results, and a leaderboard on our website, tracebench.github.io.

</details>


### [284] [When Interference Graphs Evolve: Doubly Robust Estimation of Dynamic Peer Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27187)
*Xiaojing Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出受控对比框架（controlled contrast framework），将潜在结果按自身处理、时间聚合的同伴暴露和后分配网络演化摘要进行索引，区分同伴效应、自身处理、网络演化的因果作用。基于此设计了动态网络双稳健估计器DynaNet-DR，合并时间因子化倾向得分与归一化增广，在多个假设下具有双稳健一致性，并通过半合成基准和MathOverflow观测研究验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同伴效应的估计在交互图动态演化时面临困难，因为预分配网络历史、动态同伴暴露和后分配网络变化各自具有不同的因果作用，传统方法难以将它们区分，需要一种能够控制网络演化过程并分离各因果效应的框架。

Method: 引入受控对比框架，以自身处理、时间聚合的同伴暴露和后分配网络演化摘要建立潜在结果索引，定义多种受控对比而非中介分解；提出DynaNet-DR估计器，结合时间因子化倾向得分与归一化增广，并加入代表性得分预测、固定截断和有限样本稳定化。

Result: 在一致性、摘要充分性、顺序可交换性、正性、干扰收敛和弱依赖条件下，标准估计器在结果回归或倾向得分估计器任一致时均保持一致；在固定真实时态图序列的半合成基准中，相较于完整画像方法取得了较优的估计精度。

Conclusion: 动态网络中的同伴效应可通过受控对比框架和DynaNet-DR双稳健估计器有效估计，其基准评估针对摘要索引对比而非反事实边的生成，MathOverflow研究在既定假设下作为观测性示例说明。

Abstract: Peer effects are difficult to estimate when interaction graphs evolve because pre-assignment network history, dynamic peer exposure, and post-assignment network change have distinct causal roles. We introduce a controlled contrast framework that indexes potential outcomes by own treatment, temporally aggregated peer exposure, and a post-assignment evolution summary. Differences between the resulting means define own-treatment, peer-exposure, controlled network-evolution, and joint controlled contrasts rather than a mediation decomposition. We develop the Dynamic Network Doubly Robust estimator, DynaNet-DR, which combines a temporally factorized propensity with normalized augmentation. Under consistency, summary sufficiency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, nuisance convergence, and weak dependence, its canonical estimator is consistent when either the outcome regression or the propensity estimator is consistent. The reported implementation adds representative-score prediction, fixed clipping, and finite-sample stabilization. Semi-synthetic benchmarks on fixed real temporal graph sequences show favorable estimation accuracy among methods targeting the full profile. These benchmarks assess summary-indexed contrasts rather than counterfactual edge generation, and the MathOverflow study is an observational illustration under the stated assumptions.

</details>


### [285] [Common Geodesics Do Not Guarantee Fisher Consistency of the Structured SVM: Minimal Counterexamples and a Tree-Metric Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27203)
*Jintao Fei,Jiangying Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了结构化支持向量机（structured SVM）中Fisher一致性的充分性问题。作者证明了一个已知的必要条件（任务损失为度量且每个输出三元组存在公共测地点）对于坐标式argmax解码器并非充分条件。论文完全分类了加权树度量下的argmax一致性（仅当树为路径时成立），并给出了树形分支结构失败仅发生在边界分布、全支撑分布下仍成立的结论。还构造了5个输出、$K_{2,3}$图及三维Hamming立方体的全支撑反例，所有最优性声明均有精确的原始-对偶证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化预测中，Fisher一致性是保证代理损失最小化等价于真实风险最小化的关键性质。现有研究给出了一个已知的必要条件（任务损失为度量且每个输出三元组有公共测地点），但该条件是否充分尚不清楚。理解argmax解码器在此条件下的一致性边界，对设计可靠的代理损失和验证校准链接至关重要。

Method: 作者通过具体反例构造和完整分类分析：首先构造四输出星型图上的严格非Bayes最优分数向量证明必要条件不充分；接着对加权树度量给出完整分类（路径树的充分必要性）；利用边界分布与全支撑分布的区分，构造五输出及$K_{2,3}$（最小$K_{m,n}$族成员）和三维Hamming立方体的全支撑反例；所有论证辅以精确的原始-对偶最优性证书。

Result: (1) 共同测地条件对坐标式argmax解码器不是充分的，四输出是最小反例规模；(2) 树度量下argmax一致性当且仅当树为路径；(3) 分支树上的失败仅出现在边界分布，全支撑分布下树度量仍保持argmax性质；(4) 满足共同测地条件时，5个输出是最小全支撑反例规模，$K_{2,3}$是无穷$K_{m,n}$族中的最小成员；(5) 三维Hamming立方体存在全支撑反例。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了嵌入（embedding）保证校准链接存在性与实际验证指定argmax链接一致性之间存在具体的解码器差距：在多面体设定下，即使嵌入能保证某个校准链接存在，也无法保证预设的argmax链接在所有代理风险最小化器上有效。这为结构化SVM的代理损失设计提供了重要的理论边界。

Abstract: A known necessary condition for Fisher consistency of the structured support vector machine requires the task loss to be a metric for which every output triple has a common geodesic point. We show that this condition is not sufficient for the canonical coordinate-wise argmax decoder. A four-output unit star admits an exactly optimal score vector whose maximizers are all strictly non-Bayes, and four outputs are minimal among metrics satisfying the condition. We then completely classify positively weighted tree metrics whose vertex set is the output space: argmax consistency holds if and only if the tree is a path. The failure on branching trees is confined to boundary distributions; every tree retains the argmax property at every full-support distribution. Among metrics satisfying the common-geodesic condition, five outputs are necessary and sufficient for a full-support counterexample; $K_{2,3}$ is the smallest member of an infinite $K_{m,n}$ family. We additionally give a full-support counterexample for the three-dimensional Hamming cube. All optimality claims have exact primal-dual certificates. The counterexamples expose a concrete decoder gap: in this polyhedral setting, an embedding can guarantee the existence of a calibrated link without validating a prescribed argmax link on every surrogate-risk minimizer.

</details>


### [286] [Profit based evaluation of machine learning for nitrogen recommendations in winter wheat](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27205)
*Xulong Wang,Po Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对冬小麦施氮量建议，本文提出以利润损失而非预测精度来评估机器学习模型。基于892条产量响应曲线和氮-粮价比扫描建立的测试台，发现机器学习无法准确恢复最优施氮量，但在标准建议上叠加一个简单的修正步骤可将利润损失削减25%（另一站点无需重新训练即削减43%），证明机器学习的价值在于修正标准建议而非替代它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准UK施氮建议在设定时不响应价格波动，而近年价格大幅波动使最优施氮量变化数十公斤/公顷。机器学习常被提议为解决方案，但传统上仅以预测精度评估，而预测准确并不等同于推荐方案更盈利。作者旨在直接以利润损失来评分施氮建议的盈利能力。

Method: 构建892条来自两个长期英国试验的产量响应曲线测试台，扫描氮-粮价比以覆盖所有价格情景。对比机器学习模型与标准建议，采用前沿利润损失作为评分指标，并测试在模型输出后叠加简单修正步骤的混合方案。

Result: 机器学习作为预测器失败：无模型能在农场容差内恢复最优施氮量，基准噪声显示任何模型均无法做到。正常价格下所有模型在利润上都不如标准建议。但在模型后应用简单修正步骤可将利润损失削减25%，更好的模型和额外特征无增益；同一冻结修正在第二站点无需重训即削减43%损失。混合方案（标准建议+阻尼修正）可消除偏差并削减罕见大损失。价格扫描同时给出减排成本，与当前碳价格相当。

Conclusion: 机器学习的价值在于作为利润评分的修正项叠加在标准建议之上，而非完全替代标准建议。即使机器学习无法准确预测最优施氮量，也能通过修正标准建议显著提高盈利能力，同时以与碳价相当的成本实现减排。

Abstract: Nitrogen rates for winter wheat are set before the season, under unknown prices and weather. The standard UK advice does not respond to prices, yet recent price swings moved the most profitable rate by tens of kilograms per hectare. Machine learning is often proposed as the fix. However, it is usually judged on prediction accuracy, and accurate prediction does not by itself make the recommended rate more profitable. Our insight is to score nitrogen advice directly by the profit it forgoes on measured yield response curves. We build a test bench on 892 such curves from two long running UK experiments, and sweep the nitrogen to grain price ratio to cover all price scenarios. On this bench, machine learning fails as a predictor. No model recovers the best rate within farm tolerance, and the benchmark noise shows none can. At normal prices, every model also loses to the standard advice on profit. The gain sits elsewhere. A simple correction step applied after the model cuts profit losses by a quarter, while better models and extra features give no gain. The same frozen correction cuts losses by 43% at the second site without any retraining. A hybrid of standard advice plus a damped correction removes bias and trims rare large losses. The same price sweep also prices emission cuts, at a cost comparable to current carbon prices. Machine learning therefore pays as a profit scored correction to standard advice, not as its replacement.

</details>


### [287] [HALO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Language-Aligned IMU Foundation Model for Open-Set Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27233)
*Zihan Ding,Liyu Zhang,Xiaomin Ouyang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HALO是一个面向IMU传感器的人类活动识别基础模型，通过两阶段训练框架（异构感知自监督预训练+同义词感知软对比学习的语言对齐）同时解决传感异构性和开放集泛化两大挑战，在7个留出数据集上全面超越5个SOTA基线，且参数量仅为最新基础模型MOMENT的约1/10。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IMU-based人类活动识别缺乏能够跨主体、跨设备、跨活动泛化的统一模型，主要面临两大挑战：一是传感异构性（采样率、通道配置、传感器位置差异），二是对未见活动和标签词表的泛化能力差。现有方法通常针对特定数据集设计，难以统一。

Method: HALO采用两阶段训练框架。阶段1：异构感知自监督预训练，包括自适应池化分词（adaptive-pooling tokenization）、通道独立特征提取（channel-independent feature extraction）、以及上下文感知传感器条件注入（contextualized sensor conditioning，将自然语言传感器描述嵌入每个通道）。阶段2：通过同义词感知软对比学习（synonym-aware soft contrastive learning）将IMU编码器与文本嵌入对齐，实现基于余弦相似度检索的开放集识别，无需逐数据集分类器。

Result: 在10个公开数据集训练、7个留出数据集上评估，HALO在全部8个聚合指标上超越5个SOTA基线；在基线匹配输入下仍在4个设置中的3个保持领先。仅使用约35M可训练参数（比MOMENT的341.2M少10倍），在覆盖全部87个训练标签的零样本开放集准确率上提升13.7个百分点。但在两个严重分布偏移的数据集上，包括HALO在内的所有模型零样本性能均崩溃。

Conclusion: HALO证明了语言对齐的异构感知预训练能够以远低于现有基础模型的参数量，在IMU-HAR中实现跨数据集开放集泛化的显著提升，但同时也揭示了在严重分布偏移场景下零样本泛化的固有局限，指出该领域仍有进一步研究空间。

Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using inertial measurement units (IMUs) enables a wide range of applications, yet the field still lacks a unified model that can generalize across diverse subjects, devices, and activities. Training such a model is difficult due to two key challenges: sensing heterogeneity -- differences in sampling rates, channel configurations, and sensor placements -- and poor generalization to unseen activities and label vocabularies. We introduce HALO (Heterogeneity-Aware Language-aligned Open-set model), a domain-specific IMU foundation model that addresses both challenges through a two-stage training framework. Stage 1 pretrains the IMU encoder with heterogeneity-aware self-supervised learning, including adaptive-pooling tokenization, channel-independent feature extraction, and contextualized sensor conditioning that injects natural-language sensor descriptions into each channel embedding. Stage 2 aligns this IMU encoder with text embeddings via synonym-aware soft contrastive learning, enabling open-set recognition via cosine-similarity retrieval without per-dataset classifiers. Trained on 10 public HAR datasets and evaluated on 7 held-out datasets, HALO outperforms five state-of-the-art baselines on all 8 aggregate metrics, and still leads on 3 of 4 settings under baseline-matched inputs. Despite using only ~35M trainable parameters -- 10x fewer than the latest foundation model MOMENT (341.2M) -- HALO improves zero-shot open-set accuracy, measured over all 87 training labels, by 13.7 percentage points. On two further datasets with severe distribution shift, every model including HALO collapses zero-shot. A video demonstration of HALO's performance in real world is available at https://youtu.be/rooVKragtFU

</details>


### [288] [Importance Scoring of Transformer Attention Heads in Learning Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27241)
*Ahmad Jad Allah,Kazi F. Akhter,Md. Kamrozzaman Bhuiyan,Manar D. Samad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将重要性评分指标应用于多头Transformer模型的表格数据学习场景，通过在40个多样化表格数据集上的实验，验证了基于头部重要性的剪枝策略的鲁棒性，并揭示了表格数据中注意力头重要性的独特分布规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管深度Transformer在计算机视觉和自然语言处理领域已被广泛研究，但其在表格数据上的应用仍相对未被充分探索。作者旨在通过重要性评分指标来理解和优化Transformer在处理表格数据时的内部机制，弥补该领域的研究空白。

Method: 提出一种注意力头重要性评分指标，用于解释多头Transformer模型在表格数据学习中的行为。在40个不同结构的表格数据集上进行实验，通过逐步移除低重要性分数和高重要性分数的注意力头来评估模型性能变化，并跨六个注意力层分析头部重要性的分布模式。

Result: 在72.5%的实验案例中，逐步移除低重要性分数的头部时模型表现最为鲁棒；而先移除最重要注意力头则导致分类性能最大幅度的下降。重要头部分散在六个注意力层中，没有一致的层特定趋势。与图像和语言领域不同，表格数据集中各注意力头的重要性随数据集模式与特征空间的不同而差异显著。

Conclusion: 所提出的重要性评分能够提升Transformer架构的效率和冗余度，并为表格数据领域中的Transformer模型可解释性提供了新的视角。源代码已公开供社区使用。

Abstract: Computationally demanding and opaque deep learning models can be better understood and optimized by analyzing how they transform data. While deep transformers have been widely studied in computer vision and natural language processing, their application in tabular data remains relatively underexplored. This paper presents one of the first applications of an importance-scoring metric to interpret multi-head transformer models in learning from tabular data. Experiments conducted on 40 diverse tabular datasets demonstrate robustness to head drops based on the proposed head importance score. In 72.5\% of experimental examples, the model remains most resilient to performance drops when heads with the lowest importance scores are gradually removed. In contrast, removing the most important attention head first results in the greatest reduction in classification performance. A closer look at individual head importance scores across six attention layers reveals that important heads are scattered across layers, with no consistent layer-specific trends. In contrast to the image and language domains, the importance of individual attention heads varies considerably across tabular datasets with different schemas and feature spaces. The proposed importance score can improve efficiency and redundancy within transformer architectures. We make the source code for measuring the importance of individual attention heads publicly available.

</details>


### [289] [Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27254)
*Sai Adith Senthil Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Circuit Condensation（电路冷凝）方法，通过对模型进行后训练来将行为集中到更小的因果图中，从而生成比冻结基线小8.1倍（最高316倍）的压缩电路。该方法在四种行为、八种模型上验证，且生成电路能跟踪原模型的下一词分布并预测其错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的冻结发现方法（frozen discovery）通常返回数百条边，使得电路难以检查、比较和穷尽验证。机械可解释性需要更小而可验证的因果电路来理解模型行为。

Method: 每轮迭代中：（1）剪除低归因（low-attribution）边；（2）训练低秩适配器（low-rank adapter）通过剩余路径匹配原始模型输出；（3）仅当任务性能和通用能力保持时保留剪除结果。该方法在搜索过程中包含权重更新，区别于仅搜索不更新的基线。

Result: 在32个设置中的30个中，冷凝电路比最强冻结基线更小，平均缩小8.1倍，最高达316倍。无权重更新的重复搜索在32个设置中的29个中产生更大电路，证明权重更新是缩减的主要驱动力。测试19个电路的全部子集发现11个不可再缩减，其余存在可移除边。在间接宾语识别任务上，冷凝将电路隔离为24个注意力头（其中17个有文献记载的角色），远优于冻结电路的61个头（36个未记载）。

Conclusion: Circuit Condensation能够生成充分且可验证的电路，是对已发表机制的充分子电路而非其重构。成对消融研究揭示边之间存在依赖关系，说明电路的效应不能独立理解，冷凝电路能跟踪原模型下一词分布并预测其错误。

Abstract: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task performance and general capability survive. Across four behaviors and eight models, condensed circuits are smaller than the strongest frozen baseline in 30 of 32 settings, by $8.1\times$ on average and up to $316\times$. Repeating the search without weight updates produces larger circuits in 29 of 32 settings, showing that weight updates, rather than search alone, drive the reduction. Testing every subset of 19 circuits finds 11 that cannot be reduced and reveals removable edges in the rest. Pair ablations expose dependencies between edges, showing that their effects cannot be understood independently. On indirect object identification, condensation isolates 24 heads, 17 of them with documented roles, against 61 heads and 36 undocumented ones for the matched frozen circuit: a sufficient sub-circuit of the published mechanism rather than a reconstruction of it. The resulting circuit tracks the original model's next-token distribution and predicts its errors.

</details>


### [290] [Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27259)
*Xiaoxiao Lu,Yunlong Dong,Jiahao Shi,Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEON（潜在演化算子网络），将世界行动模型中的潜在状态转移实现视为独立于预测表示和预测-策略耦合的架构选择，通过基于受控Koopman生成器视角的算子传播和加性强迫建模潜在演化，在两种WAM框架下提升闭环性能与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在世界行动模型广泛采用基于Transformer的预测器，其归纳结构聚焦于token交互而非时间演化，导致潜在转移的实现方式与任务所需的时序动态建模不匹配。作者认为转移实现本身是一个被忽视但有重要影响的架构选择，值得独立研究。

Method: LEON在学得的可观测空间中，通过上下文调制的算子传播和加性强迫来建模潜在演化。该方法以受控Koopman生成器视角为理论基础，将上下文相关的转移变化组织在共享的演化算子结构周围，同时保留加性变化作为互补路径。

Result: 受控动力系统实验验证了演化特异的归纳偏置以及算子传播和强迫的互补作用。在两种不同的WAM公式中，LEON均提升了闭环性能和鲁棒性，且在完全替换转移模块时仍然有效。

Conclusion: 实验结果确立了转移实现是潜在WAM中一个具有重要影响的架构选择，LEON为潜在状态转移提供了一种优于Transformer基础方案的结构化建模方式。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.

</details>


### [291] [MM-Spectrum: Multimodal Multi-spectral Molecular Structural Elucidation with a Stable MoE Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27286)
*Hai-tao Yu,Nan Min,Zheng Fang,Hongyu Zhan,Yusen Tan,Yuhan Wang,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MM-Spectrum，一个基于稀疏混合专家（MoE）的多模态多光谱分子结构解析框架，通过显式模态感知路由机制和共享/交互专家设计，解决多模态光谱中异构性和模态不平衡导致的性能退化问题，在多种模态组合和缺失模态场景下均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态光谱测量（如质谱、红外、核磁共振等）包含高度互补但异构的信号，直接拼接多光谱序列会导致模态不平衡和性能退化，需要专门的框架来解决这种异构性和不平衡问题。

Method: MM-Spectrum采用稀疏MoE框架：(1) 显式模态感知路由机制，在路由时同时暴露光谱身份和token内容表示；(2) 共享专家与交互专家结合，配合异构专家容量设计，提取模态特有信息和跨模态协同信息，同时抑制噪声干扰。

Result: 在全模态、双模态和缺失模态设置的分子结构解析任务中，MM-Spectrum均实现了一致且显著的性能提升，并通过消融实验和可解释性分析验证了各组件有效性。

Conclusion: MM-Spectrum有效解决了多光谱模态不平衡下的性能退化问题，通过模态感知路由和共享/交互专家设计实现了跨模态信息的高效整合，为多模态光谱分子结构解析提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Inferring molecular structures from multimodal spectroscopic measurements requires integrating complementary yet highly heterogeneous signals. However, the common paradigm of directly concatenating multispectral sequences can exhibit anomalous performance degradation, primarily due to pronounced heterogeneity and the resulting multimodal imbalance across modalities. As a remedy, we propose MM-Spectrum, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework tailored for multimodal multispectral spectra-to-structure elucidation. To better match the information characteristics under multispectral imbalance, MM-Spectrum introduces an explicit modality-aware routing mechanism that exposes spectral identity to the router in addition to token content representations. Moreover, it incorporates shared and interaction experts, together with heterogeneous expert capacities, to extract multispectral modality-unique and cross-modal synergistic information while suppressing noise-induced interference. Across full-modality, bimodal, and missing-modality settings on molecular structural elucidation, MM-Spectrum achieves consistent and substantial improvements, supported by ablation studies and interpretability analyses.

</details>


### [292] [QuantumBoostNet: A Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Enhanced Accuracy in Cardiac Ultrasound View Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27302)
*Mihai Udrescu-Milosav,Stefan-Alexandru Jura,Mihai Udrescu,Gerhard-Paul Diller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QuantumBoostNet，一种用于超声心动图视角识别的混合经典-量子架构，通过经典骨干网络与10量子比特参数化量子电路的结合，在心脏超声视图识别任务上超越现有最优模型并展现出良好的噪声鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心脏超声（超声心动图）中正确视角/角度的识别对精确解剖解释、可靠测量和减少临床错误至关重要。尽管计算机视觉已取得显著进展，但最先进的模型在标准基准上表现良好，在面对医学影像任务中高噪声数据时往往产生次优结果，因此需要更鲁棒、更精确的专用模型。

Method: QuantumBoostNet采用混合经典-量子架构：包含一个经典骨干网络和两个输出头（一个经典头和一个量子头），其中量子头由参数化的10量子比特量子电路实现。训练分两个阶段进行，通过一个混合参数监测损失动态，在两个头之间进行自适应过渡。

Result: 大量实验表明，尽管可模拟的量子比特数量有限，QuantumBoostNet在心脏超声视图识别任务上始终优于最先进的经典模型和混合经典-量子模型，实现了相对于最优竞争者的相对改进。该模型还在已建立的图像分类基准上展现出优越性能，并表现出对噪声的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持混合经典-量子模型在专科医学影像应用中的持续发展，QuantumBoostNet的成功验证了量子计算与经典深度学习结合在提高医学影像分析精度和鲁棒性方面的潜力。

Abstract: Accurate identification of the correct view or angle in cardiac ultrasound (echocardiogram) is a critical component of cardiologic imaging. This step is essential for precise anatomical interpretation, reliable measurement, and the reduction of clinical errors. Although computer vision has advanced significantly, most state-of-the-art models perform well on standard benchmarks but often yield suboptimal results in specialized medical imaging tasks due to the high level of noise present in the data. QuantumBoostNet, a hybrid classical-quantum architecture, is introduced to address these challenges. This model integrates a classical backbone with two heads: one classical and one quantum, with the quantum head implemented as a parametrized 10-qubit quantum circuit. Training occurs in two stages, with an adaptive transition between heads governed by a mixing parameter that monitors loss dynamics. Extensive experiments indicate that, despite the limited number of qubits that can be simulated, QuantumBoostNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art classical and hybrid classical-quantum models in cardiac ultrasound view identification, achieving a relative improvement over the best competitor. QuantumBoostNet also demonstrates superior performance on established image classification benchmarks and exhibits robustness to noise. These findings support the continued development of hybrid classical-quantum models for specialized medical imaging applications.

</details>


### [293] [Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27339)
*Xinwei Qiang,Xiang Fang,Chang Chen,Yue Guan,Yufei Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过引入"信息下限"（information floor）概念，将块草稿（block drafting）中拒绝率分解为信息下限和模型差距两部分，从而区分短程条件信息的价值与提案模型的质量。在四个域、四个开源目标和前沿API目标上的实验表明：全并行下限在最终槽位可达0.286，单个已实现token可消除86-100%的下限，而当前草稿器仍远高于其下限，后半段slot的模型差距占DFlash拒绝率的43-64%和DSpark oracle条件拒绝率的85-92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块草稿方法在一次前向传播中提出多个token，但其拒绝率混合了两种不同来源的损失：缺失块内路径信息（within-block path information）和对可观测信息建模不完美（imperfect modelling）。现有的接受长度指标无法区分这两种损失，导致无法准确评估提案质量与条件信息价值。

Method: 作者引入"信息下限"（information floor）的概念，定义为在指定条件顺序下最小期望拒绝率。总拒绝率减去信息下限即"模型差距"（model gap）。两者均通过目标回滚（target rollouts）进行估计。实验覆盖四个域，测试了四个开源权重目标模型和一个前沿API目标模型。

Result: 三个主要发现：（1）全并行下限在Qwen3-4B最终槽位达到0.286，即最优提案的每槽位接受率上限为71%；（2）单个已实现token可消除86-100%的信息下限，这一局部性也被独立的互信息分析所证实；（3）当前草稿器仍远高于其下限：最终槽位的模型差距占DFlash拒绝率的43-64%，占DSpark oracle条件拒绝率的85-92%。

Conclusion: 这些发现将短程条件信息（short-range conditioning）的价值与提案质量分开，表明信息下限本身对块草稿形成了硬性约束，而现有草稿器在质量上仍存在巨大的改进空间，尤其是DSpark在oracle条件下的大部分拒绝源自模型差距而非信息下限。

Abstract: Block drafters propose several tokens in one forward pass, before earlier target tokens are realised. Their rejection mixes two losses: missing within-block path information and imperfect modelling of observable information. Accepted length cannot distinguish them. We separate the two with an information floor, the minimum expected rejection at a specified conditioning order; rejection above this floor is the model gap. Estimating both from target rollouts across four domains, four open-weight targets, and a frontier API target yields three findings. First, the all-parallel floor reaches $0.286$ at the final slot on Qwen3-4B, limiting even the best proposal to $71\%$ per-slot acceptance. Second, one realised token removes $86$--$100\%$ of this floor, a locality also recovered by an independent mutual-information analysis. Third, current drafters remain far above their floors: the final-slot model gap accounts for $43$--$64\%$ of DFlash rejection and $85$--$92\%$ of DSpark's oracle-conditioned rejection. These findings separate the value of short-range conditioning from proposal quality.

</details>


### [294] [Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27351)
*Yunpeng Ba,Zhi Zheng,Yue Xie,Jiaqing Li,Xialiang Tong,Tao Zhong,Mingxuan Yuan,Zhichao Lu,Xuyang Wu,Zhenkun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了Evolution Strategies (ES)作为LLM推理后训练范式的优化行为，发现ES相比GRPO具有更广的推理覆盖范围（更高的Pass@K），同时保持Pass@1性能；ES的性能增益仅来自少量大幅更新的稀疏子集，不会导致灾难性遗忘；ES在更大模型上需要更小的种群规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ES作为一种内存高效的后训练范式已崭露头角，但其优化行为尚未被充分研究，难以明确其与主流后训练范式（如GRPO）相比的优势范围。本文旨在系统性地分析ES的动力学与机制，厘清其适用场景。

Method: 1) 理论分析：推导验证器投影下的Jensen-Shannon多样性对Pass@K性能的帮助；2) 系统实验对比ES与GRPO的优化动态，包括熵塌缩、Pass@1和Pass@K指标；3) 提出顺序GRPO-ES训练策略结合两者优势；4) 分析ES参数漂移与功能性稀疏性；5) 研究超参数（种群规模）在不同模型规模下的影响。

Result: 1) 理论上和实证上都证明ES比GRPO具有更广的推理覆盖，可获得更高的Pass@K；2) GRPO出现熵塌缩而ES在维持Pass@1的同时获得更高的Pass@K；3) GRPO-ES顺序训练策略可同时兼顾两者的优势；4) ES的收益仅来自少量大幅更新，功能性稀疏，大面积参数移动不等于广泛功能变化，不会导致灾难性遗忘；5) 更大LLM需要更小的ES种群规模。

Conclusion: ES应被视为一种独特的推理后训练范式，而非GRPO的低效、内存节约型替代方案，其独特优势在于更广的推理覆盖和功能性稀疏的参数更新特征。

Abstract: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reasoning coverage, thereby better exploiting the reasoning capabilities of pretrained LLMs. Theoretically, we show that verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity across the ES population is helpful to higher Pass@K performances. Empirically, unlike GRPO, which exhibits entropy collapse, ES improves Pass@1 while attaining higher Pass@K than GRPO. We further develop a sequential GRPO-ES training strategy that combines GRPO's strength in Pass@1 with ES's gains in Pass@K. Second, we find that despite substantial whole-model parameter drift, the task-performance gains of ES are only contributed to a sparse subset of larger-magnitude updates. This functional sparsity suggests that large parameter movement need not imply widespread functional change, and held-out evaluations further show that it does not necessarily lead to catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we study how hyperparameter design affects the effectiveness of ES, demonstrating that ES requires a smaller population size in a larger LLM. These findings position ES as a distinct reasoning post-training paradigm rather than a less effective, memory-efficient alternative to GRPO.

</details>

### [295] [Learning Interpretable Tumor Microenvironment Representations by Fitting Pan-Cancer Cell State-Niche Correlation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26208)
*Xiao Xiao,Jiashu He,Shiyang Zhang,Meiyi Mao*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 提出了GITIII-scale，一个可解释的泛癌空间转录组基础模型，用于肿瘤微环境（TME）表示学习，能够研究细胞状态-生态位关联及其潜在的配体-受体（LR）信号通路。该模型利用Transformer建模空间距离内的细胞对相互作用，通过可解释的单层图Transformer（无前馈网络）分解受体细胞中每个基因如何受邻近供体细胞影响，并通过图Transformer生成细胞邻域嵌入。在泛癌数据库中训练后，模型在未见癌症类型上比现有空间转录组基础模型更准确地恢复生态位相关的细胞状态变化，并在乳腺癌案例中识别出与内皮过度生长和肿瘤发生相关的潜在靶向药物LR通路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤微环境中细胞状态受邻近细胞的细胞-细胞相互作用（CCIs）影响，识别与致病过程相关的失调CCIs对药物靶点发现至关重要。然而，成像型空间转录组学和单细胞RNA测序分别提供空间信息和全转录组测量，单独使用均不足以同时获得两者信息；现有空间转录组基础模型无法有效从空间分辨的全转录组单细胞数据中学习，也无法显式推断驱动细胞状态-生态位关联的CCI机制，且缺乏足够的可解释性来支持直接的生物学解释。

Method: GITIII-scale采用层级架构：1）使用Transformer在定义的空间距离内建模细胞对之间的相互作用；2）使用不含前馈网络的可解释单层图Transformer，将受体细胞中每个基因的表达分解为来自各邻近供体细胞的影响；3）使用图Transformer生成细胞邻域嵌入。模型在配对的scRNA-seq和成像型空间转录组数据集组成的泛癌数据库上进行训练。

Result: 在训练中未见过的癌症类型上，GITIII-scale生成的TME嵌入比现有空间转录组基础模型更准确地恢复了生态位相关的细胞状态变化。在未见过的乳腺癌数据集的案例研究中，模型成功识别出与内皮过度生长和肿瘤发生相关的潜在药物靶向LR通路，展示了其可解释性和实际应用价值。

Conclusion: GITIII-scale是首个能够同时实现层级化、可解释的泛癌空间转录组基础模型，它不仅提升了TME表示的准确性，还能显式推断CCI机制（LR信号通路），为药物靶点发现提供了可解释的生物学见解，具有跨癌症类型的泛化能力。

Abstract: In the tumor microenvironment, cell's state is influenced by cell-cell interactions (CCIs) with neighboring cells in its niches. Identifying dysregulated CCIs that are associated with pathogenic process pinpoints targets for drug discovery. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics and single-cell RNA sequencing provide, respectively, single-cell spatial information and transcriptome-wide measurements needed to study CCIs, but neither modality provides both. Existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models also cannot effectively learn from spatially resolved single-cell data with full-transcriptome coverage, explicitly infer the CCI mechanisms driving cell state-niche associations, or interpretable enough to support direct biological interpretations. Here, we present GITIII-scale, a hierarchical, interpretable pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics foundation model for TME representation learning that investigates cell state-niche associations and their underlying ligand-receptor (LR) signaling pathways. GITIII-scale uses transformers to model interactions between pairs of cells at defined spatial distances, an interpretable single-layer graph transformer without a feed-forward network to decompose how each gene in a receiver cell is influenced by each neighboring sender cell, and a graph transformer to generate cellular-neighborhood embeddings. Trained on our assembled pan-cancer database of specimen-matched scRNA-seq and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets, GITIII-scale generated TME embeddings that recovered niche-associated state changes more accurately than existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models in cancer types unseen during training. A case study of an unseen breast cancer dataset further demonstrated the model's interpretability by identifying potentially drug-targetable LR pathways associated with endothelial overgrowth and tumorigenesis.

</details>

### [296] [Hysteresis and multistability in network spreading with neuronal activity feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26528)
*Christoffer G. Alexandersen,Dani S. Bassett*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文研究了网络传播过程与共同演化的活动过程之间的非线性反馈耦合，证明非线性反馈可在SIS传播模型中产生有限振幅入侵阈值、迟滞和多稳态，并通过多项式耦合函数的度约束了内稳态数量，在二次积分放电（QIF）神经元网络的随机尖峰模拟中验证了理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经退行性疾病中病理蛋白的传播与神经元活动构成反馈回路，但现有模型大多假设两个过程之间为线性反馈。作者希望探究非线性反馈是否会从根本上改变传播动力学行为，从而更好地理解大脑健康和疾病之间的转换机制。

Method: 作者将SIS传播过程与共同演化的活动过程耦合，在一般加权网络上分析反馈强度与形状对入侵动力学的影响；在规则图上利用多项式耦合函数进行数学分析，推导内稳态数量的上界；最后通过随机尖峰的二次积分放电（QIF）神经元网络模拟验证理论预测。

Result: 非线性反馈可产生有限振幅入侵阈值、迟滞现象和内稳态多稳态；正则图上排除了周期解，多项式耦合度约束了内稳态数量，单调耦合需要增强性反馈才能产生多稳态；QIF神经元网络的随机模拟中同时恢复了有限振幅入侵阈值和内生双稳态。

Conclusion: 活动过程的反馈可以在网络传播动力学中创造迟滞和多稳态。在神经科学应用中，神经元动力学可能作为神经退行性疾病的控制点，即使活动状态的短暂变化也可能使大脑在健康和疾病之间翻转。

Abstract: Spreading processes on networks often interact with other dynamics on the same nodes. Neurodegenerative disease provides one example: pathological proteins spread through anatomical connections, while neuronal activity influences and is altered by their spread, forming a spreading-activity feedback loop. However, models coupling pathological protein spreading and neuronal activity have largely focused on linear feedback between the two processes. Here we show that nonlinear feedback can fundamentally change the invasion dynamics in a susceptible--infected--susceptible spreading process coupled to a co-evolving activity process. On general weighted networks, the strength and shape of the feedback may generate finite-amplitude invasion thresholds, hysteresis, and endemic multistability. On regular graphs with homogeneous dynamics, we rule out periodic solutions and show that the degrees of polynomial coupling functions bound the number of endemic states, while monotone couplings require reinforcing feedback for multistability. We test these predictions in simulations of a stochastic spiking neuronal network described by quadratic integrate-and-fire dynamics, where we recover both finite-amplitude invasion thresholds and endemic bistability. These results show that feedback from activity processes can create hysteresis and multistability in network spreading dynamics. In neuroscientific applications, our work suggests that neuronal dynamics may act as a control point in neurodegenerative disease, with even transient changes in activity capable of tipping the brain between health and disease.

</details>


### [297] [Beta oscillation changes in ALS: A Dual-Site International Replication Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27003)
*Marit Boxum,Gabriel Rodrigues Palma,Robin Jansen,Iris A. Bastmeijer,Sanya Dalal,Eva Woods,Narin Suleyman,Eileen Rose Giglia,Aoife Troy,Abby Field,Serena Plaitano,Marjorie Metzger,Niall Pender,Orla Hardiman,Leonard H. van den Berg,Roisin McMackin,Stefan Dukic*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究在荷兰和爱尔兰两个独立队列中验证了ALS患者在执行持续注意力反应任务(SART)时的脑电事件相关去同步化(ERD)和事件相关同步化(ERS)模式。虽然对照组在两个队列中都表现出可重复的theta ERS、alpha/beta ERD和beta ERS模式，但ALS组与对照组之间的差异仅在爱尔兰队列中复制，而非荷兰队列，部分反映了队列间功能损伤程度的差异。研究支持将ERD/ERS指标作为ALS运动功能衰退的可靠脑电标记。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ALS患者需要可重复的生物标志物来监测运动和认知功能障碍。此前研究报道了ALS患者SART任务中frontal和parietal通道的beta频段ERD减弱和运动后ERS衰减，但尚需在独立队列中验证这些发现的可靠性，以确认其作为临床生物标志物的价值。

Method: 在荷兰（ALS n=63，匹配对照n=64）和爱尔兰（ALS n=36，对照n=36）两个队列中进行随机SART任务，使用128通道脑电图(EEG)记录。采用复Morlet小波对非锁相活动进行时频分析，计算基线归一化的任务后ERD和ERS，比较Go和NoGo试验中组间差异及EEG与任务表现的关联。

Result: 两个对照队列均一致地引出theta ERS、alpha和beta ERD及反弹beta ERS，且NoGo比Go试验表现出更强的theta ERS、更强的alpha ERD和更弱的beta ERS。与先前阴性发现不同，ALS患者在两个中心均显示出降低的Go和总正确率(p<0.002)，爱尔兰队列中Go反应时间更慢(p=0.02)。爱尔兰ALS队列复制了先前工作中beta ERD和ERS减弱的发现，但荷兰队列未发现此差异。两个中心中更强的beta ERS均与更快的Go反应相关(p<0.011)。

Conclusion: 对照组发现可重复且与运动表现的一致性关联表明EEG能够可靠捕获皮层运动网络功能异常，支持ERD/ERS指标作为ALS运动功能衰退的脑电标志物。但跨队列的差异提示需考虑功能损伤程度等混杂因素，未来应用这些生物标志物时应注意队列间特征的标准化。

Abstract: Reproducible biomarkers that monitor motor and cognitive dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are needed. Previous work reported reduced beta-band event-related desynchronization (ERD) and attenuated post-movement event-related synchronization (ERS) in frontal and parietal channels during the sustained attention to response task (SART). We aimed to validate these findings in Dutch and Irish cohorts. A randomized SART with 128-channel electroencephalography (EEG) was performed in Dutch (ALS n=63; matched controls n=64) and Irish (ALS n=36; controls n=36) cohorts. Non-phase-locked activity was quantified using complex Morlet wavelets to compute baseline-normalized post-stimulus ERD and ERS. Group differences and EEG associations with task performance were examined for Go and NoGo trials. In both control cohorts, the SART elicited theta ERS and alpha- and beta-band ERD, followed by rebound beta ERS across the frontoparietal axis, with greater theta ERS, stronger alpha ERD, and weaker beta ERS on NoGo than Go trials. In contrast to previous null findings, people with ALS showed reduced Go and total accuracy in both centres (p<0.002) and slower Go responses in the Irish cohort (p=0.02). The ALS cohorts differed in NoGo accuracy, Go response time, and anticipation errors (all p=0.03). Replicating prior work, the Irish ALS cohort showed reduced beta ERD and ERS versus controls, with no such differences in the Dutch cohort. Greater beta ERS was associated with faster Go responses in both centres (p<0.011). ERD and ERS changes replicated in the Irish but not the Dutch cohort. Cohort differences in these metrics reflected, at least in part, varying functional impairment. Reproducible control findings and consistent associations with motor performance indicate reliable capture of cortical motor network dysfunction, supporting these measures as EEG markers of motor decline in ALS.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [298] [Ankhdjet: An Open-Source Compiler for Mask-Programmed Ternary Compute-in-ROM on an Open PDK](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26206)
*Mohnish Pai*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Ankhdjet，一个开源编译器，可将HuggingFace三元量级检查点（BitNet b1.58等）编译为固定compute-in-ROM宏的via-mask程序，使用开放SKY130 PDK完成全开源的权重到掩码编译流程，并通过完整开源工具链signoff（含DRC、LVS、时序）验证。这是首个在可制造开放PDK上实现的开源权重到掩码compute-in-ROM编译器，也是首个在开放PDK上提交制造的compute-in-ROM宏（TinyTapeout/ChipFoundry SKY130 shuttle，预计2027年流片）。编译器采用全数字读取（全摆幅位线采样），替代模拟比较器读出方案，面积缩小至八分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型推理受权重移动（weight movement）主导——每生成一个token都要重新读取所有权重。三元量化（BitNet b1.58）将每个权重压缩至1.58比特，在2B参数规模达到与全精度相当的性能，使得将权重硬连到只读掩码中成为可行方案。商用芯片Taalas HC1已在先进节点验证了硬连线权重的可行性，但使用封闭工具链。本文旨在探究模型专用硅片能否完全基于开放基础设施实现可复现的制造流程。

Method: 本文提出Ankhdjet开源编译器，将HuggingFace三元检查点（BitNet b1.58）编译为开放SKY130 PDK上固定compute-in-ROM宏的via-mask程序。读取方式完全数字化（全摆幅位线采样进入标准单元，可通过综合发射到任意节点）；同时保留模拟比较器读出作为已测量的变体，但被数字读出替代（面积仅为前者的八分之一）。编译器流程两次使用不同权重矩阵，通过完全相同流程验证（仅掩码不同），并通过完整开源工具链signoff（KLayout DRC零错误、netgen LVS零错误、时序干净）。此外采用逐层对抗性验证方法论，捕获了三个DRC不可见的静默短路。

Result: 编译器通过两次不同的权重矩阵在完全相同的流程中完成signoff（DRC零、LVS零、时序干净），是首个在开放PDK上提交制造的compute-in-ROM宏（TinyTapeout/ChipFoundry SKY130 shuttle ttsky26c，预计2027年流片）。逐层对抗性验证捕获了三个DRC不可见的静默短路。在130nm工艺下在每晶体管存储两个三元权重的方案结果是否定（失败）。读取能量来自提取寄生参数仿真（每次感知权重0.98-1.73 pJ），未声称实际能量测量。在130nm下验证了模拟感知技术的存活情况。

Conclusion: Ankhdjet证明了模型专用硅片可以在完全开放的基础设施上实现可复现的制造，从三元权重到掩码编译、验证到流片提交均可通过开放工具链完成。数字读出替代模拟读出将面积缩减至八分之一。制造载体为演示验证用途，未声称能量测量结果，实际硅片预计2027年返回。

Abstract: Large-language-model inference is dominated by weight movement: every generated token re-reads every weight. Ternary quantization (BitNet b1.58) shrinks each weight to 1.58 bits with reported parity at the 2B-parameter scale, small enough that hardwiring the weights into a read-only mask becomes plausible, and a commercial chip (Taalas HC1) has validated hardwired weights on an advanced node behind closed tooling. This paper asks whether model-specific silicon can be made reproducible with entirely open infrastructure. We present Ankhdjet, an open-source compiler that lowers a HuggingFace ternary checkpoint (BitNet b1.58 and its kin) to a via-mask program of a fixed compute-in-ROM macro on the open SKY130 PDK, verified end to end with open tools. We defend two claims: (1) the first open-source weights-to-mask compute-in-ROM compiler on a fabricable open PDK, taken through full open-toolchain signoff (KLayout DRC zero, netgen LVS zero, clean timing) twice with two different weight matrices through an identical flow in which only the mask differs; and (2) the first compute-in-ROM macro submitted for fabrication on an open PDK (TinyTapeout/ChipFoundry SKY130 shuttle ttsky26c, silicon expected 2027). The compiler's read is fully digital (full-swing bitline sampling into standard cells, so the emission ports to any node by synthesis); an analog comparator readout of the same machine is retained as a measured variant, replaced by the digital readout at one eighth the area. We additionally report the per-level adversarial verification methodology that caught three DRC-invisible silent shorts, a negative result on storing two ternary weights per transistor at 130 nm, and which analog sense techniques survive at which nodes. Read energy is from extracted-parasitic simulation (0.98-1.73 pJ per sensed weight); no energy measurements are claimed, and the fabricated vehicles are demonstrators.

</details>


### [299] [MeshReduce-U: Compiler-Guided Communication Reduction for Irregular Neural Reductions on Mesh NoCs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26220)
*Amirreza Khorasanian*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MeshReduce-U是一个面向网格NoC空间加速器的编译器引导通信缩减与路由框架，通过对不规则神经网络工作负载中的偏斜多对一归约进行结构重写（合并源、形成聚合岛、阻塞通道、选择汇点），在路由前消除流量，相比基线平均降低延迟40.3%、总链路使用56.0%和融合链路使用48.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多不规则的神经网络工作负载会产生偏斜的多对一归约，伴随重复邻域和非局部通信。传统的NoC映射器针对固定通信图优化布线和路由，但结合归约实际上提供了在路由前消除流量的合法机会，这个问题尚未被充分利用。

Method: MeshReduce-U包含五个关键步骤：1) 合并共置源节点；2) 形成局部聚合岛；3) 阻塞具有兼容扇入结构的通道；4) 选择容量可行的汇点；5) 使用融合的使用感知成本对剩余的固定宽度载体进行路由。同时引入确定性路由重放模型，分别报告调度导出的通信延迟、总链路使用量（TLU）和融合链路使用量（FusedTLU）。

Result: 在20个可降维的神经网络工作负载集合上，相比ABC风格源聚合基线，MeshReduce-U平均降低延迟40.3%、TLU 56.0%、FusedTLU 48.7%，且每个工作负载三个指标均有改善。在40个合成不规则归约上平均降低延迟12.3%和TLU 19.7%。新的30实例逐遍研究显示结构重写将全局载体数量减少60.9%，重放延迟降低63.0%。

Conclusion: 在路由前对可归约的神经通信进行结构重写，比在未缩减的流量图上进行更深入的搜索更有效。这验证了编译器引导的通信缩减策略在网格NoC空间加速器上的显著优势。

Abstract: Many irregular neural workloads induce skewed many-to-one reductions with repeated neighborhoods and nonlocal communication. Conventional NoC mappers optimize placement and routes for a fixed communication graph, even though associative reductions expose legal opportunities to eliminate traffic before routing. We present MeshReduce-U, a compiler-guided communication-reduction and routing framework for mesh-NoC-based spatial accelerators.
  MeshReduce-U coalesces colocated sources, forms local aggregation islands, blocks channels with compatible fan-in structure, selects capacity-feasible sinks, and routes the remaining fixed-width carriers using fused usage-aware costs. A deterministic route-replay model reports schedule-derived communication latency, total link usage (TLU), and fused link usage (FusedTLU) separately.
  Across a 20-workload lowerable neural-network zoo, MeshReduce-U reduces mean latency, TLU, and FusedTLU by 40.3%, 56.0%, and 48.7%, respectively, relative to an ABC-style source-aggregation baseline, improving all three metrics on every workload. Across 40 synthetic irregular reductions, it reduces mean latency and TLU by 12.3% and 19.7%. A new 30-instance pass-by-pass study further shows that the structural rewrites reduce the global carrier count by 60.9% and replay latency by 63.0%. These results show that rewriting reducible neural communication before routing can be more effective than searching harder over an unreduced traffic graph.

</details>


### [300] [Beyond Edge Cuts: Activity-Weighted Multicast Hypergraph Mapping for Spiking Neural Networks on Mesh NoCs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26223)
*Amirreza Khorasanian*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: M-HySMap是一种路由感知、活动加权的多播超图映射框架，用于将脉冲神经网络映射到神经形态多核平台。其核心创新在于将每个源神经元视为向突触后扇出集合发送脉冲的有向超边，利用"移动一个神经元只影响其自身及其前驱的超边"这一局部性原理实现精确增量增益评估和路由贡献缓存。在115个作业的基准测试中，相比Activity+QAP基线降低了10.6-19.6%的路由多播跳数，比Edge+QAP降低19.7-41.1%，增量更新加速4.7-12.7倍且与全量重算数值一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SNN映射方法通常将问题抽象为图划分与两两放置代价，但这种抽象与物理通信事件不匹配：一个源神经元的脉冲会被投递到一组突触后目的地，且到多个目的地的路由可能共享网格链路。需要一种更贴合物理通信语义的映射框架。

Method: M-HySMap将每个源神经元建模为指向其突触后扇出的有向超边，以剖析活动性为权重。映射器从活动感知的图/QAP种子出发，优化目标包含目的核扇出、确定性网格路由并集以及链路拥塞。核心算法观察是局部性：移动一个神经元只改变其自身源根超边及其前驱的超边，从而在缓存所有未受影响路由贡献的同时进行精确增量增益评估。此外推导了保守的放置下界，并设计了分区与放置邻域组合以保留最优驻留解。

Result: 在115个作业（Potjans启发的递归SNN和4×4到6×6网格NoC外加7×7压力测试）上，M-HySMap比Activity+QAP减少10.6-19.6%的路由多播跳数，比Edge+QAP减少19.7-41.1%。增量更新使细化阶段加速4.7-12.7倍，同时与全量重计算在数值精度上完全一致。

Conclusion: 超图映射与路由感知的组合能显著优于传统图划分+QAP基线的映射质量，且利用局部性实现的高效增量更新使该方案在计算效率上具有实用性。

Abstract: Mapping spiking neural networks (SNNs) onto neuromorphic many-core platforms is often formulated with graph partitioning and pairwise placement costs. That abstraction is convenient, but it does not match the physical communication event: one spike from a source neuron is delivered to a set of postsynaptic destinations, and routes to several destinations can share mesh links. We present M-HySMap, a route-aware, activity-weighted multicast hypergraph mapping framework. Each source neuron induces a directed hyperedge to its postsynaptic fanout, weighted by profiled activity. The mapper starts from strong activity-aware graph/QAP seeds and then optimizes distinct destination-core fanout, the union of deterministic mesh routes, and link congestion. The central algorithmic observation is locality: moving one neuron can change only its own source-rooted hyperedge and the hyperedges of its predecessors. This permits exact incremental gain evaluation while caching every unaffected route contribution. We expose this combinatorial structure in detail, derive a conservative placement lower bound, and describe a portfolio of partition and placement neighborhoods that preserves the best incumbent. Across a 115-job evidence suite on Potjans-inspired recurrent SNNs and mesh NoCs from 4 x 4 to 6 x 6, plus a 7 x 7 stress case, M-HySMap reduces routed multicast hops by 10.6-19.6% over Activity+QAP and 19.7-41.1% over Edge+QAP. Incremental updates accelerate refinement by 4.7-12.7x while matching full recomputation to numerical precision.

</details>


### [301] [Redwood: A Frontier AI Accelerator Designed, Verified, and Deployed from Scratch in 2 Weeks by AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26418)
*Architect Labs*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个端到端AI系统，将软件到硅片的整个栈折叠为单一优化循环，实现硬件与软件的协同设计和验证。其首次演示为Redwood——一款面向物理AI的前沿推理加速器，由AI系统在两位人类架构师给定高层规格后，两周内自主生成性能模型、RTL设计、UVM环境、形式化证明、固件和内核，无需任何人工干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI工作负载与硬件演化的时间尺度不匹配：芯片架构定义到量产需要数年，而目标工作负载几个月就会变化。摩尔定律停滞下，专业化成为提升能效的主要手段，但现有的设计流程无法跟上工作负载的节奏，设计决策在深度不确定性下被提前锁定，并因"通用性余量"和"新负载映射到冻结硅片"而付出双重代价。

Method: 提出一个端到端AI系统，将软件到硅片的完整栈合并为单一优化循环，硬件与软件在同一目标下协同设计和验证。在两位人类架构师给出高层规格后，系统自主生成性能模型、RTL设计、UVM验证环境、形式化证明、固件和内核。商业EDA工具、专有形式化引擎和硬件在环验证共同确保每个模块达到95%覆盖率。规格变更可在48小时内重新验证并部署到硬件。

Result: Redwood在两周内以无人工干预方式完成设计，规格变更48小时内完成再验证和部署。其FPGA变体Redwood Nano可在超低功耗下运行Llama和Qwen等多亿参数模型。投影到三星8nm工艺（与Jetson Orin Nano同工艺类别）时，Redwood相比实测Jetson基线在相同模型上实现1.75倍吞吐量和1.9倍功耗降低，即3.4倍的性能功耗比提升。此外，运行在Redwood上的Qwen还参与了下一代Redwood的设计，向递归自我改进迈出一步。

Conclusion: 这是首个由AI系统端到端设计并运行现代AI模型的生产级AI加速器，证明AI系统可以以工作负载的节奏驱动芯片设计，将硬件设计周期从数年压缩到数周。Redwood的递归自我改进尝试（AI设计的芯片反过来辅助设计下一代芯片）为芯片设计的自动化循环提供了初步验证。

Abstract: Modern AI workloads and the hardware that runs them evolve on different timescales: architectural definition precedes volume silicon by years, while target workloads shift in months. Design decisions are therefore committed under deep uncertainty and paid for twice, once in the generality added as a hedge, and again when new workloads map poorly onto frozen silicon. As Moore's Law stagnates, specialization is the main remaining source of performance-per-watt and demands a design cycle that runs at the cadence of the workloads. We present an end-to-end AI system that collapses the software-to-silicon stack into a single optimization loop, where hardware and software are co-designed and verified under one objective. Its first demonstration is Redwood, a frontier AI accelerator built for single-batch, low-power, ultra-low-latency inference for physical AI. From a high-level specification by two human architects, the system autonomously generated the performance model, RTL design, UVM environments, formal proofs, firmware, and kernels in under two weeks with no human intervention below the specification. Every block reached 95% coverage via commercial EDA tools, our proprietary formal engine, and hardware-in-the-loop validation. Specification changes were reverified and redeployed to hardware in under 48 hours. Redwood Nano, its ultra-low-power FPGA variant, runs multi-billion-parameter models like Llama and Qwen. Projected onto Samsung 8 nm, the Jetson Orin Nano's process class, Redwood delivers 1.75x the throughput at 1.9x lower power, a 3.4x performance-per-watt gain against a measured Jetson baseline on the same models. Qwen running on Redwood also helped design next-generation Redwood, an early step toward recursive self-improvement. To our knowledge, this is the first production-worthy AI accelerator designed end-to-end by an AI system and running a modern AI model.

</details>


### [302] [HOLMES: In-Context Failure-Center Localization for High-Dimensional Yield Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26758)
*Wei W. Xing,Xixi Zhou,Kaiqi Huang,Jiaye Pan,Hong Qiu,Xin Wang,Shan Shen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: HOLMES是一种用于高sigma成品率估计的新方法，将失效中心定位重新构建为少样本二元分类问题，利用先验拟合的表格基础模型进行无梯度的上下文推理，结合基于SVD的各向异性提议分布和基于命中率的自适应混合方案，在高维SRAM基准（D=108至1,152）上保持5.9%以内的相对误差，相比最强基线（25.8%）有显著提升，且相比蒙特卡洛方法最高加速58.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高sigma成品率估计中，从严重不平衡的样本集中定位失效中心是核心挑战。现有基于代理模型的方法依赖迭代梯度训练，在极端类别不平衡下不适定，模型误差会传播到估计器中，导致高维场景下精度崩溃。

Method: 方法包含三个关键组件：(1) 将失效中心定位重新构建为少样本二元分类，使用先验拟合的表格基础模型进行无梯度、单次前向的上下文推理，规避不适定的训练循环；(2) 基于SVD的各向异性提议分布，捕获失效流形的局部几何结构；(3) 基于命中率的自适应混合机制，在传统自适应方法失效的地方稳定重要性权重。

Result: 在6T SRAM基准上覆盖D=108到D=1,152，全维度基线在不同维度出现精度崩溃，最强基线相对误差达25.8%；PCA+MNIS在最大两个维度额外评估。HOLMES在全部五个配置中保持5.9%以内的相对误差，相比蒙特卡洛实现最高58.8倍加速。

Conclusion: HOLMES通过将失效中心定位问题转化为少样本分类并利用基础模型的无梯度推理能力，有效解决了高维高sigma成品率估计中传统代理方法的不适应性和精度崩溃问题，在精度和计算效率上均显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Importance sampling for high-sigma yield estimation requires locating the failure center from a severely imbalanced sample set. Existing surrogate-assisted methods rely on iterative gradient-based training, ill-posed under extreme class imbalance; model errors propagate into the estimator, causing accuracy collapse in high dimensions. We recast failure-center localization as few-shot binary classification: a prior-fitted tabular foundation model performs gradient-free in-context inference in a single forward pass, eliminating the ill-posed training loop. \textbf{HOLMES} (High-sigma Optimal Localization via Manifold Estimation and Sampling) pairs this with an SVD-based anisotropic proposal that captures the local geometry of the failure manifold, and a hit-rate-driven adaptive mixing scheme that stabilizes importance weights where conventional adaptation collapses. On 6T SRAM benchmarks spanning $D = 108$ to $D = 1{,}152$, full-dimensional baselines exhibit accuracy collapse at some dimension, with the strongest baseline reaching 25.8\% relative error; PCA+MNIS is additionally evaluated at the two largest dimensions. HOLMES remains within 5.9\% across all five configurations with up to $58.8\times$ speedup over Monte Carlo. The code is available on \href{https://github.com/IceLab-JCIE/ICE006-Yield-Holmes}

</details>


### [303] [LLMs in Digital EDA: A perspective on shifting roles from Generation to Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27184)
*Matthew Youngman,Cristian Sestito,Themis Prodromakis*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种分层视角来理解LLM在EDA中的应用：Generator（单次生成设计工件）、Agent（通过迭代工具反馈精炼输出）和Orchestrator（跨EDA阶段协调决策），并指出当前系统存在"语法陷阱"——模型被训练生成看似合理但不满足物理正确性的代码，且工具碎片化和设计上下文丢失阻碍了向工业级设计的扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EDA文献中，基于LLM的解决方案通常只辅助孤立的设计阶段或任务，这掩盖了能力涌现和系统扩展的驱动因素。作者希望通过一种统一的分层框架来揭示能力如何在系统中积累，并识别当前方法的根本性局限。

Method: 作者提出了一种三层级角色分类框架——Generator（一次性设计工件生成器）、Agent（借助迭代工具反馈进行精炼的智能体）和Orchestrator（跨EDA阶段协调决策的协调器）——用于系统地比较和分析已发表系统中的能力积累模式，并据此诊断当前方法的结构性障碍。
