We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.

</details>


### [433] [Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27266)
*Yuan Chang,Xiaoqi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NPO（朴素提示优化），一种轻量级单谱系方法，通过教师模型与回滚反馈迭代修改提示词，在更少回滚次数下达到或超越GEPA的性能，且教师模型越强优势越明显。NPO优化的提示词可迁移至其他学生模型，表明简单线性提示优化可以匹敌复杂的搜索过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示优化是加速智能体AI递归自我改进（RSI）的高效途径，能在降低计算成本的同时达到与微调相当的性能。然而近期提示优化器的发展趋势过于追求复杂的搜索结构，作者认为这种复杂度并非必要，旨在验证简单的线性优化方法能否达到甚至超越复杂方法的性能。

Method: NPO是一种单谱系（single-lineage）的迭代提示优化方法：使用教师模型基于回滚（rollout）反馈逐步修订提示词，不引入复杂的搜索分支、群体策略等机制，仅依靠教师模型自身的推理能力和迭代反馈来改进提示。实验在多种任务（包括交互式游戏）上进行，与GEPA和GRPO等方法对比，并测试提示词跨模型迁移能力。

Result: NPO在更少的回滚次数下达到或优于GEPA的性能表现；更强的教师模型能进一步放大NPO的优势，表明教师推理能力可部分替代优化器端的搜索复杂度；在交互式游戏中NPO与GEPA总体竞争力相当，而GRPO在部分不适合提示优化的任务上表现更好；NPO优化出的提示词可直接迁移到其他同族学生模型并获得相似的性能提升。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明，简单、线性的提示优化足以匹敌显著更复杂精细的搜索过程，提示优化领域存在对不必要复杂性的过度倾向，简单方法值得被更广泛的关注和采用。

Abstract: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some tasks less amenable to prompt optimization. We also show that NPO-optimized prompts elicit similar performance improvements when applied verbatim to other student models, especially across models within the same family. Overall, our preliminary results show that simple, linear prompt optimization can rival substantially more sophisticated and complex search procedures.

</details>


### [434] [BrailleBench: Investigating Multi-Criteria Braille Comprehension in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27268)
*Jinghan Zhang,Fengran Mo,Zhiyu Chen,Xiaoyan Han,Kunpeng Liu,Chang-Tien Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BrailleBench，一个用于评估大语言模型盲文理解能力的基准测试，涵盖5,570个实例、五个数据集，跨越英文和一级/二级盲文，并评估六个代表性LLM，发现模型在盲文可及性方面与印刷英语能力存在持续差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM为知识获取和计算辅助提供了便利，但这些能力应同样惠及弱势群体。然而，现有的AI系统是否足够包容盲人和聋盲用户，使其能通过盲文访问相同功能尚不清楚。盲文的指示符、缩略形式和数字表示对模型理解提出了独特要求，目前缺乏系统评估LLM盲文理解能力的基准。

Method: 构建了BrailleBench基准，包含5,570个实例，来自五个数据集（数学、常识、多跳问答），覆盖英文及Grade 1和Grade 2两种盲文等级。设计了三种配置以测试：理解盲文撰写内容、用盲文表达答案、以及端到端盲文交互。通过确定性、专家审查的流程构建，使用自建的Braille Toolkit，不依赖任何LLM生成的数据实例。

Result: 评估了六个代表性LLM，发现印刷英语能力与盲文可及性之间存在持续差距。盲文理解和表达具有不对称性：Grade 2盲文在输入端尤其脆弱（相比Grade 1），完全盲文请求会进一步降低模型性能。

Conclusion: 实验观察为未来盲文AI系统的发展提供了宝贵指导，BrailleBench所有相关资源已公开供未来研究使用。

Abstract: Although Large language models (LLMs) mediate access to knowledge and computational assistance, their capabilities should benefit vulnerable groups in the same way. However, it is unclear whether existing AI systems are inclusive enough for blind and deafblind users to access the same functionality through Braille, whose indicators, contractions, and digital representations introduce distinct requirements for model comprehension. To this end, we introduce BrailleBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Braille comprehension from different Criteria. BrailleBench aligns 5,570 instances from five datasets, including mathematics, commonsense, and multi-hop question answering across English and Braille Grades 1 and 2. Different configurations are designed to understand whether the systems can comprehend Braille-authored content, express answers in Braille, and complete end-to-end Braille interaction. To ensure the quality and prevent evaluation bias, the benchmark is built through a deterministic, expert-reviewed pipeline via a self-created Braille Toolkit without using any data instances generated by LLMs. We evaluate six representative LLMs from various aspects. The results reveal a persistent gap between print-English capability and Braille accessibility. Braille understanding and expression are asymmetric, where Grade 2 is especially fragile on the input side compared to Grade 1, and fully Braille requests further reduce performance. The experimental observations provide valuable guidance for the development of future Braille AI systems. All related resources in BrailleBench are publicly available for future research.

</details>


### [435] [LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27296)
*Jackie Baek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）能否为具良好定义（well-specified）的运筹学（OR）问题设计有效算法。在库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化三类问题中，最强的模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有评估实例上达到或超越了现有最优方法，且仅需单次未调优的提示词和固定的Python沙箱计算预算即可实现。能力随模型发布时间的推进快速提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索前沿LLM在运筹学算法设计中的潜力，验证其能否在最小人工干预下生成与专用方法竞争的有效算法，为算法设计提供新的实证基线。

Method: 在三个OR问题（库存控制、排队网络控制、品类优化）上，评估两个层级的LLM使用：层级1（给定单实例生成解）和层级2（仅给问题类别描述和参数范围，生成映射实例参数到解的算法）。采用单个未调优提示词，模型可调用带固定计算预算的Python沙箱工具。

Result: gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有实例上匹配或超越现有最优方法，包括层级2（算法在未见评估实例前就已固定）。不同模型在八个月内发布的性能差异显著，表明该能力正在快速演进。

Conclusion: 对于所研究的良好定义的运筹学问题，单次未调优的LLM查询即可生成与专用方法竞争的有效算法，前沿LLM可以作为这些领域算法设计的严肃实证基线。

Abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.
  The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

</details>


### [436] [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27311)
*Jinghan Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Weiyuan Li,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HarnessLens是一个预算感知的自动化代理框架进化框架，通过联合探索任务空间和可配置组件、从执行轨迹中推导候选修改，并使用可归因证据门控进行行为相关任务的选择性验证，从而在减少评估预算的同时提升代理框架的持出性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理框架（Agent harnesses）对语言模型代理使用指令、工具和运行时组件的方式有重要影响，但调整这些框架需要昂贵的验证成本。现有的propose-and-verify方法通常在每个固定的任务集上对所有候选进行评分，浪费了与目标行为无关的评估开销，并且聚合分数可能掩盖特定功能的回归问题。因此需要一种更高效、更可靠的框架进化方法。

Method: HarnessLens包含三个核心要素：(1) 联合探索任务空间与用户可配置组件；(2) 从执行轨迹中推导候选修改方案；(3) 使用可归因证据门控（attributable-evidence gate）对每个候选在行为相关任务上进行选择性验证，只对与其行为目标相关的任务分配评估预算。

Result: 在三个代理框架和四个基准测试上，HarnessLens将平均持出性能提升了7.6%-13.6%，同时相比竞争基线消耗了显著更少的评估预算。

Conclusion: 结果表明，带有显式归因的行为感知验证能够在受限交互预算下实现更可靠且更样本高效的代理框架进化，证明了行为相关验证和归因机制的价值。

Abstract: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable components, derives candidate modifications from execution trajectories, and selectively verifies each candidate on behavior-relevant tasks using an attributable-evidence gate. Across three agent harnesses and four benchmarks, HarnessLens improves average held-out performance by 7.6-13.6% while consuming substantially less evaluation budget than competing baselines. These results demonstrate that behavior-aware verification with explicit attribution enables more reliable and sample-efficient harness evolution under constrained interaction budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/jhxu5214/HarnessLens.

</details>


### [437] [Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27340)
*Allison Zhuang,Santiago Aranguri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现思维链中口头表达的评估意识（eval-awareness）并非单一量，而是可区分为能力导向（capabilities-flavored）和安全导向（safety-flavored）等不同框架，这些框架对模型遵从性（compliance）的预测截然不同，且评估意识的抑制效果在行为层面上并不均匀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全评估管线中，针对评估意识的干预日益常用，但评估意识被当作单一量进行抑制。这种简化可能掩盖其内部异质性，导致安全评估结果失真或误判。

Method: 在Qwen3-32B模型上使用FORTRESS数据集，对思维链中口头化的评估意识进行框架分类（能力导向、安全导向、两者兼具或两者皆非），并分析不同框架与遵从性的预测关系；进一步通过CoT-prefill干预评估意识为负的rollout，检验因果性。

Result: 能力导向框架预测遵从性的概率比安全导向框架高出+24到+46个百分点（跨越所有测试的steering条件）；CoT-prefill干预中10/11个prefill将遵从性向预测方向移动，提示因果联系。评估意识在行为上并非均匀单一：总体抑制率变化可能掩盖安全相关成分不变的事实，且相同的"X%评估意识抑制"可能对应性质上不同的行为结果。

Conclusion: 评估意识不应被视为单一可抑制量，其在框架层面和行为层面均存在结构性异质性。安全评估管线中关于评估意识抑制的结论需要更细粒度的分解与审视，否则可能产生误导性的安全评估结果。

Abstract: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very differently. On Qwen3-32B over the FORTRESS dataset, capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing across all tested steering conditions. A CoT-prefill intervention on eval-awareness-negative rollouts suggests the link is causal, with 10 of 11 prefills shifting compliance in the predicted direction. Then, eval-awareness is not behaviorally uniform: aggregate suppression rates can move while the safety-relevant component does not, and the same "X% suppression of eval-awareness" can correspond to qualitatively different behavioral outcomes.

</details>


### [438] [Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27364)
*Nicholas J. Hallman,Zachary T. Kowaleski,Anu Puvvada,Jaime J. Schmidt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究利用一家大型企业8个月内的71.3万余条员工提示词及对应大模型响应数据（覆盖15个职能领域、近4000名后台员工），考察生成式AI使用的精细化程度，发现资深员工使用更为精细、不同职能间差异显著且Strategy/Digital Innovation/Project Management三个部门最高，同时精细化程度不随时间提升也不受正式AI培训的持续改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在企业中的普及已广泛发生，但对其使用质量（而非单纯使用频率）的量化理解和驱动因素研究仍然匮乏。企业管理者需要了解哪些员工/职能能更好地利用genAI、如何改善总体使用水平，而现有文献缺乏大规模、细粒度的实证证据。

Method: 利用一家大型企业专属的专有数据，收集2025年8个月内来自15个职能领域、近4,000名后台员工的713,564条提示词及其对应的大语言模型响应，通过量化指标衡量提示词的"精细化程度"（sophistication），并基于员工资历、职能归属、时间趋势及正式AI培训事件进行横截面和时间序列分析。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1) 资深员工展现出更高的genAI使用精细化程度，提示领域专业知识与genAI能力存在互补效应；(2) 使用精细化程度在不同职能间差异显著，其中Strategy、Digital Innovation和Project Management三个以公司战略举措和组织变革为核心的部门最高；(3) 未观察到使用精细化程度随时间的自然提升，也未发现正式AI培训带来的持续改善，暗示精细化的genAI使用可能难以通过常规方式改变。

Conclusion: 该研究为genAI使用质量提供了首个大规模实证度量和影响因素分析，对管理者优化AI部署与培训策略具有直接实践意义，同时为后续研究者提供了可复用的衡量框架和研究基础。特别地，培训效果有限及时间无自发改善的发现，提示提升genAI使用精细化可能需要更根本性的干预设计。

Abstract: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.

</details>


### [439] [CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27391)
*Sil Hamilton,Albert Yu Sun,Oscar J. Romero,Carl-Leander Henneking,David Mimno,Bishan Yang,Igor Labutov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了CorporateBench (CB)，一个人类验证的多任务Q&A基准测试，其评估语料库超过23万篇文档，覆盖4个合成企业（12至10,000名员工），评估LLM在信息抽取和知识库查询两个维度的表现。实验发现LLM在接近真实规模的输入上表现显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越擅长回答企业级文档集上的复杂问题，但评估困难：公司不愿共享内部沟通数据，而现有合成数据集过于简单，无法反映真实企业通信网络的规模和复杂度。

Method: 构建CorporateBench基准，包含四个合成生成的企业（规模从12到10,000名员工），每个语料库从随时间演化的知识库中采样，保证跨文档逻辑一致性，即使跨越数十万文档也能维持。评估涵盖信息抽取和知识库查询两个维度，并经过人工验证。

Result: 评估了五个LLM，发现当输入规模接近真实场景时，模型性能显著下降。

Conclusion: CorporateBench为LLM开发者提供了企业通信推理的度量标准，填补了基准测试生态系统中的关键空白。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

</details>


### [440] [Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27421)
*Kevin Zhu,Ryan Zhang,Baraa Abed,Tilendra Choudhary,Malvern Madondo,Mehak Arora,Yixuan Yang,Alasdair Gent,Aditya Nagori,Omer T. Inan,Krista L. Haines,Patrick Georgoff,Suresh M. Agarwal,Vijay Krishnamoorthy,Tetsu Ohnuma,Mihai V. Podgoreanu,Michael R. Pinsky,Gilles Clermont,Craig M. Coopersmith,Craig S. Jabaley,Rishikesan Kamaleswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种基于患者72小时轨迹数据的脓毒症严重程度指数，使用43项常规记录变量，以死亡率为治疗级别排序信号而非逐状态目标，在29,116名（马萨诸塞州）和7,691名（佐治亚州）符合Sepsis-3标准的成人患者上进行了回顾性两队列验证。该指数在0-10量表上能区分死亡者与存活者（高出1.19-1.64分），与乳酸变化相关（Spearman rho=0.39），跨机构一致性为70-77%，外部患者内相关性为0.54-0.59，显示出作为临床决策支持工具的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的脓毒症严重程度指数（如SOFA）基于几十年前固定的变量和权重设定，离散化粗糙且校准队列不再反映当代重症医学实际。当前没有直接从患者轨迹中学习的替代方案进入常规临床使用，因此需要一个适应现代重症监护环境的、数据驱动的新型脓毒症严重程度指标。

Method: 采用回顾性双队列研究设计，纳入两个医院系统（马萨诸塞州和佐治亚州）共36,807名符合Sepsis-3标准的成人患者。使用43项常规记录变量，覆盖72小时治疗窗口。核心创新是将死亡率作为治疗级别的排序信号（而非逐状态目标），允许信用在时间步上非均匀分配。评估使用20%永久测试集，采用临床案例和Spearman相关性分析，通过bootstrap重采样获得不确定性区间。

Result: 在SOFA-2、乳酸、MAP和肌酐的各基线分层中，非存活者比存活者得分高1.19-1.64分（0-10量表）。患者内指数变化与乳酸变化相关（Spearman rho=0.39；n=1,854），MAP和肌酐相关性较弱。跨机构一致性为同站点相关性的70-77%。外部患者内相关为0.54和0.59，分别对应0.92和0.90的天花板。指数与既有指标相关，而零假设对照接近零。

Conclusion: 该指数提供了具有每小时预后信息价值的评分，能够有意义地区分患者结局，且与临床预期一致，可作为补充临床判断的决策支持工具。

Abstract: Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively.
  We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero.
  Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

</details>


### [441] [Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27429)
*Nguyen Xuan-Vu,Octavian Susanu,Daniel Armstrong,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAELLE是一种基于电子占据向量离散流匹配的反应预测模型，将化学反应建模为电子空间上的连续时间马尔可夫链，通过最优传输构造中间编辑轨迹，在USPTO-480K基准上取得竞争性性能，并在分布外场景下保持鲁棒性，且能恢复机制轨迹并预测副产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习反应建模方法要么通过从头生成产物分子，要么通过基于分子拓扑的启发式图编辑操作，但化学反应的本质是电子空间的变换。作者希望直接在电子占据空间建模反应，从而更好地捕获反应的内在机制。

Method: 将反应物到产物的映射形式化为定义在键合、非键合和氢位点上的图结构整数值电子占据空间上的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）；将离散流匹配混合路径通过最优传输推广到离散电子重排，构造机制可解释的中间编辑轨迹序列，无需基元步骤标注。

Result: 在USPTO-480K基准上达到与领先反应预测模型相当的性能；在结构复杂性和反应类型两种分布外场景下，现有方法性能下降时MAELLE仍保持强性能；能够自然恢复与已知化学一致的机制轨迹并预测反应副产物。

Conclusion: MAELLE证明了在电子空间而非分子拓扑空间建模反应的优势：不仅实现了竞争性的反应预测精度，还提供了机制可解释性的额外收益，包括在分布外场景下的鲁棒性和副产物预测能力。

Abstract: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology.
  We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors.
  Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites.
  To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations.
  MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models.
  Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade.
  Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.

</details>


### [442] [WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27454)
*Liyan Tang,Cyrus Rashtchian,Chun-Sung Ferng,Andrew Tomkins,Da-Cheng Juan,Tu Vu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WikiSkill框架，将智能体技能与持久化知识库（wiki）协同进化，通过持续将经验沉淀为可复用的知识，再基于知识库迭代技能，在多种基准和模型上超越现有技能进化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能自动发现方法虽然能从智能体经验中挖掘技能并支持渐进式适应，但指导技能开发的关键洞察往往分散在优化历史中，难以跨迭代系统复用，导致技能进化缺乏结构化的知识支撑。

Method: WikiSkill将原始执行经验、累积知识与可执行技能分离为三层结构，持续将执行经验整合进wiki知识库，后续技能更新以此为知识基础进行迭代进化，实现经验→知识→技能的循环协同进化。

Result: 在多个基准和模型上，WikiSkill一致优于最先进的技能进化方法，并在大多数模型-基准组合下胜过无技能基线。更大模型从进化技能中获益更多；小模型配备进化技能可超越明显更大的无技能模型。进化技能可跨模型和模型家族迁移，且其他模型进化的技能可优于自进化技能。消融实验确认wiki中知识持久累积对技能进化至关重要。

Conclusion: 系统性积累和精炼智能体经验对开发可复用、可迁移的技能具有显著价值，WikiSkill证明了知识库驱动下的技能进化框架的有效性，为智能体技能发展的知识管理提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [443] [WALL-SS: Scaling Long-horizon World Models via Next-Scale Autoregression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26239)
*Maeve Zhang,Rain Sun,Xiang Wang,Cyril Zhang,Shalfun Li,Meng Cao,Howard Lu,Ethan Chen,Harry Jhou,KZ Zheng,Lights Shi,Regis Cheng,Lorenzin,Robert Wang,Victor Yao,Gody Li,Elise Mon,Yohann Tang,Ryan Yu,PS Zhang,Vincent Chen,Hang Su,Roy Gan,Hao Wang,Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WALL-SS是一个通过尺度级自回归缩放生成视觉未来的世界模型，支持动作可控和长时程机器人仿真，具备变长生成、流式扩展和奖励驱动优化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式世界模型为机器人提供了预测世界演化的能力，但现有方法在统一生成式框架上存在不足：需要将动作与后果关联、支持灵活视界和连续交互、以及实现奖励驱动的优化。

Method: WALL-SS将具身轨迹表示为观测与动作时间交错排列的因果序列，使状态转移显式依赖动作；通过粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的尺度级生成来支持长视界，并在同一层级内包含三个互补组件：（1）动作条件化下一尺度预测，注入尺度对齐的动作表示以增强动作-未来耦合；（2）尺度压缩长时程记忆，细粒度保留近期交互并压缩远期观测与动作，配合尺度级dream forcing增强对自生成上下文的鲁棒性；（3）在线策略对齐（on-policy alignment），利用动作跟随和长期一致性奖励优化自回归视觉动态，同时保持预训练视觉分布。

Result: 实验表明WALL-SS在动作跟随和轨迹精度上有提升，支持有界内存下的连贯分钟级流式展开，且在线策略对齐一致性地减少了动作漂移和长时程不一致性。

Conclusion: WALL-SS通过尺度级自回归生成框架验证了统一的生成式世界模型公式在长时程机器人仿真中的有效性，其三个互补组件协同工作以实现动作可控、长视界且可优化的视觉未来生成。

Abstract: Generative world models provide robots with predictive models of how the world evolves under interaction, with growing potential for simulation, planning, policy evaluation, and robot learning. Beyond clip-level future prediction, a unified generative formulation should relate actions to consequences, support flexible horizons and continuous interaction, and enable reward-driven optimization. We introduce WALL-SS, a world model that generates visual futures through Scale-wise autoregressive Scaling, enabling action-controllable and long-horizon robotic simulation. WALL-SS represents embodied trajectories as causal sequences of temporally interleaved observations and actions, making action-dependent state transitions explicit while naturally supporting variable-length generation, streaming extension through reusable causal states, and direct optimization through sequence probabilities. To make this formulation effective over long horizons, we generate each future observation in a coarse-to-fine manner and develop three complementary components within the same hierarchy. Action-conditioned next-scale prediction injects scale-aligned action representations to improve action-future coupling and model both successful and failed behaviors. Scale-compressed long-horizon memory retains recent interactions at fine resolution while compressing distant observations and actions, with scale-wise dream forcing enhancing robustness to self-generated context. Finally, on-policy alignment optimizes autoregressive visual dynamics with action-following and long-term consistency rewards while preserving the pretrained visual distribution. Experiments show that WALL-SS improves action following and trajectory accuracy, supports coherent minute-long streaming rollout under bounded memory, and consistently benefits from on-policy alignment in reducing action drift and long-horizon inconsistency.

</details>


### [444] [Constraint-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Static Shape Estimation of Co-Manipulative Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26273)
*Rana Danesh,Pari Qarehdaghi,Farrokh Janabi-Sharifi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种约束感知的物理信息神经网络（PINN），用于肌腱驱动共操作连续体机器人（CCR）的静态形状估计。该方法采用几何变分应变建模，并融合投影静态平衡残差和几何闭环残差，在有限噪声数据下相比纯数据驱动ANN大幅提升精度，且推理速度远快于迭代非线性求解器，实验微调后进一步提升了标记点匹配精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共操作连续体机器人的静态形状估计具有挑战性，因为连续体臂与柔性操作对象形成闭环，必须同时满足静态平衡约束和几何闭环约束。传统方法依赖迭代非线性求解器，计算效率低，而纯数据驱动方法在有限和含噪训练数据下难以保证物理一致性和几何一致性。

Method: 采用几何变分应变（geometric variable strain）公式对肌腱驱动连续体机器人进行建模，构建一个约束感知的物理信息神经网络（PINN）。网络损失函数包含投影静态平衡残差（projected static equilibrium residual）以强制执行力学方程，以及配置级别的几何闭环残差（configuration-level geometric residual）以强制执行闭环几何约束。在仿真中与纯数据驱动ANN比较，并在实验中通过微调提升实际性能。

Result: 在140个样本和50%标签噪声条件下，PINN相对配置误差、平衡残差和闭环残差分别降低67.88%、67.35%和88.06%。使用完整数据集时，PINN达到0.1597%的相对配置误差，推理时间0.1773ms，而迭代非线性求解器需17.97s。实验微调将标记RMSE从2.657mm降至0.497mm，R2从-0.788提升至0.937。

Conclusion: 所提出的约束感知PINN能够实现对闭环CCR系统的高精度、物理一致且计算高效的静态形状估计，显著优于纯数据驱动方法，并大幅超越传统迭代求解器的推理速度，验证了融合物理约束的神经网络在该类连续体机器人形状估计问题中的有效性。

Abstract: Static shape estimation of co-manipulative continuum robots (CCRs) is challenging because the continuum arms and manipulated flexible object form a closed chain that must satisfy both static equilibrium and geometric loop-closure constraints. This paper presents a constraint-aware physics-informed neural network (PINN) for static shape estimation of a tendon-driven CCR modeled using the geometric variable strain formulation. The proposed method incorporates a projected static equilibrium residual and a configuration-level geometric residual to enforce the governing mechanics and closed-chain geometry. In simulation, the PINN is compared with a purely data-driven artificial neural network (ANN) under limited and noisy training data. With 140 samples and 50% label noise, the PINN reduces the relative configuration error, equilibrium residual, and closed-chain residual by 67.88%, 67.35%, and 88.06%, respectively. Using the full dataset, the PINN achieves 0.1597% relative configuration error with an inference time of 0.1773 ms, compared with 17.97 s for an iterative nonlinear solver. Experimental fine-tuning reduces the marker RMSE from 2.657 mm to 0.497 mm and increases R2 from -0.788 to 0.937. These results demonstrate accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient static shape estimation of closed-chain CCRs.

</details>


### [445] [Dispersive Forward Tree Search for Optimal Control: Coverage, Complexity, and Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26314)
*Shashank A. Deshpande,Jonathan P. How*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于前向传播的动力学运动规划器DFT*（Dispersive Forward Tree search），针对微分平坦非线性系统提供确定性有限样本近最优性保证。通过构造局部色散控制命令集构建前向树，并采用成本条件支配剪枝使树的大小与规划时域呈多项式关系（而非指数关系），同时利用并行硬件加速，在嵌入式处理器上实现了竞争性甚至更优的规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于转向（steering）的规划器需要求解状态到状态的边界值问题（BVP），这对非线性平台而言往往难以实现。虽然前向传播（forward propagation）规避了转向需求，但其有限样本行为缺乏理论刻画，且实际实现性能不佳。因此需要开发一种既有理论保证又能在实践中高效运行的传播式动力学运动规划方法。

Method: 1) 在微分平坦非线性系统类中，证明由局部色散（locally dispersive）控制命令生成的前向树在达到一定规模时包含近最优轨迹。2) 为控制仿射系统提供构造色散控制命令集的通用机制。3) 证明为了覆盖被认证的轨迹类（不考虑成本），树的大小在规划时域上必然指数级增长；为此提出成本条件支配剪枝过程，将树的大小保持在时域多项式级别且保留近最优性。4) 实现DFT*算法，以广度优先方式展开前向树，天然映射到并行硬件。5) 为单轮车、拖挂车和四旋翼设计高效色散采样器，并在实时重规划（receding-horizon）框架下实现动态环境规划。

Result: DFT*在单轮车、拖挂车和四旋翼等平台上，在嵌入式处理器上以相当的求解时间下取得了与最先进运动规划器一致甚至明显更优的解质量，并随并行计算规模扩展而进一步加速。在动态环境中，以嵌入式计算预算实现了实时重规划。

Conclusion: 本文弥合了传播式运动规划器在理论保证与实际性能之间的鸿沟：通过色散命令集和成本条件支配剪枝，首次在微分平坦非线性系统中实现了确定性有限样本近最优性保证的同时，保持了多项式规模的树复杂度和优秀的实际求解性能，验证了前向传播策略在运动规划中的可行性和竞争力。

Abstract: Steering-based planners require solutions to state-to-state boundary value problems, which can be inaccessible for nonlinear platforms. Forward propagation evades the steering requirement, but the finite-sample behavior of the associated planners remains uncharacterized and their implementations underperform in practice. This paper develops a propagation-based kinodynamic planner with deterministic finite-sample near-optimality guarantees. We work within the large class of differentially flat nonlinear systems and show that a forward tree of locally dispersive control commands contains a near-optimal trajectory at a certified tree size. We provide a general mechanism to construct dispersive command sets for control-affine systems, which are necessary to implement the search algorithm prescribed by the theory. We show that covering the certified trajectory class irrespective of cost provably demands a tree exponentially sized in the problem horizon, and present a cost-conditioned dominance pruning procedure that retains near-optimality at a tree size polynomial in the horizon. We implement the resulting search algorithm, Dispersive Forward Tree search (DFT*), as breadth-first expansion of the forward tree, which maps naturally onto parallel hardware. We design efficient dispersive samplers for the unicycle, the trailer car, and the quadrotor and evaluate challenging planning tasks for these platforms. DFT* delivers consistently competitive and often substantially better solution quality than state-of-the-art kinodynamic planners at comparable solution times on embedded-tier processors, accelerating further as parallel compute is scaled. We also implement DFT* in a receding-horizon loop to demonstrate real-time planning in dynamic environments at embedded-tier compute budgets.

</details>


### [446] [Cross-Platform Benchmark of Neural 3D Reconstruction for Autonomous Laboratory Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26383)
*Yongho Kim,Mengjiao Han,Victor Mateevitsi,Silvio Rizzi,Michael E. Papka,Nicola Ferrier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统性地对多种神经3D重建方法（NeRF、3D Gaussian Splatting、SAM3D）在从单板计算机到服务器级节点的不同GPU计算平台上进行了基准测试，发现Gaussian Splatting渲染质量优于NeRF但GPU开销更大，机载计算不足以进行交互速率的逐场景优化，而SAM3D可在数秒内生成合理的物体几何但细节存在偏差。研究提出了分层流水线方案：轻量级前馈重建维持实时感知与跟踪循环，较重度的神经重建则按需在合适的计算资源上调度执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主实验室机器人依赖3D重建流水线在物理控制回路的延迟预算内将原始摄像头流转换为可操作的物体表征。尽管神经3D重建方法已展现高质量的视图合成能力，但其在实际实验室机器人运行的计算平台上的实时可行性尚未得到充分刻画，因此需要进行跨计算平台的系统基准测试。

Method: 作者在从单板计算机到服务器级节点的多种GPU计算设备上，对NeRF、3D Gaussian Splatting的训练与渲染性能进行了系统性的计算平台基准测试，同时将Meta的SAM3D单图像重建方法放入同一评估维度，量化其在延迟和质量保真度方面相对于逐场景优化方法的差距。

Result: 实验结果表明：Gaussian Splatting在渲染质量上优于NeRF，但GPU计算成本更高；机载计算资源不足以支持全量逐场景优化达到交互速率；SAM3D的初步评估显示其能在数秒内生成合理的物体几何，但存在细节不匹配的问题，可能影响下游操作任务的可靠性。

Conclusion: 这些发现支持分层神经重建流水线的设计思路：以轻量级前馈重建方法维持实验室机器人的实时感知与跟踪闭环，同时将计算密集型的神经重建任务在合适的计算平台上进行选择性调度，从而在实时性与重建质量之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Autonomous robots performing laboratory tasks depend on 3D reconstruction pipelines that can turn raw camera streams into actionable object representations within the latency budget of a physical control loop. Neural 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated high-quality view synthesis, but their real-time viability across the compute platforms on which laboratory robots actually run remains poorly characterized. In this work, we present a systematic compute-platform benchmark of neural 3D reconstruction methods, evaluating NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting training and rendering on GPU-enabled computing devices ranging from single-board computers to server-class nodes, and place Meta's SAM3D single-image reconstruction on the same axes to quantify its latency and fidelity gap relative to per-scene optimization. Our results show that Gaussian Splatting yields higher rendering quality than NeRF at greater GPU cost, and that onboard compute is insufficient for full per-scene optimization at interactive rates. Our preliminary assessment on SAM3D indicates that it delivers plausible object geometry within seconds, but with detail mismatches that can compromise downstream manipulation. Together, these findings motivate tiered pipelines in which lightweight feed-forward reconstruction sustains the real-time perception-and-tracking loop for laboratory robots, while heavier neural reconstruction is scheduled selectively on suitable compute.

</details>


### [447] [RTNav: Towards Real-Time Zero-Shot Object Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26496)
*Easop Lee,Lingyu Zhang,Boyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RTNav，一种将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有界计算作为显式设计考虑的实时零样本目标导航架构，在实时变体的HM3D-v1/v2和HM3D-OVON基准上相比先前工作成功率提升最高11%，SPL提升最高5.1个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉和语言基础模型的零样本目标导航方法大多在同步模拟器中开发，环境等待智能体行动，推理时间实际上被忽略。然而在真实世界实时执行中，墙钟时间计入任务预算，推理延迟会导致这些架构的性能显著退化。作者希望解决这一被忽视的实时性问题。

Method: RTNav将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有界计算作为显式设计考虑，构建了一个简单但有效的架构，用于在实时约束下执行零样本目标导航。

Result: 在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和HM3D-OVON的实时变体上评估，RTNav较先前最优方法在成功率上提升最高11%，在Success weighted by Completion Time (SPL)上提升最高5.1个点。

Conclusion: 研究揭示现有零样本导航方法在实时时序条件下存在一致性的性能退化问题，并证明将延迟与异步作为显式设计考虑可以显著改善实时导航性能，为真实世界部署提供更实用的方案。

Abstract: Navigation in unknown environments to find unforeseen objects has become increasingly feasible with capable vision and language foundation models. However, these models also introduce non-negligible inference latency, which becomes an important concern when agents must operate continuously in the real world. Most state-of-the-art methods are still developed in synchronous simulators, where the environment waits for the agent to act and inference time is effectively free. As a result, agents are often designed around the sequential execution of perception, reasoning, and action, with little regard for time constraints. Under real-time execution, where wall-clock time counts towards the task budget, the inefficiencies of these architectures become clear. We show that recent zero-shot object navigation methods suffer consistent performance degradation under such realistic timing conditions. Motivated by this observation, we propose RTNav, a simple but effective architecture that treats inference latency, asynchronous environment stepping, and bounded compute as explicit design considerations. Evaluated on real-time variants of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, RTNav improves the success rate by up to 11% and the Success weighted by Completion Time by up to 5.1 points over prior work.

</details>


### [448] [Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid: Bipedal Locomotion with Linear-Quadratic Control and Learned Cost Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26505)
*Xulin Chen,Borui He,Ruipeng Liu,Naveed Tahir,Zhenyu Gan,Garrett E. Katz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LQR框架的Poppy人形机器人闭环行走控制器，通过从开环轨迹播放数据中学习二次成本函数，实现了可靠的、无需辅助的双足行走，并在实验中验证了其相对开环播放方法在行走性能上的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Poppy人形机器人是一款开源、低成本、适用于AI研究和教育的机器人，但此前没有任何已发表的方法能在标准Poppy硬件上实现可靠且无需辅助的双足行走，这限制了其作为研究平台的应用价值。

Method: 基于线性二次调节器（LQR）框架设计闭环行走控制器用于轨迹跟踪。具体流程为：首先通过开环播放名义行走轨迹收集数据，然后利用这些数据学习LQR控制器所需的二次成本函数，从而构建闭环控制器以改善行走可靠性。

Result: 经过实证验证，所提出的闭环控制器在行走性能上相比开环轨迹播放方法取得了统计学上显著的提升。

Conclusion: 本文成功为Poppy标准硬件提供了首个可实现的闭环双足行走控制器，展示了基于数据学习的LQR方法在低成本人形机器人运动控制中的有效性。

Abstract: The Poppy Humanoid is an open-source, low-cost robot suitable for research and education in artificial intelligence. However, we are unaware of any published methodology that achieves reliable, unassisted bipedal locomotion on the standard Poppy hardware. This paper contributes a functional closed-loop walking controller for Poppy, based on the linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) framework for trajectory tracking. Starting with data collected from open-loop playback of a nominal walking trajectory, our proposed method learns a quadratic cost function for an LQR controller that substantially improves the reliability of the motion. The closed-loop controller is validated empirically, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in walking performance compared to open-loop trajectory playback.

</details>


### [449] [Memory Anchors for Continual Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26545)
*Maximilian Du,Zhanyi Sun,Chen Xu,Paarth Shah,Masha Itkina,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"Memory Anchors"（记忆锚点）概念：在连续学习中，少量旧经验数据对防止灾难性遗忘起到关键作用。这些锚点位于新旧任务表征坍缩冲突的区域，通过识别并利用这些关键经验，可显著降低灾难性遗忘（排除10%锚点导致遗忘增加4.5倍；富集锚点使高冲突任务遗忘降低63%），并在真实机器人上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署在真实场景中的机器人策略需要持续学习新任务而不遗忘已有行为。常见的基于随机重放缓冲区的策略虽然简单，但忽略了不同旧经验对新任务保持性能的贡献差异。作者发现仅少量旧经验对锚定过去性能起关键作用，因此需要识别并利用这些"Memory Anchors"来更高效地对抗灾难性遗忘。

Method: 首先定义并识别Memory Anchors：这些经验位于新任务观测表征坍缩到旧任务观测表征的区域内，尽管两者需要冲突的动作（例如熟悉物体需要以新方式操作）。在采样重放缓冲区前，排除或富集这些锚点经验，对比其对连续学习性能的影响。

Result: 在LIBERO基准套件上，仅排除10%的Memory Anchors就会导致灾难性遗忘增加4.5倍以上；反之，在重放缓冲区中富集Memory Anchors可将高冲突任务的遗忘减少63%，并在真实机器人上成功实现两个任务序列的持续学习。

Conclusion: Memory Anchors是连续学习中防止灾难性遗忘的关键数据点。识别并优先利用这些锚点经验而非盲目随机采样，能更有效地保持旧任务知识，为机器人持续学习提供更高效的重放策略。

Abstract: Robot policies deployed in the wild should have the capability to continually learn new tasks without forgetting existing behaviors. A common approach to combat such catastrophic forgetting is to train on new task data with a replay buffer of previously learned task data. Although this buffer is commonly sampled randomly from all prior experiences, we show that a small set of these experiences contributes greatly in anchoring past performance. We call these experiences Memory Anchors. We identify Memory Anchors in regions where representations of new-task observations collapse onto those of old-task observations even though the tasks require conflicting actions, like when a familiar object must be manipulated in a new way. Rehearsing old data in this region plays a key role in preventing destructive overwriting of past task knowledge, serving as this critical Memory Anchor role. Excluding only 10% Memory Anchors before sampling the buffer leads to more than a 4.5x increase in catastrophic forgetting on the LIBERO benchmark suites. Conversely, enriching the replay buffer with Memory Anchors can decrease high-conflict task forgetting by 63% and enables successful continual learning of two task sequences on a real robot. Videos and additional visualizations can be found at https://robot-adaptation.github.io/MemoryAnchors

</details>


### [450] [TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26578)
*Jun-Hui Liu,Kun-Yu Lin,Yi-Lin Wei,Xu-Han Chen,Yinghao Li,Zhuohao Li,Yuan-Ming Li,Qing Zhang,Xiaoyi Fan,Dongmei Jiang,Yan Li,Wei-Shi Zheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出配置化失败诱捕（Configured Failure Trapping）这一针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的新型后门攻击任务，通过隐蔽文本触发器激活攻击并诱导特定配置的失败模式。文章提出了数据引擎合成目标轨迹和自动化评估套件，构建了Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin两个基准，并提出TrapVLA方法通过学习触发器诱导的动作残差来有效注入配置化失败行为，同时保持干净数据上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对VLA模型的后门攻击将任何任务失败视为成功攻击，无法精确控制机器人的失败方式（如指定抓取位置偏移）。这种粗粒度攻击方式挑战性低且容易被检测，需要一种能精确配置失败模式的新型攻击任务来探索VLA模型的安全性边界。

Method: 提出1）高效的数据引擎用于合成高质量目标轨迹；2）自动化套件用于测量配置化失败的保真度；3）基于此构建Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin两个基准，覆盖四种代表性失败模式；4）识别稀疏动作偏差为关键挑战，提出TrapVLA方法，显式学习触发器诱导的动作残差来引导策略向配置化失败行为偏移。

Result: 在仿真基准和真实机器人实验中的广泛验证表明，TrapVLA能有效将配置化失败模式注入VLA模型，同时大幅保持干净数据上的性能表现。

Conclusion: 配置化失败诱捕是一个更具挑战性且更难检测的后门攻击任务，TrapVLA方法有效解决了稀疏动作偏差问题，为VLA模型安全研究提供了新基准和评估方法。

Abstract: This work introduces Configured Failure Trapping, a novel backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which aims to activate attacks through stealthy textual triggers and induce configured failure modes. Unlike prior backdoor attacks that treat any task failure as a successful attack, Configured Failure Trapping requires the attacker to control how the robot fails (e.g., causing the robot to grasp with a specified positional offset), making it substantially more challenging and hard to detect. To support the new task, we propose an effective data engine for synthesizing high-quality target trajectories and an automated suite for measuring configured-failure fidelity. Then, based on this foundation, we construct two new benchmarks, namely Trap-LIBERO and Trap-RoboTwin, that instantiate Configured Failure Trapping across four representative failure modes. To address this task, we identify sparse action deviation as a critical challenge and accordingly propose a novel method named TrapVLA, which explicitly learns trigger-induced action residuals to steer the policy toward the configured failure behavior. Extensive experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic settings show that TrapVLA effectively injects configured failure modes into VLA models while largely preserving performance on clean data. Project page: https://john-liua.github.io/TrapVLA/

</details>


### [451] [SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26583)
*Pihai Sun,Gang Han,Jingkai Sun,Jiahao Ma,Zeran Su,Zelin Tao,Peiran Liu,Shuai Shi,Wei Cui,Zifan Wang,Jialin Yu,Wen Zhao,Kangning Yin,Jiaxu Wang,Jiahang Cao,Lingfeng Zhang,Hao Cheng,Jian Tang,Yijie Guo,Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SOLO是一个统一框架，通过两个关键组件解决感知型人形机器人策略在长时域行走中的脆弱性：Query Reconstructor（QR）使用傅里叶编码的单元查询从深度-本体感觉标记中检索空间特定证据，保留陡峭地形边界；Trajectory-Aware MSE（TA-MSE）蒸馏将下一状态师生不一致纳入PPO奖励，实现时序信用分配。在仿真中将高度图L1误差降低3.3-4.0倍，在压力测试地形上实现97.5%平均穿越成功率和96%踏脚石成功率，并以零样本方式在1.5公里户外路线和室内混合地形上完成部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类可以在复杂地形上长距离行走不失衡，而感知型人形机器人策略会因感知和控制的误差累积而变得脆弱。这种长时域脆弱性有两个相互叠加的原因：稠密地形重建会平滑掉对动作至关重要的细节，而逐点模仿学习缺乏时序信用分配。

Method: SOLO框架包含两个组件：(1) Query Reconstructor（QR）采用傅里叶编码的单元查询，从深度-本体感觉标记中检索空间特定证据，以保留陡峭地形边界；(2) Trajectory-Aware MSE（TA-MSE）蒸馏将下一状态师生之间的分歧加入PPO奖励，使Generalized Advantage Estimation能够将未来的分歧惩罚传播到之前的动作上。

Result: 在仿真中，QR将高度图L1误差降低3.3-4.0倍；TA-MSE在课程进度上超过PPO和MSE+PPO。在压力测试地形上，SOLO实现97.5%的平均穿越成功率和96%的踏脚石成功率，而稠密重建变体仅达到75.0-75.6%和0-3%。零样本部署仅使用胸部深度相机和本体感觉，成功完成连续1.5公里户外路线和室内混合地形路线。

Conclusion: SOLO证明了通过保留动作关键地形细节的查询重建机制和赋予时序信用分配的轨迹感知蒸馏，可以显著提升人形机器人在长时域复杂地形导航中的鲁棒性，并且能够在真实世界零样本部署中实现无缝导航。

Abstract: Humans traverse complex terrain over long distances without losing balance, whereas perceptive humanoid policies become fragile as perception and control errors accumulate. We present SOLO, a unified framework addressing two compounding causes of this long-horizon fragility: dense terrain reconstruction smooths action-critical details, and pointwise imitation lacks temporal credit assignment. Its Query Reconstructor (QR) uses Fourier-encoded cell queries to retrieve spatially specific evidence from depth-proprioception tokens, preserving sharp terrain boundaries. Trajectory-Aware MSE (TA-MSE) Distillation adds next-state teacher-student disagreement to the PPO reward, enabling Generalized Advantage Estimation to propagate future disagreement penalties to preceding actions. In simulation, QR reduces height-map L1 error by factors of 3.3-4.0, while TA-MSE surpasses PPO and MSE+PPO in curriculum progression. On stress-test terrains, SOLO achieves 97.5% mean traversal success and 96% stepping-stone success, versus 75.0-75.6% and 0-3% for dense-reconstructor variants. Deployed zero-shot with only a chest-mounted depth camera and proprioception, SOLO completes a continuous 1.5-km outdoor route and an indoor mixed-terrain course. Project page: https://sunpihai-up.github.io/solo/

</details>


### [452] [Relaxation-Aware Multimodal Sensing of Soft Gripper Driven by Structure-Perception-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26622)
*Yanzhe Wang,Hao Wu,Ziyi Zheng,Huixu Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对软体机器人抓取中因聚合物黏弹性导致抓取力持续衰减的问题，提出了一种结构-感知-学习一体化框架，融合变刚度软体夹爪、视觉与红外热成像感知以及物理信息学习模型，实现了稳定持续的力保持抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器手的柔顺性能够实现安全自适应接触，但其内在黏弹性会导致应力松弛和抓取力持续衰减，难以实现稳定持久的抓取。现有方法缺乏对交互状态的连续感知与力衰减的显式补偿机制。

Method: 提出了一个集成的结构-感知-学习框架：(1) 结构层面，开发变刚度软体夹爪；(2) 感知层面，利用机载视觉和红外热成像实时追踪变形与温度场，持续捕捉交互状态；(3) 学习层面，提出温度耦合的黏弹性力表示与物理信息学习模型，重建力变化趋势并提供持握期间的显式补偿。

Result: 在280秒力控抓持任务中，该方法将期望力保持的平均绝对误差降至0.066N，相较于固定孔径基线和仅瞬时反馈基线分别提升80%和95%。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持"机构-人工智能协同设计"的观点：机构设计决定了可行的交互范围，而学习算法弥补了黏弹性动力学中的残余不确定性，两者结合方能实现稳定、持续的抓取。

Abstract: Achieving stable, sustained grasping with soft robotic hands remains a fundamental challenge. Compliance enables safe and adaptive contact, yet the intrinsic viscoelasticity of soft polymers leads to stress relaxation and a continuous decay of grasping force during holding. Inspired by human grasping, which combines phase-dependent stiffness regulation with continuous sensing and feedback, this paper presents an integrated structure--perception--learning framework. We develop a variable-stiffness soft gripper that uses onboard vision and infrared thermography to track deformation and the temperature field in real time, preserving continuous tracking of the interaction state. To mitigate relaxation-induced force decay, we propose a temperature-coupled viscoelastic force representation, together with a physics-informed learning model, to reconstruct the force trend and provide explicit compensation during holding. Experiments show that, in a 280s force-controlled grasp-and-hold task, the proposed method maintains the desired force with a mean absolute error of 0.066N, outperforming fixed-aperture and instantaneous-only baselines by 80% and 95%, respectively. Overall, the results support a mechanism--AI co-design view: mechanisms shape feasible interactions, while learning compensates remaining uncertainty in viscoelastic dynamics, together enabling stable, sustained grasping.

</details>


### [453] [FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26645)
*Ganlong Zhao,Zijia Tang,Xingping Chen,Zhanghui Kuang,Ye Tian,Guanbin Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出FLARE框架，通过"Retry"和"Reset"两种机制赋予视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)错误恢复能力，使其能在面对常见执行错误（如抓取失败、物体掉落、意外碰撞）时自主恢复，并在接触密集的操控任务中显著提升任务成功率和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通常只在轨迹单调、无失败的演示数据上训练，导致其在真实部署中遇到执行偏差或分布外(OOD)失效时无法恢复，性能脆弱且鲁棒性不足。需要一种机制使VLA能够处理常见的执行错误并恢复任务状态。

Method: FLARE框架包含两大核心机制：(1) "Retry"机制——通过向演示数据中注入扰动和桥接片段，解耦机器人位姿与环境状态，使策略能够自主处理执行偏差；(2) "Reset"管线——利用多模态大语言模型(MLLM)对执行视频进行离线失败分析，自动识别OOD状态，并针对性地收集少量以物体为中心的"Reset"技能库进行训练，用于将环境恢复到任务有效状态。推理阶段，在线MLLM监控器在任务执行与"Reset"技能之间进行仲裁。

Result: 在具有挑战性的接触密集操控任务上的实验表明，FLARE方法显著提高了任务成功率和鲁棒性，能够有效处理抓取失败、物体掉落和意外碰撞等常见执行错误。

Conclusion: 通过"Retry"与"Reset"相结合的双层错误恢复范式，FLARE为VLA模型提供了从轻微执行偏差到严重OOD失效的全谱系错误恢复能力，提升了VLA在复杂长时程操控任务中的部署可靠性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models~(VLAs) have demonstrated significant promise in generalizing to complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. However, their performance remains brittle, as they are typically trained on trajectory-monotonic, failure-free demonstrations. This reliance on ``perfect" data leaves them unable to recover from common execution errors, such as a missed grasp, a dropped object, or an unexpected collision. In this paper, we propose FLARE, a novel framework that endows VLAs with robust error recovery capabilities through a ``Retry" and ``Reset" paradigm. First, we introduce a ``Retry" mechanism by injecting perturbation and bridging segments that decouple robot pose from environment state into demonstrations, enabling the policy to autonomously handle execution deviations. Second, to address critical, state-breaking (OOD) failures, we introduce a ``Reset" pipeline. We leverage an MLLM for offline failure analysis to automatically identify OOD states from execution videos. This analysis enables the efficient, targeted collection of a small library of object-centric ``Reset" skills, which are trained to restore the environment to a task-valid state. Our full framework integrates these learned policies. At inference, an online MLLM monitor arbitrates between task execution and ``Reset" skills. Experiments on challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks show our approach significantly improves task success and robustness.

</details>


### [454] [Beyond the Proving Ground: Independent Public-Road Testing of Assisted Lane Change Systems using LiDAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26669)
*Marcello Cellina,Akos Kriston,Antonio Migneco,Davide Maggi,Stefano Favelli,Fabrizio Re,Fabrizio Minarini,Andrea Nuovo,Riccardo Dona,Biagio Ciuffo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在公共道路上独立测试辅助车道变更（ALC）系统的方法，并在法国A31高速公路进行实车测试，使用LiDAR检测与跟踪系统来评估系统是否符合UNECE第79号法规的安全距离要求。测试发现部分情况下系统允许了不满足法规最小距离要求的变道操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用高级驾驶辅助系统的测试对安全和合规至关重要，但现有测试场地场景无法反映真实驾驶的复杂性，而地理围栏方法则需要制造商协作且限制评估独立性，因此需要一种独立、真实且符合合规评估需求的方法。

Method: 在法国A31高速公路上开展公共道路测试，使用配备LiDAR检测与跟踪系统的测试车辆，结合实时动态（RTK）GNSS接收器来评估检测与跟踪性能。测试覆盖了测试车辆与接管车辆之间不同距离和速度的组合，并将记录的车道变更轨迹与UNECE第79号法规的车道变更抑制要求进行比较。

Result: 在27个预定义的车道变更操作中，18个完成、9个被抑制。在6个案例中，系统允许了不满足法规最小距离要求的操作；其中3个案例在校准测量不确定性后偏差仍具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: 这是首次面向ALC系统满足第79号法规安全距离要求的公共道路测试活动。结果表明LiDAR传感适用于此类评估，该方法论可支持市场监督和未来法规修订，揭示审批程序未覆盖的真实世界行为。

Abstract: Testing of commercial Advanced Driver Assistance Systems is essential to ensure safety and compliance during type approval and in service operation. However, proving ground scenarios may not reflect real world driving complexity, while geo fencing can require manufacturer collaboration and limit assessment independence. This work presents a methodology for independently testing Assisted Lane Change systems on public roads. A campaign on the A31 French motorway used a test vehicle equipped with a LiDAR based vehicle detection and tracking system. Tests covered combinations of inter vehicle distance and speed between the test vehicle and the take over vehicle. Real time kinematic global navigation satellite system receivers assessed detection and tracking performance. Recorded lane change trajectories were compared with the lane change suppression requirements of UNECE Regulation Number 79. Of 27 predefined lane change manoeuvres, 18 were completed and 9 suppressed. In 6 cases, the system allowed manoeuvres that did not meet regulatory minimum distance requirements. In 3 cases, the deviation remained statistically significant after accounting for measurement uncertainty. To the authors knowledge, this is the first public road campaign designed to assess Assisted Lane Change compliance with Regulation Number 79 safety distance requirements. The results demonstrate the suitability of LiDAR based sensing for this purpose. The methodology can support market surveillance and future regulatory revisions by revealing real world behaviours not covered by approval procedures.

</details>


### [455] [PredVLA: A Sub-Million-Parameter Predictive-Coding Policy for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26673)
*Hiroki Sawada,Shunichi Kasahara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PredVLA是一个仅含68万可训练参数、无需机器人数据预训练的语言条件预测编码策略，通过层级生成式循环动力学预测视觉特征与本体感觉，在LIBERO基准上短时程任务平均成功率达86.9%，长时程任务为75.4%，并在受控对比中分别达到参数匹配的Transformer和LSTM策略平均成功率的3.7倍和7.4倍。其预测编码框架还提供了可量化的闭环修正贡献度测量机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型预训练视觉-语言-动作模型主导了现代机器人操作基准，但其参数规模是否必要尚不明确，小型控制架构能否在远小于这些模型的参数预算下保持竞争力也是一个开放问题。

Method: 提出PredVLA，一种语言条件的预测编码策略，仅含0.68百万可训练参数，无机器人数据预训练。其核心是层级生成式循环动力学，同时预测视觉特征和本体感觉，而观测仅通过由此产生的感觉预测误差的在线推断来影响潜状态。此外，通过禁用预测误差推断可实现精确的开环控制条件，以直接测量观测驱动修正的贡献。

Result: 在LIBERO上，PredVLA在三个短时程套件上达到86.9%的平均成功率，包含长时程套件时为75.4%。在相同的冻结前端、演示、动作解码器和评估协议下，其平均成功率分别是参数匹配的Transformer和LSTM策略的3.7倍和7.4倍。

Conclusion: 亚百万参数级别的循环生成式策略能够在现代语言条件操作基准上取得强性能，同时提供由预测误差驱动的在线状态修正的显式机制，表明大型预训练模型并非语言条件控制的必要条件。

Abstract: Large pretrained vision-language-action models dominate modern robot-manipulation benchmarks, but it remains unclear how much model scale is necessary for strong language-conditioned control, or whether fundamentally different control architectures can remain competitive at much smaller parameter budgets. We present PredVLA, a language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with only 0.68 million trainable network parameters and no robot-data pretraining, whose hierarchical generative recurrent dynamics predict visual features and proprioception while observations influence latent state only through online inference from the resulting sensory prediction errors. On LIBERO, PredVLA achieves an 86.9% mean success rate across the three short-horizon suites and 75.4% when the long-horizon suite is included. Under a controlled comparison using the same frozen front end, demonstrations, action decoder, and evaluation protocol, PredVLA achieves 3.7x and 7.4x mean success rates of parameter-matched Transformer and LSTM policies, respectively. The predictive-coding formulation also makes the contribution of observation-driven correction directly measurable: because observations influence the recurrent state only through prediction-error-based latent inference, disabling this inference yields an exact open-loop control condition. Together, these results show that a sub-million-parameter recurrent generative policy can achieve strong performance on modern language-conditioned manipulation benchmarks while providing an explicit mechanism for prediction-error-driven online state correction.

</details>


### [456] [Residual Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Computed Torque Control for a Cable-Driven Lower-Limb Rehabilitation Robot under Disturbances and Parametric Uncertainties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26739)
*Mohammad-Hossein Fakouri,Ali Keymasi-Khalaji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种残差深度强化学习增强的计算力矩控制框架，用于缆索驱动下肢康复机器人的精确轨迹跟踪，在保持模型可解释性的同时提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缆索驱动下肢康复机器人面临模型不确定性、外部扰动、关节约束和缆索单向驱动等挑战，传统基于模型的控制器对模型失配敏感，而纯学习型控制又降低透明性且难以处理约束。

Method: 采用残差深度强化学习增强的计算力矩控制（CTC）框架：CTC生成名义控制指令，一个有界的DDPG策略仅提供额外的补偿力矩，两者叠加形成最终控制信号。

Result: 在名义、不确定、扰动、组合及泛化等多类仿真条件下，残差控制器相比纯CTC改善了轨迹跟踪和扰动抑制能力，同时保持模型基指令结构的可解释性并满足可行性检查；泛化测试表明跟踪改进可持续，但也暴露出依赖轨迹的约束限制。

Conclusion: 有界残差学习是仿真环境下康复机器人控制的一种实用鲁棒性增强策略，但需进一步进行约束感知和实验验证。

Abstract: Accurate trajectory tracking in cable-driven lower-limb rehabilitation robots is challenging because model uncertainty, external disturbances, joint constraints, and pull-only cable actuation can degrade nominal control performance. Conventional model-based controllers provide an interpretable control structure but remain sensitive to model mismatch, whereas fully learning-based control can reduce transparency and complicate constraint-aware operation. This study proposes a residual deep reinforcement learning-enhanced computed torque control framework in which computed torque control generates the nominal command and a bounded Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient policy supplies only an additional compensating torque. The approach is evaluated in simulation under nominal, uncertain, disturbed, combined, and generalization conditions, together with trajectory-tracking, joint-limit, cable-demand, workspace-feasibility, and cable-Jacobian diagnostics. Across the evaluated conditions, the residual controller improves tracking and disturbance rejection relative to computed torque control while preserving the interpretable model-based command structure and satisfying the reported feasibility checks in the representative evaluation. Broader tests indicate that tracking improvements can persist beyond the representative case while also exposing trajectory-dependent constraint limitations. These results support bounded residual learning as a practical robustness-enhancement strategy for simulation-based rehabilitation robot control and motivate further constraint-aware and experimental validation.

</details>


### [457] [MeshPriorDiT: Hierarchical Modeling for Action-Conditioned Cloth Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26766)
*Zihang Wang,Jianming Hu,Shang Su,Hao Huang,Mengkai Shi,Jun Gao,Shuo Feng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MeshPriorDiT，一种层次化布料动力学预测模型，将未来布料运动分解为结构化网格先验和生成式残差。网格GNN先预测多步顶点位移以捕捉材料拓扑与抓取约束，Residual DiT再通过条件流匹配生成残差运动，最终利用材料邻接关系对残差进行缩放和解码。在三个布料操作任务的15步自回归推演中，与GNN-Only基线相比Global MSE平均降低43.42%，与DiT-DDPM基线相比降低75.03%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有布料动力学预测方法存在两难：网格基GNN虽能通过材料连通性捕捉局部物理响应，但消息传递范围有限，难以协调拓扑上相距遥远的区域，且自回归推演会导致误差累积；Transformer基动力学模型虽能通过全局注意力捕捉长程交互，但缺乏显式的材料连通性，需从数据中自行学习局部拓扑响应。因而需要一个结合两者优势的模型。

Method: MeshPriorDiT采用层次化分解框架：1) 动作条件网格GNN预测多步顶点位移，生成尊重材料拓扑和抓取约束的参考轨迹（网格先验）；2) 以历史状态、规划动作和网格先验为条件，Residual DiT通过条件流匹配联合生成先验未捕获的残差运动；3) 生成的残差通过材料邻接矩阵进行缩放和解码，以协调相邻顶点间的修正。

Result: 在三个布料操作任务的15步自回归推演评估中，MeshPriorDiT相比GNN-Only基线平均Global MSE降低43.42%，相比DiT-DDPM基线降低75.03%，同时保持与GNN-Only相当的Edge-strain MSE（边缘应变误差）。

Conclusion: 将网格先验与生成式残差相结合的层次化架构能同时兼顾局部物理合理性与长程协调能力，有效克服了单一范式的局限性，为动作条件布料动力学预测提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Action-conditioned cloth dynamics prediction requires both locally plausible deformation and long-range coordination. Existing approaches largely follow two paradigms. Mesh-based GNNs capture local physical responses through material connectivity. However, their finite message-passing range limits coordination between topologically distant regions, while autoregressive rollouts tend to accumulate prediction errors. Transformer-based dynamics models capture long-range interactions through global attention, but often operate without explicit material connectivity and must learn local topological responses directly from data. We propose MeshPriorDiT, a hierarchical dynamics model that decomposes future cloth motion into a structured mesh prior and a generative residual. An action-conditioned mesh GNN first predicts multi-step vertex displacements, yielding a reference trajectory that respects material topology and grasp constraints. Conditioned on historical states, planned actions, and the mesh prior, a Residual DiT then uses conditional flow matching to jointly generate the residual motion not captured by the prior. The generated residual is further rescaled and decoded using material adjacency to coordinate corrections across neighboring vertices. We evaluate MeshPriorDiT on 15-step autoregressive rollouts across three cloth manipulation tasks. Averaged over the three tasks, MeshPriorDiT reduces average Global MSE by 43.42% relative to the GNN-Only baseline and by 75.03% relative to the DiT-DDPM baseline, while maintaining a favorable Edge-strain MSE comparable to that of GNN-Only.

</details>


### [458] [Online Joint Calibration of Steering Offset and Planar LiDAR Extrinsics for Wheeled Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26789)
*Subodh Mishra,Arindam Dhar,Suprotim Majumdar,Naveen Arulselvan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）的在线估计方法，在自行车运动学模型框架下同时估计仓库移动机器人（WMR）的转向偏移和平面LiDAR外参，替代传统手动标定流程。真实数据集实验表明，校正转向偏移可显著降低横向跟踪误差（CTE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库移动机器人的路径跟踪严重依赖精确的转向感知和LiDAR-车辆外参标定。实际中转向“零点”通常通过手动方式设定，LiDAR外参则直接假设来自CAD模型且维护后可能漂移，这些静态手动标定流程在安全关键环境中常导致标定失准，引发蛇形运动、摆振和高的横向跟踪误差（CTE）。因此需要一种原理性的在线标定替代方案。

Method: 在自行车运动学模型的基础上，设计了一个扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF），用于在线联合估计转向偏移（steering offset）和平面LiDAR外参。该方法将静态手动标定转化为基于实时传感器数据的在线状态估计问题。

Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，校正转向偏移能够显著降低横向跟踪误差（CTE），验证了该方法在提升WMR路径跟踪精度方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于EKF的在线标定方法为WMR提供了比手动标定更可靠、更原理化的方案，能够有效缓解因转向零点和LiDAR外参失准导致的路径跟踪性能退化。

Abstract: Accurate steering sensing and LiDAR-to-vehicle extrinsics are crucial for reliable path tracking in warehouse mobile robots (WMRs); miscalibration often leads to snaking, weaving, and elevated cross-track error (CTE). In practice, steering ``zero'' is commonly set manually (e.g., eyeballing straightness via a PS4 joystick), while LiDAR extrinsics are assumed from CAD and may drift after maintenance. Such static, manual procedures frequently cause miscalibration in safety-critical environments. This paper presents an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)--based method for online estimation of steering offset and planar LiDAR extrinsics within a bicycle-kinematics model, providing a principled alternative to manual calibration. Experiments on real datasets show that correcting steering offset reduces CTE substantially, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [459] [Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26800)
*Taeyoon Lee,Chunpeng Wang,Christopher G. Atkeson,Alfred A. Rizzi,Nicolas Rojas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种在线学习框架，使双臂机器人能够在真实硬件上几分钟内学会多种杂耍模式，即使存在显著的sim2real差距。核心思想是学习应建立在机器人现有知识之上而非替换它，通过正则化的记忆学习方法结合局部经验模型与全局先验模型，同时构造互达集合保证真实世界中持续学习的安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人技能学习面临sim2real差距的挑战，传统方法要么依赖大量真实数据，要么受限于模拟器保真度。作者发现即使模型与现实存在很大差距，仍可提供极大价值，因此希望设计一种能够在真实硬件上快速、安全、持续学习的框架，让机器人利用不完美的先验知识，通过自身真实经验不断精化行为。

Method: 1) 提出"正则化记忆式学习"(regularized memory-based learning)：从累积经验中学习局部模型，同时保留全局先验模型用于经验稀疏区域的推断，实现高效稳定的在线学习。2) 构建"互达集合"(mutually reachable set)，确保连续投掷与接球之间安全转换，避免任一机械臂进入下一个动作会违反关节或执行器限制的状态。3) 在双臂多指手+机载视觉的平台上进行真实世界在线学习。

Result: 双臂机器人在少于5分钟的真实交互时间内，安全地学习并组合出五种经典三球杂耍模式：cascade（瀑布）、tennis（网球）、half-shower（半淋浴）、shower（淋浴）和box（盒子）。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了不完美的先验模型结合安全在线学习机制，能够使机器人快速在真实世界中获取多样的动态技能。更广泛地，这指向了机器人应基于先验知识构建、并通过自身真实经验持续精化行为的学习范式。

Abstract: We present an online learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to acquire diverse juggling patterns directly on physical hardware within minutes, even with a significant sim2real gap. One of the most important lessons from this work is that a model, even when far from reality, can be extremely useful for learning. This motivates a central philosophy of our approach: learning should build upon the robot's current knowledge rather than replace it. Our regularized memory-based learning puts this principle into practice by learning a local model from accumulated experience while retaining the global prior model to extrapolate where experience is sparse. This enables efficient and stable online learning from each new experience without resorting to uninformed exploration over a vast space of possible behaviors. Equally important to continual on-robot learning is safety, allowing the robot to repeatedly practice and improve in the real world. We construct a mutually reachable set that allows safe transitions between successive throws and catches, without driving either arm into a state from which its next action would require violating the robot's joint or actuator limits. Together, these ideas enable a bimanual robot with multi-fingered hands and onboard vision to safely learn and compose five canonical three-ball juggling patterns, including cascade, tennis, half-shower, shower, and box, within less than 5 minutes of real-world interaction. More broadly, this work points toward robots that build upon imperfect prior knowledge and continually refine their behavior through their own real-world experience.

</details>


### [460] [CLIPPER: Replayable Shortlisted Optimization for Repeated Spatial Coverage Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26819)
*Julian Teusch,Jörg Philipp Müller,Monika Sester*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CLIPPER框架，用于城市微出行（micromobility）规划中的快速、约束精确迭代规划。在布伦瑞克市基于地理围栏排除、强制保留站点、间距规则和区域上限等约束的实际场景中，CLIPPER通过候选池加精确增益重算与保守界限触发扩展/审计，在三个城市数据上以13.6–28.9倍的加速实现与完整贪婪算法几乎一致的覆盖率（差距不超过0.245个百分点），并支持可回放的城市级规划状态比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市微出行规划面临大量实际操作约束（地理围栏排除、强制保留站点、间距规则、区域上限），每次政策调整都需要重新生成可行规划方案。完整集合贪婪算法在城市规模下需数十秒才能处理一个方案，这严重制约了多方案快速比较与回放的需求，因此需要一个低延迟但保持约束精确的替代方案。

Method: CLIPPER包含两个变体：CLIPPER-F为每个提案组分配相同数量的候选槽位；CLIPPER-A则共享一个候选预算在组间分配。核心机制包括：构建有界候选池、选择前重新计算精确当前增益、逐一检查所有活动约束；用单候选覆盖率设定初始顺序，并通过离线全集合扫描测量池外遗漏增益；在线使用保守界限触发扩展或审计以保证完整性。

Result: 在布伦瑞克、慕尼黑和柏林三个城市的实验中，CLIPPER-F的完整链平均覆盖率与同政策下的完整集合贪婪算法差距不超过0.245个百分点，平均滚动时间降低13.6–28.9倍。CLIPPER-A在覆盖率优先政策下仅使用完整集合贪婪算法9–15%的滚动时间，平均覆盖率差距在布伦瑞克为1.82个百分点、慕尼黑为0.12、柏林为0.27。

Conclusion: CLIPPER在保持每个编码模型约束均被强制执行的前提下，实现了城市规模的快速、可回放规划状态比较。它有效地在时间效率与规划最优性之间取得平衡，为市政微出行规划的动态政策迭代提供实用工具。

Abstract: Operational requirements developed with the City of Braunschweig frame municipal micromobility planning under geofenced exclusions, mandatory retained sites, spacing rules, and area-level caps. Each policy edit requires a new feasible plan; full-set greedy takes tens of seconds per alternative at city scale. We present CLIPPER (Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay). It forms bounded candidate pools but recomputes exact current gains and checks every active constraint before selection. Coverage from each candidate alone sets the initial order. Offline full-set scans measure gains omitted by the pool; online, a conservative bound triggers expansion or audit. CLIPPER-F gives each proposal group the same number of candidate slots. Across Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin, its mean coverage over complete chains stays within 0.245 percentage points of full-set greedy under the same policy, with 13.6--28.9 times lower mean rollout time. CLIPPER-A instead distributes one shared candidate budget across the groups. Under its coverage-prioritized policy, it uses 9--15% of full-set greedy's rollout time under the same policy, with mean gaps of 1.82 percentage points in Braunschweig, 0.12 in Munich, and 0.27 in Berlin. Together, CLIPPER enables rapid, replayable comparison of recorded city-scale planning states while enforcing every encoded model constraint.

</details>


### [461] [TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26821)
*Jiarui Yang,Yehao Lu,Yuning Su,Yu Zhong,Yufeng Xie,Yazhou Zhang,Haiyu Lan,Kaixiang Lu,Peiwen Lin,Chuang Wang,Junwei Liang,Enyu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TemporalFlow-VLA通过物理grounded的时间监督学习紧凑的执行历史，利用机器人状态、几何和标定相机构建训练专用的robot-surface时间流目标，监督两个执行对齐的时间查询，在不增加部署推理开销的情况下显著提升多阶段操作任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽利用预训练的视觉语言表征进行机器人控制，但简单拼接历史帧无法可靠捕捉近期的物理状态变化。在多阶段操作中，视觉上相似的状态可能因先前的执行步骤不同而需要不同的动作，现有方法缺乏对有序执行历史的有效建模。

Method: 提出TemporalFlow-VLA框架：(1) 利用记录的机器人状态、机器人几何和标定相机构建robot-surface时间流作为训练专用监督目标；(2) 监督两个执行对齐的时间查询（temporal queries），为动作专家提供结构化历史信息；(3) 几何监督路径仅在训练时使用，部署时不进行运动估计或几何处理；(4) 采用异步特征缓存，保持单帧级别的服务端采样延迟。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上达到97.63±0.26%的平均成功率，其中LIBERO Long为96.60±0.87%；在12个RoboTwin任务上达到85.5%（Clean）和84.2%（Randomized）的成功率。在长时程多阶段操作任务上优势最为明显。受控历史干预实验表明动作预测同时依赖历史内容和时间顺序。

Conclusion: TemporalFlow-VLA提供了一种紧凑且物理grounded的接口来利用有序执行历史，无需显式运动估计或部署时的几何处理，在保持低推理延迟的同时显著提升多阶段操作的性能。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for robot control, yet simply adding historical frames does not reliably capture recent physical change. This is especially problematic in multi-stage manipulation, where visually similar states may require different actions depending on prior execution. To address this challenge, we present TemporalFlow-VLA, which learns compact execution history through physically grounded temporal supervision. Using recorded robot states, robot geometry, and calibrated cameras, we construct robot-surface temporal flow as a training-only target and supervise two execution-aligned temporal queries that provide structured history to the action expert. The geometric supervision path is not evaluated at deployment. TemporalFlow-VLA achieves 97.63 +/- 0.26% average success on LIBERO, including 96.60 +/- 0.87% on LIBERO Long, and 85.5%/84.2% Clean/Randomized success across 12 RoboTwin tasks. It shows its clearest advantage over prior methods on longer-horizon, multi-stage manipulation. Controlled history interventions show that action prediction depends on both historical content and temporal order. With asynchronous feature caching, temporal conditioning maintains single-frame-level server-side sampling latency without additional historical-encoding overhead. Overall, TemporalFlow-VLA provides a compact, physically grounded interface for exploiting ordered execution history without explicit motion estimation or geometric processing at deployment.

</details>


### [462] [Active Surface-Driven Reconfigurable Gripper: Robust Grasping and Sequential Manipulation of Thin Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26883)
*Ziyi Zheng,Keqi Zhu,Hao Wu,Yanzhe Wang,Huixu Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成主动表面与欠驱动柔顺性的机器人夹爪，用于稳定抓取薄物体（以书本为代表），无需复杂控制即可实现可靠抓取与操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数现有夹爪抓取薄物体时依赖高精度的接近和抓取动作，鲁棒性差、适用性有限。薄物体的抓取和操作面临显著挑战，需要更鲁棒的解决方案。

Method: 首先设计了一种带有主动表面的欠驱动夹爪，其中主动表面拇指可在不需要调整机械臂或其他手指的情况下执行目标书本的手内重新定位，欠驱动手指与环境建立柔顺接触条件，可重构结构在不同配置下可靠抓取书本。其次建立夹爪的运动学模型，确定两种代表性场景（桌面平放和书架竖直放置）的初始抓取姿态。通过分析书本在桌面上与夹爪及环境相互作用的物理模型，系统优化结构参数和抓取策略。最后通过实验验证。

Result: 实验证明该夹爪在抓取平放薄物体（包括书本、纸张、布料、塑料薄膜和鼠标垫）时具有强鲁棒性和适应性，抓取竖直放置书本时具有高成功率，并能可靠完成长时间连续"抓取-放置"任务。

Conclusion: 所提出的主动表面结合欠驱动柔顺性的夹爪方案，通过结构设计与物理模型分析而非复杂控制，有效解决了薄物体抓取难题，展现出良好的鲁棒性、适应性和实用性。

Abstract: Robotic grippers face substantial challenges in grasping and manipulating thin objects. Most existing grippers rely on highly precise approach and grasp motions, which limits robustness and reduces applicability. This paper explores thin-object grasping using books as a representative example. Here, we propose a novel solution that integrates an active surface with underactuated compliance to achieve stable grasping of thin objects without complex control. First, an underactuated gripper with an active surface is designed. The active-surface thumb performs in-hand repositioning of the target book without requiring adjustments of the robot arm or the other fingers, while the underactuated fingers establish compliant contact conditions with the environment, and the reconfigurable structure enables reliable grasping of books under different configurations. Second, we establish a kinematic model of the gripper, and determine the initial grasp postures for two representative scenarios (books lying flat on a desktop and books vertically packed in a shelf). Third, by analyzing the physical model of a book lying on a table and its interaction with the gripper and the environment, we systematically optimize the structural parameters and grasping strategy. Finally, extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed gripper and strategy. The results demonstrate strong robustness and adaptability when grasping thin objects placed flat (including books, paper, fabric, plastic film, and mouse pad), as well as a high success rate when grasping vertically packed books. Moreover, the proposed gripper can reliably complete long sequential "grasp-place" tasks.

</details>


### [463] [Beyond Shallow-Water Photorealism: Physically and Sensor-Grounded Simulation for Deep-Sea Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26888)
*Michele Grimaldi,Enrico Di Maria,Ignacio Carlucho,Yvan R. Petillot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于物理和传感器模型的深海仿真扩展框架，在Stonefish模拟器中增强了水动力模型、IMU/DVL漂移、磁力计扰动、地形力学、压力驱动环境变化及水下光学模型，旨在更真实地模拟深海AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV和水下滑翔机的行为，同时保持实时仿真能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下模拟器过度强调视觉真实感而忽视物理保真度，且主要聚焦于浅水效应，在深海环境中相关性有限且计算成本高昂，无法准确模拟深海作业条件。不准确的传感器和环境模型会引入非物理伪影和过于乐观的性能估计，尤其影响长时间导航和基于学习的自主性研究。

Method: 在Stonefish模拟器基础上进行物理与传感器层面的扩展：1) 随机IMU和DVL漂移建模；2) 磁力计扰动模拟；3) 高阶水动力模型；4) 地形力学（terramechanics）建模；5) 压力驱动的环境变量变化；6) 基于物理的水下光学模型。该框架覆盖多种深海平台（AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV、水下滑翔机），并兼顾实时仿真性能。

Result: 该框架能够在保持实时仿真兼容性的前提下，更真实地捕捉深海AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV和水下滑翔机所受的力学作用与传感器测量行为，为深海条件导航、感知和自主性研究提供了实用基础。

Conclusion: 该工作推动水下仿真向更贴近真实深海作业条件的方向发展，特别适用于长时导航和学习型自主系统研究。尽管复杂流固相互作用和完整环境随机性建模仍具挑战，但该框架为深海条件下的研究提供了切实可行的起点。

Abstract: Many recent underwater simulators emphasize visual realism at the expense of physical fidelity, focusing on shallow-water effects with limited relevance in deep-water environments and high computational cost. In this work, we shift the focus toward deep-sea physical and sensor realism. We present a physics- and sensor-grounded extension of the Stonefish simulator that augments its hydrodynamic models with stochastic IMU and DVL drift, magnetometer disturbances, higher-order hydrodynamics, terramechanics, pressure-driven environmental variability, and physically based underwater optics. These additions are designed to better capture the forces and measurements shaping the behavior of deep-ocean AUVs, ROVs, landers, ASVs, and gliders, while remaining compatible with real-time simulation. This work advances underwater simulation toward more representative deep-sea operating conditions, which is particularly relevant for long-duration navigation and learning-based autonomy, where inaccurate sensor and environmental models introduce non-physical artifacts and overly optimistic performance. While challenges remain, including complex fluid-structure interactions and full environmental stochasticity, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for navigation, perception, and autonomy research under deep-sea conditions.

</details>


### [464] [Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization for Underwater Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26932)
*Michele Grimaldi,Yosaku Maeda,Hitoshi Kakami,Ignacio Carlucho,Yvan R. Petillot,Tomoya Inoue*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种接触辅助因子图定位（Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization）框架，通过将机械臂与海底的物理接触视为高置信度几何约束，融合自适应视觉里程计、目标检测和机载传感器，解决自主水下机器人在近距离海底采样时因视觉退化导致的尺度模糊和轨迹漂移问题。实验表明，接触约束显著降低轨迹漂移并提升目标重访精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主水下机器人在低空海底采样时，下视相机在无纹理平面海床上会产生尺度模糊、横向退化及特征跟踪不一致等问题；而惯性-DVL融合缺乏结构漂移校正机制。现有方法无法在感知退化的水下环境中提供可靠的定位精度，亟需新的定位策略。

Method: 提出Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization框架：1）在平滑定位公式中将物理交互（吸盘式机械手接触事件）建模为高置信度几何因子；2）紧密融合自适应视觉里程计、基于学习的物体检测和机载传感器；3）视觉里程计相对位姿因子与地标方位-距离因子按内点统计进行不确定性缩放，抑制弱视觉帧对估计器的干扰；4）接触事件作为隐式闭环约束，无需外观特征重识别；5）系统支持运动过程中完全在线初始化。

Result: 在实验水池、港口和仿真环境中的实验表明：与基于滤波的导航方法和无接触的图模型相比，接触诱导约束显著降低轨迹漂移，并提高目标重访精度。

Conclusion: 物理交互可作为感知退化水下环境中的一种定位原语（localization primitive），为自主水下机器人在低可见性、无纹理海底环境中的可靠定位提供了有效补充方案。

Abstract: Accurate state estimation for autonomous underwater vehicles performing close-range seafloor sampling remains challenging. In low-altitude operation, down-looking cameras over featureless planar seabeds produce scale ambiguity, lateral degeneracy, and inconsistent feature tracking. Meanwhile, inertial-Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) fusion alone provides no mechanism for structural drift correction. We propose a Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization framework that treats physical interaction as an informative geometric constraint within a smoothing-based localization formulation. The method tightly fuses suction-based manipulator contact events with adaptive visual odometry, learned object detections, and on-board sensors. Visual odometry relative-pose factors and landmark bearing-range factors are uncertainty-scaled according to inlier statistics to prevent visually weak frames from destabilizing the estimator, while contact events are modeled as high-confidence factors that induce implicit loop closures without appearance-based place recognition. Furthermore, the system can fully initialize online during motion. Experimental evaluation in tanks, harbor, and simulation environments demonstrates that contact-induced constraints significantly reduce trajectory drift and improve object revisit accuracy compared to filtering-based navigation and contact-free graph formulations. These results highlight the role of embodied physical interaction as a localization primitive in perception-degraded underwater environments

</details>


### [465] [4DSynth: Controllable Procedural World Synthesis for Dynamic Embodied Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26947)
*Zehao Qi,Haochen Luo,Jia-Wang Bian,Zeyu Ma,Shuyang Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 4DSynth是一个可控的程序化系统，能将自然语言描述、蓝图掩码或单张照片转化为带有显式几何、动画角色、无碰撞轨迹和物理就绪状态的4D环境，并由此构建了4DSynth-Nav交互式导航基准，实验表明两种视觉语言模型在多数任务上失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需要视觉多样、物理可交互且随时间变化的环境。程序化模拟器能生成大规模交互场景，4D生成器能产生视觉动力学，但将这些属性结合到一个环境中仍需大量手动工作，且结果难以编辑和控制，无法大规模复用。

Method: 提出4DSynth，一个可控程序化系统：将自然语言描述、蓝图掩码或单张照片作为输入，通过共享的几何接地表示支持多场景路径，统一处理动画、相机规划、渲染和任务生成，输出具有显式几何、动画演员、无碰撞轨迹和物理就绪仿真状态的4D环境。

Result: 构建了完全由4DSynth程序化场景生成的4DSynth-Nav交互式导航基准。在三个难度层级上评估了两种视觉语言模型，两者均在大多数任务上失败且在早期子任务后就停滞。同一程序化可控性使每个失败可复现且每个难度轴可独立调节。

Conclusion: 论文同时提出了可控的生成流水线和可扩展的基准测试，为开发和评估具身智能体提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Embodied agents need environments that are visually diverse, physically interactive, and changing over time. Procedural simulators can generate large interactive scene collections, and recent 4D generators produce compelling visual dynamics. Combining these properties in one environment, however, still demands extensive manual effort, and the result is rarely editable or controllable enough to reuse at scale.
  We present 4DSynth, a controllable procedural system that turns a natural-language description, a blueprint mask, or a single photograph into an editable 4D environment with explicit geometry, animated actors, collision-free trajectories, and physics-ready simulation state. Multiple scene routes share one geometry-grounded representation, so the same pipeline handles animation, camera planning, rendering, and task generation.
  To validate the full pipeline, we construct 4DSynth-Nav, an interactive navigation benchmark generated entirely from 4DSynth's procedural scenes. Two vision-language models evaluated across three difficulty tiers both fail the majority of tasks and stall after early subtasks. The same procedural controllability that produces these environments also makes each failure reproducible and each difficulty axis independently tunable. This paper presents both a controllable generation pipeline and the scalable benchmark it enables, offering a practical foundation for developing and evaluating embodied agents.
